;;; $9380..9388: Stripe image: clear credits tilemaps ;;;
;; Stripe image number $D2 (see ImagePointers), loaded when the credits start. Two RLE records fill VRAM $2000
;;     and $3000
;; with blank tiles ($F8/$00 and $FA/$08), then $FF ends the image.
$0C:9380              .db $20,$00,$5F,$FE,$F8,$00,$30,$00 ; Credits clear image: VRAM $2000, RLE fill $1FFF bytes with tile $F8 attr $00
$0C:9388              .db $5F,$FE,$FA,$08,$FF         ; Next record: VRAM $3000, RLE fill with tile $FA attr $08; $FF ends the image


;;; $938D: Ending mode entry points ;;;
;; Four JSL entry points called from bank 00 game modes. Each sets the data bank to $0C.
;; $0C938D: credits, every frame (game mode $1B): scroll text and layers ($9F6A) and run the background
;;     fade ($AB1F).
;; $0C939A: Yoshi's House (mode $1F): draw the sprite grid ($A0E3) and run the scene ($A1D4).
;; $0C93A5: enemy parade (mode $25): $AEAD.
;; $0C93AD: mode $21 wait: counts [$145B] down; at zero sets game mode $23 and [$1DE9] = $FF.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:9557: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
$0C:938D 8B           PHB                             ; \
$0C:938E 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = $0C (old bank saved on the stack)
$0C:938F AB           PLB                             ; /
$0C:9390 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$0C:9392 20 6A 9F     JSR.W $9F6A                     ; Scroll the credits layers and queue text rows ($9F6A)
$0C:9395 20 1F AB     JSR.W $AB1F                     ; Run the background transition fade ($AB1F)
$0C:9398 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$0C:9399 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$0C:939A 8B           PHB                             ; \
$0C:939B 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = $0C (old bank saved on the stack)
$0C:939C AB           PLB                             ; /
$0C:939D 20 E3 A0     JSR.W $A0E3                     ; Draw the 14x3 grid of 16x16 sprites ($A0E3)
$0C:93A0 20 D4 A1     JSR.W $A1D4                     ; Run the Yoshi's House scene ($A1D4)
$0C:93A3 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$0C:93A4 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$0C:93A5 8B           PHB                             ; \
$0C:93A6 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = $0C (old bank saved on the stack)
$0C:93A7 AB           PLB                             ; /
$0C:93A8 20 AD AE     JSR.W $AEAD                     ; Run the ending enemy parade ($AEAD)
$0C:93AB AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$0C:93AC 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$0C:93AD 8B           PHB                             ; \
$0C:93AE 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = $0C (old bank saved on the stack)
$0C:93AF AB           PLB                             ; /
$0C:93B0 CE 5B 14     DEC.W $145B                     ; Count down the wait timer [$145B]
$0C:93B3 D0 0A        BNE $93BF                       ; Not zero yet: just return
$0C:93B5 A9 23        LDA.B #$23                      ; \
$0C:93B7 8D 00 01     STA.W RAM_GameMode              ; / Game mode = $23 (ending: load the enemy parade)
$0C:93BA A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$0C:93BC 8D E9 1D     STA.W $1DE9                     ; / [$1DE9] = $FF (purpose unclear)
$0C:93BF AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$0C:93C0 6B           RTL                             ; Return long



;;; $93C1..93C9: Pointer table: credits background data ;;;
;; Seven 16-bit pointers into bank $0C, indexed by [$1928] * 2. Each points to RLE compressed Map16 numbers
;;     for one credits background.
$0C:93C1              .db $5A,$F4,$C0,$E7,$82,$EC,$44,$DD ; Backgrounds 0-3: $0C:F45A, $0C:E7C0, $0C:EC82, $0C:DD44
$0C:93C9              .db $00,$D9,$59,$DF,$54,$DE     ; Backgrounds 4-6: $0C:D900, $0C:DF59, $0C:DE54


;;; $93CF..93D7: Table: credits tile word masks ;;;
;; Seven words ANDed with each tile word of the matching background: $FFFF keeps bit 8 of the tile number,
;;     $FEFF clears it.
$0C:93CF              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FE,$FF,$FE,$FF,$FE ; AND masks for backgrounds 0-3: $FFFF, $FEFF, $FEFF, $FEFF
$0C:93D7              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FE,$FF,$FE     ; AND masks for backgrounds 4-6: $FFFF, $FEFF, $FEFF


;;; $93DD: Load credits backgrounds into tilemaps ;;;
;; Called once from the credits setup (bank 00 $0094A3). For each of the 7 backgrounds in [$1928]:
;;     decompresses the RLE Map16 numbers
;; to $7E:B900 ($944C, also builds a pointer table at $0FBE to the Map16 definitions at $0D:9100), then
;;     expands each 16x16
;; Map16 into four 8x8 tile words at $7F:4000 + [$1928] * $800 ($94C0). Finally DMAs background 0
;;     ($9567), resets the text
;; pointers, initializes the jumping objects and starts the credits music.
;; RLE format: control byte; bit 7 set = repeat the next byte (count-1) times, clear = copy count literal
;;     bytes. FF FF ends the data.
;; $0C944C: decompression. $0C94C0: Map16 to tilemap conversion (16 Map16 per row, two passes of 128).
;; Called by:
;;     $00:94A3: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
$0C:93DD C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$0C:93DF 9C 28 19     STZ.W $1928                     ; [$1928] = 0: start with credits background 0
$0C:93E2 AD 28 19     LDA.W $1928                     ; \
$0C:93E5 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$0C:93E8 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:93E9 AA           TAX                             ; / X = [$1928] * 2: index into the word tables
$0C:93EA BF C1 93 0C  LDA.L $93C1,X                   ; [$68] = pointer to this background's compressed Map16 map ($0C:xxxx)
$0C:93EE 85 68        STA $68
$0C:93F0 BF CF 93 0C  LDA.L $93CF,X                   ; [$65] = AND mask for this background's tile words
$0C:93F4 85 65        STA $65
$0C:93F6 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$0C:93F8 A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; Y = 0
$0C:93FB A6 68        LDX $68                         ; X = source pointer
$0C:93FD E0 FE E8     CPX.W #$E8FE                    ; \
$0C:9400 90 03        BCC $9405                       ; |
$0C:9402 A0 01 00     LDY.W #$0001                    ; / Y = 1 if the source pointer is >= $E8FE, else 0
$0C:9405 A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; X = 0
$0C:9408 98           TYA                             ; \
$0C:9409 9F 00 BD 7E  STA.L $7EBD00,X                 ; |
$0C:940D 9F 00 BF 7E  STA.L $7EBF00,X                 ; |
$0C:9411 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:9412 E0 00 02     CPX.W #$0200                    ; } Fill $7E:BD00-$BEFF and $7E:BF00-$C0FF with Y (Map16 high bytes)
$0C:9415 D0 F2        BNE $9409                       ; /
$0C:9417 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$0C:9419 85 6A        STA $6A                         ; / [$6A] = $0C: bank of the compressed data
$0C:941B A2 00 B9     LDX.W #$B900                    ; \
$0C:941E 86 0D        STX $0D                         ; / [$0D] = $B900: destination $7E:B900 (bank in [$0F] is set by $944C)
$0C:9420 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$0C:9422 20 4C 94     JSR.W $944C                     ; Decompress the map to $7E:B900 and build the Map16 pointers ($944C)
$0C:9425 20 C0 94     JSR.W $94C0                     ; Convert the Map16 map to a tilemap at $7F:4000 ($94C0)
$0C:9428 EE 28 19     INC.W $1928                     ; Next background: [$1928]++
$0C:942B AD 28 19     LDA.W $1928                     ; \
$0C:942E C9 07 00     CMP.W #$0007                    ; |
$0C:9431 D0 AF        BNE $93E2                       ; / Repeat until all 7 backgrounds are built
$0C:9433 A9 40 58     LDA.W #$5840                    ; \
$0C:9436 85 65        STA $65                         ; / [$65] = $5840: VRAM address of the first credits text row (BG3)
$0C:9438 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$0C:943A 64 67        STZ $67                         ; [$67] = 0: index of the next credits text row
$0C:943C 9C 28 19     STZ.W $1928                     ; [$1928] = 0: show background 0 first
$0C:943F 22 67 95 0C  JSL.L $9567                     ; DMA background 0 to VRAM ($9567)
$0C:9443 20 51 A0     JSR.W $A051                     ; Initialize the 7 jumping objects ($A051)
$0C:9446 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$0C:9448 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Play the credits music ([$1DFB] = $09)
$0C:944B 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$0C:944C C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$0C:944E A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; \
$0C:9451 84 03        STY $03                         ; |

$0C:9455 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$0C:9457 A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; \
$0C:9459 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / [$0F] = $7E: destination bank
$0C:945B A4 03        LDY $03                         ; Y = source index
$0C:945D B7 68        LDA [$68],Y                     ; Read the control byte: bit 7 = repeat run, low 7 bits = count - 1

$0C:9464 29 80        AND.B #$80                      ; \
$0C:9466 F0 18        BEQ $9480                       ; / Bit 7 clear: literal run ($0C9480)
$0C:9468 A5 07        LDA $07                         ; \
$0C:946A 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; |
$0C:946C 85 07        STA $07                         ; / [$07] = control byte & $7F (count - 1)
$0C:946E B7 68        LDA [$68],Y                     ; Read the byte to repeat
$0C:9470 C8           INY                             ; \
$0C:9471 84 03        STY $03                         ; / Advance the source index
$0C:9473 A4 05        LDY $05                         ; Y = destination index
$0C:9475 97 0D        STA [$0D],Y                     ; Store the byte at [$0D]+Y
$0C:9477 C8           INY                             ; Destination index++
$0C:9478 C6 07        DEC $07                         ; \
$0C:947A 10 F9        BPL $9475                       ; / Repeat count times
$0C:947C 84 05        STY $05                         ; Save the destination index
$0C:947E 80 12        BRA $9492                       ; Run done: go to the end check ($0C9492)

$0C:9480 A4 03        LDY $03                         ; Y = source index (literal run)
$0C:9482 B7 68        LDA [$68],Y                     ; Read the next literal byte
$0C:9484 C8           INY                             ; \
$0C:9485 84 03        STY $03                         ; / Advance the source index
$0C:9487 A4 05        LDY $05                         ; Y = destination index
$0C:9489 97 0D        STA [$0D],Y                     ; Store the byte at [$0D]+Y
$0C:948B C8           INY                             ; \
$0C:948C 84 05        STY $05                         ; / Advance the destination index
$0C:948E C6 07        DEC $07                         ; \
$0C:9490 10 EE        BPL $9480                       ; / Repeat for count bytes
$0C:9492 A4 03        LDY $03                         ; Y = source index
$0C:9494 B7 68        LDA [$68],Y                     ; \

$0C:9498 D0 C1        BNE $945B                       ; / Next byte is not $FF: decode another run
$0C:949A C8           INY                             ; \

$0C:949D C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; |
$0C:949F D0 BA        BNE $945B                       ; / Two $FF bytes in a row end the data; otherwise decode another run
$0C:94A1 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$0C:94A3 A9 00 91     LDA.W #$9100                    ; \
$0C:94A6 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $9100: address of the first Map16 definition in bank $0D
$0C:94A8 A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; X = 0
$0C:94AB A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:94AD 9D BE 0F     STA.W $0FBE,X                   ; / Table $0FBE+X = address of this definition
$0C:94B0 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:94B2 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:94B3 69 08 00     ADC.W #$0008                    ; |
$0C:94B6 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Next definition: address += 8 (four 8x8 tile words)
$0C:94B8 E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:94B9 E8           INX                             ; / X += 2
$0C:94BA E0 00 04     CPX.W #$0400                    ; \
$0C:94BD D0 EC        BNE $94AB                       ; / Repeat for 512 definitions
$0C:94BF 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:94C0 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$0C:94C2 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index 16-bit
$0C:94C4 A2 00 B9     LDX.W #$B900                    ; \
$0C:94C7 86 6B        STX $6B                         ; / [$6B] = $B900: pointer to the decompressed Map16 low bytes
$0C:94C9 A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; \
$0C:94CB 85 6D        STA $6D                         ; |
$0C:94CD 85 70        STA $70                         ; / [$6D] = [$70] = $7E: bank of both arrays
$0C:94CF A2 00 BD     LDX.W #$BD00                    ; \
$0C:94D2 86 6E        STX $6E                         ; / [$6E] = $BD00: pointer to the Map16 high bytes ($7E:BD00)
$0C:94D4 A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; \
$0C:94D6 85 6A        STA $6A                         ; / [$6A] = $0D: bank of the Map16 definitions
$0C:94D8 A0 F0 00     LDY.W #$00F0                    ; \
$0C:94DB 84 04        STY $04                         ; / [$04] = $00F0: source index of the first Map16 number
$0C:94DD AD 28 19     LDA.W $1928                     ; \
$0C:94E0 EB           XBA                             ; |
$0C:94E1 29 00        AND.B #$00                      ; |
$0C:94E3 AA           TAX                             ; |
$0C:94E4 86 00        STX $00                         ; / [$00] = [$1928] * 256: running Map16 counter (256 per background)
$0C:94E6 A2 7F 00     LDX.W #$007F                    ; \
$0C:94E9 86 08        STX $08                         ; / [$08] = $7F: Map16 tiles left in this pass - 1
$0C:94EB E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$0C:94ED A4 04        LDY $04                         ; Y = source index
$0C:94EF B7 6B        LDA [$6B],Y                     ; \
$0C:94F1 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = Map16 number, low byte
$0C:94F3 B7 6E        LDA [$6E],Y                     ; \
$0C:94F5 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = Map16 number, high byte
$0C:94F7 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$0C:94F9 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$0C:94FB 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:94FC AA           TAX                             ; / X = Map16 number * 2
$0C:94FD BD BE 0F     LDA.W $0FBE,X                   ; \
$0C:9500 85 68        STA $68                         ; / [$68] = address of this Map16's four tile words
$0C:9502 A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; Y = 0: offset into the definition
$0C:9505 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:9507 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:9508 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:9509 48           PHA                             ; |
$0C:950A 29 3F 00     AND.W #$003F                    ; |
$0C:950D 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$0C:950F 68           PLA                             ; |
$0C:9510 29 C0 FF     AND.W #$FFC0                    ; |
$0C:9513 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:9514 05 06        ORA $06                         ; |
$0C:9516 AA           TAX                             ; / X = tilemap byte offset: column = ([$00] mod 16) * 4, row = ([$00] / 16) * $80

$0C:9525 9F 40 40 7F  STA.L $7F4040,X                 ; / Tile word 1 (bottom-left) to $7F:4040+X (next tilemap row)

$0C:952A C8           INY                             ; / Next tile word
$0C:952B B7 68        LDA [$68],Y                     ; \
$0C:952D 25 65        AND $65                         ; |
$0C:952F 9F 02 40 7F  STA.L $7F4002,X                 ; / Tile word 2 (top-right) to $7F:4002+X
$0C:9533 C8           INY                             ; \

;;; $9567: DMA credits background to VRAM ;;;
;; Called through JSL from NMI (bank 00 $008203) and from the credits setup. Copies the $0800 byte tilemap of
;;     background [$1928]
;; from $7F:4000 + [$1928] * $0800 to VRAM $30C0 and $34C0 in two DMAs, then clears the reload request
;;     [$1FFE].
;; Called by:
;;     $00:8203: NMI handler: sound, PPU mirrors, DMA (NMIStart)
;;     $0C:943F: Load credits backgrounds into tilemaps
$0C:9567 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$0C:9569 8B           PHB                             ; \
$0C:956A 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = $0C (old bank saved on the stack)
$0C:956B AB           PLB                             ; /
$0C:956C A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$0C:956E 8D 15 21     STA.W $2115                     ; / VMAIN = $80: increment after the high byte
$0C:9571 A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; \
$0C:9573 8D 16 21     STA.W $2116                     ; / VRAM address low = $C0
$0C:9576 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$0C:9578 8D 17 21     STA.W $2117                     ; / VRAM address high = $30 (word address $30C0)
$0C:957B A0 06        LDY.B #$06                      ; Y = 6: copy 7 bytes
$0C:957D B9 59 95     LDA.W $9559,Y                   ; \
$0C:9580 99 10 43     STA.W $4310,Y                   ; |
$0C:9583 88           DEY                             ; |
$0C:9584 10 F7        BPL $957D                       ; / Copy the DMA setup to $4310-$4316 (channel 1)
$0C:9586 AD 28 19     LDA.W $1928                     ; \
$0C:9589 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:958A 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:958B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:958C 0D 13 43     ORA.W $4313                     ; |
$0C:958F 8D 13 43     STA.W $4313                     ; / Source high byte |= [$1928] * 8: source = $7F:4000 + background * $0800
$0C:9592 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0C:9594 8D 0B 42     STA.W $420B                     ; / Start DMA channel 1: first half of the tilemap to VRAM $30C0
$0C:9597 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$0C:9599 8D 15 21     STA.W $2115                     ; / VMAIN = $80
$0C:959C A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; \
$0C:959E 8D 16 21     STA.W $2116                     ; / VRAM address low = $C0
$0C:95A1 A9 34        LDA.B #$34                      ; \
$0C:95A3 8D 17 21     STA.W $2117                     ; / VRAM address high = $34 (word address $34C0)
$0C:95A6 A0 06        LDY.B #$06                      ; Y = 6: copy 7 bytes
$0C:95A8 B9 60 95     LDA.W $9560,Y                   ; \
$0C:95AB 99 10 43     STA.W $4310,Y                   ; |
$0C:95AE 88           DEY                             ; |
$0C:95AF 10 F7        BPL $95A8                       ; / Copy the DMA setup to $4310-$4316 (channel 1)
$0C:95B1 AD 28 19     LDA.W $1928                     ; \
$0C:95B4 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:95B5 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:95B6 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:95B7 0D 13 43     ORA.W $4313                     ; |
$0C:95BA 8D 13 43     STA.W $4313                     ; / Source high byte |= [$1928] * 8: source = $7F:4400 + background * $0800
$0C:95BD A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0C:95BF 8D 0B 42     STA.W $420B                     ; / Start DMA channel 1: second half of the tilemap to VRAM $34C0
$0C:95C2 9C FE 1F     STZ.W $1FFE                     ; [$1FFE] = 0: background reload request done
$0C:95C5 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$0C:95C6 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$0C:9E30              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 140-143: -, -, -, -
$0C:9E38              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 144-147: -, -, -, -
$0C:9E40              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 148-151: -, -, -, -
$0C:9E48              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 152-155: -, -, -, -
$0C:9E50              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 156-159: -, -, -, -
$0C:9E58              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 160-163: -, -, -, -
$0C:9E60              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 164-167: -, -, -, -
$0C:9E68              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 168-171: -, -, -, -
$0C:9E70              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 172-175: -, -, -, -
$0C:9E78              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 176-179: -, -, -, -
$0C:9E80              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 180-183: -, -, -, -
$0C:9E88              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 184-187: -, -, -, -
$0C:9E90              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 188-191: -, -, -, -
$0C:9E98              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 192-195: -, -, -, -
$0C:9EA0              .db $26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00,$26,$00 ; Rows 196-199: -, -, -, -
$0C:9EA8              .db $26,$00,$26,$00             ; Rows 200-201: -, -


;;; $9EAC..9EAC: Stripe record: blank text row ;;;
;; Body of a stripe record appended before each credits text row: RLE ($40), length $3E+1 = 64 bytes of tile
;;     $FC attr $00, then $FF.
$0C:9EAC              .db $40,$3E,$FC,$00,$FF         ; RLE record body: $40 $3E = RLE, 64 bytes of tile $FC attr $00 (blank row); $FF ends


;;; $9EB1: Queue next credits text row ;;;
;; Appends records to the stripe buffer at $7F:837D (index in $7F:837B): first a blank row at VRAM address
;;     [$66]:[$65], then the
;; text record for row [$67] (if any) at column offset. Then advances [$65] by $20 (one tilemap row), wrapping
;;     inside the BG3 map.
;; Called when BG3 has scrolled one more tile row.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:9FA9: Credits scroll update
$0C:9EB1 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$0C:9EB3 AF 7B 83 7F  LDA.L $7F837B                   ; \
$0C:9EB7 AA           TAX                             ; / X = write index into the stripe buffer $7F:837D
$0C:9EB8 A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; Y = 0: index into the blank row record
$0C:9EBB E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$0C:9EBD A5 66        LDA $66                         ; \
$0C:9EBF 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; / Record VRAM address high = [$66]
$0C:9EC3 A5 65        LDA $65                         ; \
$0C:9EC5 9F 7E 83 7F  STA.L $7F837E,X                 ; / Record VRAM address low = [$65]
$0C:9EC9 E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:9ECA E8           INX                             ; / Skip the address bytes
$0C:9ECB B9 AC 9E     LDA.W $9EAC,Y                   ; \
$0C:9ECE 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; / Copy the 5 byte blank row body (RLE fill with tile $FC, then $FF)
$0C:9ED2 E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:9ED3 C8           INY                             ; |
$0C:9ED4 C0 05 00     CPY.W #$0005                    ; |
$0C:9ED7 D0 F2        BNE $9ECB                       ; / Repeat for 5 bytes
$0C:9ED9 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$0C:9EDB CA           DEX                             ; \
$0C:9EDC 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:9EDD 8F 7B 83 7F  STA.L $7F837B                   ; / Buffer index = X - 1 (on the $FF so the next record overwrites it)
$0C:9EE1 A5 67        LDA $67                         ; \
$0C:9EE3 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$0C:9EE6 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:9EE7 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$67] * 2: index of this text row
$0C:9EE8 B9 18 9D     LDA.W $9D18,Y                   ; \
$0C:9EEB A8           TAY                             ; / Y = offset of this row's record in the text data ($95C7)
$0C:9EEC E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$0C:9EEE E6 67        INC $67                         ; Next text row: [$67]++
$0C:9EF0 B9 C7 95     LDA.W $95C7,Y                   ; \
$0C:9EF3 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; |
$0C:9EF5 F0 4C        BEQ $9F43                       ; / First byte $FF = empty row: skip to the VRAM pointer update
$0C:9EF7 B9 C7 95     LDA.W $95C7,Y                   ; \
$0C:9EFA 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = starting column
$0C:9EFC B9 C8 95     LDA.W $95C8,Y                   ; \
$0C:9EFF 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = byte count - 1
$0C:9F01 64 01        STZ $01                         ; [$01] = 0: length high byte
$0C:9F03 C8           INY                             ; \
$0C:9F04 C8           INY                             ; / Y = offset of the first tile word
$0C:9F05 A5 66        LDA $66                         ; \
$0C:9F07 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; / Record VRAM address high = [$66]
$0C:9F0B A5 65        LDA $65                         ; \
$0C:9F0D 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:9F0E 65 02        ADC $02                         ; |
$0C:9F10 9F 7E 83 7F  STA.L $7F837E,X                 ; / Record VRAM address low = [$65] + column
$0C:9F14 E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:9F15 E8           INX                             ; / Skip the address bytes
$0C:9F16 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$0C:9F18 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; / Length word high byte = 0
$0C:9F1C A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:9F1E 9F 7E 83 7F  STA.L $7F837E,X                 ; / Length word low byte = count - 1
$0C:9F22 E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:9F23 E8           INX                             ; / Skip the length word
$0C:9F24 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$0C:9F26 B9 C7 95     LDA.W $95C7,Y                   ; \
$0C:9F29 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; / Copy one tile word (tile, attributes) to the stripe buffer
$0C:9F2D E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:9F2E E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:9F2F C8           INY                             ; |
$0C:9F30 C8           INY                             ; / Advance source and destination by 2
$0C:9F31 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0C:9F33 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; |
$0C:9F35 10 EF        BPL $9F26                       ; / Repeat for all words
$0C:9F37 A9 FF 00     LDA.W #$00FF                    ; \
$0C:9F3A 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; / Write the $FF end marker
$0C:9F3E 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:9F3F 8F 7B 83 7F  STA.L $7F837B                   ; / Save the new buffer write index
$0C:9F43 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$0C:9F45 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index 8-bit
$0C:9F47 A5 65        LDA $65                         ; \
$0C:9F49 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:9F4A 69 20 00     ADC.W #$0020                    ; |
$0C:9F4D 85 65        STA $65                         ; / [$65] += $20: VRAM address of the next tilemap row
$0C:9F4F 29 FF 03     AND.W #$03FF                    ; \
$0C:9F52 D0 07        BNE $9F5B                       ; / Not at a $400-word boundary: done
$0C:9F54 A5 65        LDA $65                         ; \
$0C:9F56 49 00 0C     EOR.W #$0C00                    ; |
$0C:9F59 85 65        STA $65                         ; / Wrap to the next screen of the 64x64 BG3 map ($5C00 -> $5000, $5400 -> $5800)
$0C:9F5B 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $9F5C..9F64: Table: credits transition scroll positions ;;;
;; BG3 V-scroll ([$24]) values at which the background transition starts, then the final scroll position
;;     $0559.
$0C:9F5C              .db $C0,$00,$80,$01,$40,$02,$00,$03 ; $24 values where a background transition starts: $00C0, $0180, $0240, $0300
$0C:9F64              .db $C0,$03,$80,$04,$59,$05     ; $03C0, $0480, $0559 (the last is where the scroll stops)


;;; $9F6A: Credits scroll update ;;;
;; Per-frame credits scrolling with 8.8 fixed point speeds ($1446,X speed, $144E,X sub-pixel): BG2 H-scroll
;;     [$1E] moves -0.5 px/frame,
;; BG3 V-scroll [$24] moves +0.25 px/frame until $0559. Queues a text row every 8 pixels, starts the
;;     background transition ([$1B88] = 1)
;; at the table positions, then falls into drawing Mario and Yoshi.
;; $0C9FCB: adds speed [$1446,X] to position [$00,X] using sub-pixel accumulator [$144E,X].
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:9392: Ending mode entry points
$0C:9F6A C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$0C:9F6C A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: scroll component 0 (BG2 horizontal)
$0C:9F6E A9 80 FF     LDA.W #$FF80                    ; \
$0C:9F71 9D 46 14     STA.W $1446,X                   ; / Speed 0 = $FF80 (-0.5 pixel/frame, 8.8 fixed point)
$0C:9F74 B5 1E        LDA $1E,X                       ; \
$0C:9F76 95 00        STA $00,X                       ; / Work copy [$00] = BG2 H-scroll [$1E]
$0C:9F78 20 CB 9F     JSR.W $9FCB                     ; Apply the speed ($9FCB)
$0C:9F7B B5 00        LDA $00,X                       ; \
$0C:9F7D 95 1E        STA $1E,X                       ; / BG2 H-scroll = updated position
$0C:9F7F A5 24        LDA $24                         ; \
$0C:9F81 C9 59 05     CMP.W #$0559                    ; |
$0C:9F84 B0 26        BCS $9FAC                       ; / BG3 V-scroll >= $0559: scroll finished, skip the text part
$0C:9F86 A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; X = 2: scroll component 1 (BG3 vertical)
$0C:9F88 A9 40 00     LDA.W #$0040                    ; \
$0C:9F8B 9D 46 14     STA.W $1446,X                   ; / Speed 1 = $0040 (+0.25 pixel/frame)
$0C:9F8E A5 24        LDA $24                         ; \
$0C:9F90 95 00        STA $00,X                       ; |
$0C:9F92 85 04        STA $04                         ; / Work copy [$02] and [$04] = BG3 V-scroll [$24]
$0C:9F94 20 CB 9F     JSR.W $9FCB                     ; Apply the speed ($9FCB)
$0C:9F97 B5 00        LDA $00,X                       ; \
$0C:9F99 C5 04        CMP $04                         ; |
$0C:9F9B F0 0F        BEQ $9FAC                       ; / No whole pixel moved: skip
$0C:9F9D 85 24        STA $24                         ; BG3 V-scroll = new position
$0C:9F9F A5 24        LDA $24                         ; \
$0C:9FA1 29 07 00     AND.W #$0007                    ; |
$0C:9FA4 C9 01 00     CMP.W #$0001                    ; |
$0C:9FA7 D0 03        BNE $9FAC                       ; / Only when [$24] mod 8 = 1 (a new tile row has scrolled into view)
$0C:9FA9 20 B1 9E     JSR.W $9EB1                     ; Queue the next credits text row ($9EB1)
$0C:9FAC A2 0C        LDX.B #$0C                      ; X = $0C: last entry of the transition position table
$0C:9FAE A5 24        LDA $24                         ; \
$0C:9FB0 DD 5C 9F     CMP.W $9F5C,X                   ; |
$0C:9FB3 F0 06        BEQ $9FBB                       ; / [$24] equals a transition position?
$0C:9FB5 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0C:9FB6 CA           DEX                             ; |
$0C:9FB7 10 F5        BPL $9FAE                       ; / Search all 7 entries
$0C:9FB9 80 0B        BRA $9FC6                       ; No match: continue

$0C:9FBB AD 88 1B     LDA.W $1B88                     ; \
$0C:9FBE 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$0C:9FC1 D0 03        BNE $9FC6                       ; / Transition already running ([$1B88] != 0): leave it
$0C:9FC3 EE 88 1B     INC.W $1B88                     ; [$1B88] = 1: start the background transition
$0C:9FC6 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$0C:9FC8 82 1F 00     BRL $9FEA                       ; Go draw Mario and Yoshi ($9FEA)
$0C:9FCB BD 4E 14     LDA.W $144E,X                   ; \
$0C:9FCE 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / Low byte of the sub-pixel accumulator [$144E,X]
$0C:9FD1 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:9FD2 7D 46 14     ADC.W $1446,X                   ; |
$0C:9FD5 9D 4E 14     STA.W $144E,X                   ; / Accumulator = low byte + speed
$0C:9FD8 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; \
$0C:9FDB 10 03        BPL $9FE0                       ; |
$0C:9FDD 09 FF 00     ORA.W #$00FF                    ; |
$0C:9FE0 EB           XBA                             ; / A = whole pixels moved (high byte, sign extended)
$0C:9FE1 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:9FE2 75 00        ADC $00,X                       ; |
$0C:9FE4 95 00        STA $00,X                       ; / Position [$00,X] += pixels
$0C:9FE6 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $9FE7..9FE7: Table: Yoshi piece Y offsets ;;;
;; Indexed by [$1602]: +0, -1, +0 (added to base Y $85).
$0C:9FE7              .db $00,$FF,$00                 ; Added to the base Y of the extra Yoshi pieces, indexed by [$1602]: +0, -1, +0


;;; $9FEA: Draw Mario and Yoshi in the credits ;;;
;; Places Mario at ($0038,$008F), Super, walking right, and sprite slot 0 as Yoshi (sprite $35) at ($52,$8F),
;;     animates them, draws two extra
;; OAM pieces and then moves and draws the 7 jumping objects (hedged: probably the rescued Yoshi eggs).
$0C:9FEA C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$0C:9FEC A9 38 00     LDA.W #$0038                    ; \
$0C:9FEF 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; / Mario X position = $0038
$0C:9FF1 A9 8F 00     LDA.W #$008F                    ; \
$0C:9FF4 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; / Mario Y position = $008F
$0C:9FF6 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$0C:9FF8 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0C:9FFA 85 19        STA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; / Mario power-up = 1 (Super Mario)
$0C:9FFC A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$0C:9FFE 8D 7B 00     STA.W RAM_MarioSpeedX           ; / Mario X speed = 8 (walking right)
$0C:A001 20 5A A7     JSR.W $A75A                     ; Update Mario's pose and timers ($A75A)
$0C:A004 A9 52        LDA.B #$52                      ; \
$0C:A006 85 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo               ; / Sprite slot 0 X low = $52
$0C:A008 9C E0 14     STZ.W RAM_SpriteXHi             ; Sprite slot 0 X high = 0
$0C:A00B A9 8F        LDA.B #$8F                      ; \
$0C:A00D 85 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo               ; / Sprite slot 0 Y low = $8F
$0C:A00F 9C D4 14     STZ.W RAM_SpriteYHi             ; Sprite slot 0 Y high = 0
$0C:A012 A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; \
$0C:A014 8D EA 15     STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex           ; / Sprite slot 0 OAM index = $A0
$0C:A017 20 78 A7     JSR.W $A778                     ; Set up and animate sprite $35 (Yoshi) in slot 0 ($A778)
$0C:A01A AE 02 16     LDX.W $1602                     ; X = [$1602] (Yoshi animation frame)
$0C:A01D A9 51        LDA.B #$51                      ; \
$0C:A01F 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0C:A021 64 01        STZ $01                         ; / [$00]/[$01] = $0051: X position of the extra pieces
$0C:A023 BD E7 9F     LDA.W $9FE7,X                   ; \
$0C:A026 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A027 69 85        ADC.B #$85                      ; |
$0C:A029 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = $85 + offset table [X]: Y position of the extra pieces
$0C:A02B 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:A02C 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:A02D 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:A02E A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$1602] * 4: index into the tile tables
$0C:A02F A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: OAM offset
$0C:A031 20 21 A8     JSR.W $A821                     ; Draw the two extra OAM pieces ($A821)
$0C:A034 A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; \
$0C:A036 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / [$0E] = $A0: Y line where an object lands
$0C:A038 20 A3 A8     JSR.W $A8A3                     ; Move the 7 jumping objects ($A8A3)
$0C:A03B A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$0C:A03D 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = $10: OAM offset for the objects
$0C:A03F 20 DF A8     JSR.W $A8DF                     ; Draw the 7 jumping objects ($A8DF)
$0C:A042 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $A043..A04A: Table: jumping object start positions ;;;
;; $0CA043: X positions $63-$C3 (step $10). $0CA04A: Y positions $A0/$9C alternating (7 objects each).
$0C:A043              .db $63,$73,$83,$93,$A3,$B3,$C3 ; X positions of the 7 jumping objects: $63, $73 ... $C3

$0C:A04A              .db $A0,$9C,$A0,$9C,$A0,$9C,$A0 ; Y positions of the 7 jumping objects: $A0, $9C alternating


;;; $A051: Initialize credits jumping objects ;;;
;; Clears the per-object tables ($0B23, $0B32) and sets 7 objects (index $07-$0D): X/Y from the tables above,
;;     speed from $A3C2,
;; $0AF6 = 1. Also Mario faces right and [$1B89] = $E2.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:9443: Load credits backgrounds into tilemaps
$0C:A051 8B           PHB                             ; \
$0C:A052 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = $0C (old bank saved on the stack)
$0C:A053 AB           PLB                             ; /
$0C:A054 A2 0E        LDX.B #$0E                      ; X = $0E: clear 15 entries
$0C:A056 9E 23 0B     STZ.W $0B23,X                   ; \
$0C:A059 9E 32 0B     STZ.W $0B32,X                   ; / Clear the object tables $0B23 and $0B32
$0C:A05C CA           DEX                             ; \
$0C:A05D 10 F7        BPL $A056                       ; / Repeat for all 15 entries
$0C:A05F A2 0D        LDX.B #$0D                      ; X = $0D: object index
$0C:A061 A0 06        LDY.B #$06                      ; Y = 6: table index
$0C:A063 B9 4A A0     LDA.W $A04A,Y                   ; \
$0C:A066 9D 41 0B     STA.W $0B41,X                   ; / $0B41[X] = Y position
$0C:A069 9E 5F 0B     STZ.W $0B5F,X                   ; $0B5F[X] = 0
$0C:A06C B9 43 A0     LDA.W $A043,Y                   ; \
$0C:A06F 9D 50 0B     STA.W $0B50,X                   ; / $0B50[X] = X position
$0C:A072 9E 6E 0B     STZ.W $0B6E,X                   ; $0B6E[X] = 0
$0C:A075 B9 C2 A3     LDA.W $A3C2,Y                   ; \
$0C:A078 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X                   ; / $0B05[X] = initial vertical speed from $A3C2 ($F6 = -10)
$0C:A07B A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0C:A07D 9D F6 0A     STA.W $0AF6,X                   ; / $0AF6[X] = 1 (probably gravity added to the speed each frame)
$0C:A080 88           DEY                             ; \
$0C:A081 CA           DEX                             ; / Next object
$0C:A082 E0 06        CPX.B #$06                      ; \
$0C:A084 D0 DD        BNE $A063                       ; / Repeat for X = $0D..$07 (7 objects)
$0C:A086 64 76        STZ RAM_MarioDirection          ; Mario faces right
$0C:A088 A9 E2        LDA.B #$E2                      ; \
$0C:A08A 8D 89 1B     STA.W $1B89                     ; / [$1B89] = $E2: starting window position of the transition (probably)
$0C:A08D AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$0C:A08E 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $A08F..A0B7: Table: Yoshi's House grid tile numbers ;;;
;; 42 OAM tile numbers for a 14x3 grid of 16x16 sprites (probably scenery decoration); $FF = empty cell.
$0C:A08F              .db $FF,$02,$04,$06,$08,$06,$08,$06 ; OAM tile numbers of the 14x3 grid (14 per row, cells 0-7); $FF = empty cell
$0C:A097              .db $08,$06,$08,$04,$02,$FF,$20,$22 ; Grid cells 8-15 (row 0 ends at cell 13)
$0C:A09F              .db $24,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF ; Grid cells 16-23 (row 1: cells 14-27)
$0C:A0A7              .db $FF,$24,$22,$20,$40,$42,$FF,$FF ; Grid cells 24-31
$0C:A0AF              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF ; Grid cells 32-39 (row 2: cells 28-41)
$0C:A0B7              .db $42,$40                     ; Grid cells 40-41


;;; $A0B9..A0E1: Table: Yoshi's House grid properties ;;;
;; 42 OAM property bytes matching the tile numbers ($77 = X-flipped); $FF = empty cell.
$0C:A0B9              .db $FF,$37,$37,$35,$35,$37,$37,$39 ; OAM properties of the 14x3 grid (cells 0-7); $77 = X-flipped; $FF = empty cell
$0C:A0C1              .db $39,$3B,$3B,$77,$77,$FF,$37,$37 ; Grid cells 8-15
$0C:A0C9              .db $37,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF ; Grid cells 16-23
$0C:A0D1              .db $FF,$77,$77,$77,$37,$37,$FF,$FF ; Grid cells 24-31
$0C:A0D9              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF ; Grid cells 32-39
$0C:A0E1              .db $77,$77                     ; Grid cells 40-41


;;; $A0E3: Draw Yoshi's House sprite grid ;;;
;; Fills OAM from $0290 with the 14x3 grid: X from $10 step $10 to $E0, Y from $2F step $10; each cell uses
;;     the tile and property
;; tables, size 16x16; $FF cells are skipped. Called every frame from the Yoshi's House mode.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:939D: Ending mode entry points
$0C:A0E3 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$0C:A0E5 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0C:A0E7 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$00] = [$02] = $10: left edge X of the grid
$0C:A0E9 A9 2F        LDA.B #$2F                      ; \
$0C:A0EB 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = $2F: Y of the first row
$0C:A0ED A2 90        LDX.B #$90                      ; X = $90: OAM offset of the first piece
$0C:A0EF A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: grid cell index

$0C:A0FB B9 B9 A0     LDA.W $A0B9,Y                   ; \

$0C:A106 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$0C:A108 9D 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,X               ; / OAM Y = [$01]
$0C:A10B DA           PHX                             ; \

$0C:A10D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A10E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A10F AA           TAX                             ; / X = OAM offset / 4: index into the size table
$0C:A110 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0C:A112 9D 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,X            ; / OAM size = large (16x16), X bit 8 = 0
$0C:A115 FA           PLX                             ; \
$0C:A116 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:A117 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:A118 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:A119 E8           INX                             ; / Restore X and advance the OAM offset by 4
$0C:A11A A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:A11C 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A11D 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0C:A11F 85 00        STA $00                         ; / X += $10: next column
$0C:A121 C9 F0        CMP.B #$F0                      ; \

$0C:A125 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$0C:A127 85 00        STA $00                         ; / X back to the left edge
$0C:A129 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$0C:A12B 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A12C 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0C:A12E 85 01        STA $01                         ; / Y += $10: next row

$0C:A131 C0 2A        CPY.B #$2A                      ; \
$0C:A133 D0 BC        BNE $A0F1                       ; / Repeat for all 42 cells
$0C:A135 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $A146: Draw banner; dispatch scene substate ;;;
;; Tail of a sprite-banner drawer: draws 16 16x16 OAM sprites (tiles $A136, property $35) as two
;;     4x2-tile halves,
;; the first at X = $80, the second at X = $40 - [$04] (probably the end-of-credits title graphic). Skips
;;     tiles whose X high byte is non-zero.
;; $0CA1D4 (entry): runs $AB1F (fade/window and scene timer update) and jumps through the substate table
;;     at $0CA1DE by [$1442].
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:A6B0: Ending: eggshell fragments and Yoshi helpers
$0C:A146 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; Accumulator 16-bit
$0C:A148 A9 3F 00     LDA.W #$003F                    ; \
$0C:A14B 85 08        STA $08                         ; } $08 = $0A = $003F: Y position of the first banner row
$0C:A14D 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; /
$0C:A14F 64 00        STZ $00                         ; \
$0C:A151 64 02        STZ $02                         ; |
$0C:A153 64 04        STZ $04                         ; } $00 = $02 = $04 = 0: X work values cleared
$0C:A155 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: index of the first banner tile
$0C:A157 A2 50        LDX.B #$50                      ; X = $50: OAM index to start writing at
$0C:A159 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; Accumulator 16-bit
$0C:A15B A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:A15D 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A15E 69 80 00     ADC.W #$0080                    ; |
$0C:A161 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0C:A163 85 02        STA $02                         ; } $00 = $02 = [$00] + $0080: X position of the first banner half (left edge)
$0C:A165 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; Accumulator 8-bit
$0C:A167 20 83 A1     JSR.W $A183                     ; Draw the first 8 banner tiles (two rows of four 16x16 sprites)
$0C:A16A C2 20        REP #$20                        ; Accumulator 16-bit
$0C:A16C A9 80 00     LDA.W #$0080                    ; \
$0C:A16F 38           SEC                             ; |
$0C:A170 E5 04        SBC $04                         ; |
$0C:A172 38           SEC                             ; |
$0C:A173 E9 40 00     SBC.W #$0040                    ; |
$0C:A176 85 00        STA $00                         ; } $00 = $02 = $0080 - [$04] - $0040: X position of the second banner half
$0C:A178 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$0C:A17A A9 3F 00     LDA.W #$003F                    ; \
$0C:A17D 85 08        STA $08                         ; |
$0C:A17F 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; } $08 = $0A = $003F: Y position reset for the second half
$0C:A181 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; Accumulator 8-bit; falls into the tile loop
$0C:A183 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; Draw loop entry: X position high byte
$0C:A185 D0 24        BNE $A1AB                       ; Skip the tile if the X position is off-screen (high byte non-zero)
$0C:A187 B9 36 A1     LDA.W $A136,Y                   ; \
$0C:A18A 9D 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,X                ; } OAM tile = $A136[Y]
$0C:A18D A9 35        LDA.B #$35                      ; \
$0C:A18F 9D 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,X                ; } OAM property = $35 (palette 2, priority 3)
$0C:A192 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:A194 9D 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,X               ; } OAM X = [$00]
$0C:A197 A5 08        LDA $08                         ; \
$0C:A199 9D 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,X               ; } OAM Y = [$08]
$0C:A19C DA           PHX                             ; \
$0C:A19D 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:A19E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A19F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A1A0 AA           TAX                             ; |
$0C:A1A1 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$0C:A1A3 9D 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,X            ; |
$0C:A1A6 FA           PLX                             ; } OAM size bit: tile uses large size (16x16)
$0C:A1A7 E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:A1A8 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:A1A9 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:A1AA E8           INX                             ; / X += 4: next OAM slot
$0C:A1AB C2 20        REP #$20                        ; Accumulator 16-bit
$0C:A1AD A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:A1AF 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A1B0 69 10 00     ADC.W #$0010                    ; |
$0C:A1B3 85 00        STA $00                         ; } X position += $0010: next tile column
$0C:A1B5 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; Accumulator 8-bit
$0C:A1B7 98           TYA                             ; \
$0C:A1B8 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$0C:A1BA C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; / End of a four-tile row? ([Y] AND 7 = 3)
$0C:A1BC D0 0F        BNE $A1CD                       ; Not at row end: next tile
$0C:A1BE A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$0C:A1C0 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0C:A1C2 A5 03        LDA $03                         ; } Row end: $00/$01 = start X ($02/$03) again
$0C:A1C4 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$0C:A1C6 A5 08        LDA $08                         ; \
$0C:A1C8 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A1C9 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0C:A1CB 85 08        STA $08                         ; } Y position += $10: next banner row
$0C:A1CD C8           INY                             ; Next tile index
$0C:A1CE 98           TYA                             ; \
$0C:A1CF 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; / Loop until the eight-tile group is done
$0C:A1D1 D0 B0        BNE $A183                       ; Loop for the rest of the group
$0C:A1D3 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:A1D4 20 1F AB     JSR.W $AB1F                     ; Update scene fade/window effect and scene timer
$0C:A1D7 AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; \
$0C:A1DA 22 FA 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtrLong            ; } Jump to the scene substate routine for [$1442] (pointer table below)


;;; $A1DE: Scene substate table and substate 0 (PtrsLong0CA1DE) ;;;
;; Pointer table (long) of credits-scene substates indexed by [$1442], followed by substate 0.
;; Substate 0: after the fade-in ([$1B89] = 0) sets Mario Y = $0160, walks Mario left (actor 0, X speed $F8)
;;     with Yoshi (sprite $35)
;; following $30 pixels behind, moves the line of seven actors (7-13) left, bounces them, and draws
;;     everything.
;; Advances to substate 1 when actor 7 reaches X = $0030. Actor arrays: Y speed $0B05, Y pos $0B41, X speed
;;     $0B14, X pos $0B50 (hi $0B6E).
$0C:A1DE ED A1 0C     .dw $A1ED .db :$CODE_0CA1ED     ; Substate 0: Mario and the line of characters walk in
$0C:A1E1 3C A4 0C     .dw $A43C .db :$CODE_0CA43C     ; Substate 1: landing pose animation
$0C:A1E4 32 A5 0C     .dw $A532 .db :$CODE_0CA532     ; Substate 2: release the characters one by one
$0C:A1E7 5B A6 0C     .dw $A65B .db :$CODE_0CA65B     ; Substate 3
$0C:A1EA B0 A6 0C     .dw $A6B0 .db :$CODE_0CA6B0     ; Substate 4: show banner and keep animating

$0C:A1F6 A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; \

$0C:A1FA A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \

$0C:A20F 20 64 A7     JSR.W $A764                     ; Clear behind-scenery flag and tick timers

$0C:A215 AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; Substate 0?

$0C:A21A A5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo               ; \

$0C:A21E A9 9F        LDA.B #$9F                      ; \

$0C:A222 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: first tile pair
$0C:A224 A2 B4        LDX.B #$B4                      ; X = $B4: OAM index

$0C:A22D 64 01        STZ $01                         ; X position high byte = 0
$0C:A22F AD 50 0B     LDA.W $0B50                     ; \
$0C:A232 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A233 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0C:A235 85 00        STA $00                         ; } $00 = actor 0 X position + $10
$0C:A237 AD 6E 0B     LDA.W $0B6E                     ; \
$0C:A23A 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$0C:A23C 85 01        STA $01                         ; } $01 = actor 0 X position high byte (+ carry)
$0C:A23E A9 9F        LDA.B #$9F                      ; \
$0C:A240 85 02        STA $02                         ; } $02 = $9F: Y position
$0C:A242 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \

$0C:A24F A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; \
$0C:A251 9D 14 0B     STA.W $0B14,X                   ; } Actor 0 X speed = $F8 (walk left, 1/2 pixel per frame)
$0C:A254 20 4F A7     JSR.W $A74F                     ; Move actor 0 horizontally
$0C:A257 BD 50 0B     LDA.W $0B50,X                   ; \

$0C:A281 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \

$0C:A28B 20 78 A7     JSR.W $A778                     ; Init and draw Yoshi (sprite $35) via $A778
$0C:A28E 64 01        STZ $01                         ; X position high byte = 0
$0C:A290 AD 50 0B     LDA.W $0B50                     ; \
$0C:A293 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A294 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0C:A296 85 00        STA $00                         ; } $00 = actor 0 X position + $10
$0C:A298 AD 6E 0B     LDA.W $0B6E                     ; \
$0C:A29B 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |

$0C:A2BC 0A           ASL                             ; |

;;; $A315: Update hopping character and draw trio ;;;
;; Gravity-hops actor 1 (Y speed += 1, floor at Y = $9F, bounce speed $F0), derives pose [$1458] (0-2) from
;;     its vertical speed,
;; and, if [$1457] = 1, draws three characters (left X=$18, right X=$D4, centre X=$50) with frames chosen by
;;     the pose.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:A1ED: Scene substate table and substate 0 (PtrsLong0CA1DE)
;;     $0C:A443: Substate 1: landing pose animation
;;     $0C:A6B3: Ending: eggshell fragments and Yoshi helpers
$0C:A315 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; X = 1: actor 1 (the hopping character)
$0C:A317 BD 05 0B     LDA.W $0B05,X                   ; \
$0C:A31A 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A31B 69 01        ADC.B #$01                      ; |
$0C:A31D 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X                   ; } Actor 1 Y speed += 1 (gravity)
$0C:A320 20 21 A7     JSR.W $A721                     ; Apply Y speed to actor 1 position
$0C:A323 BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X                   ; \
$0C:A326 C9 9F        CMP.B #$9F                      ; / Actor 1 Y position reached the ground ($9F)?
$0C:A328 90 0A        BCC $A334                       ; Still in the air
$0C:A32A A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$0C:A32C 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X                   ; } Landed: Y speed = $F0 (bounce up)
$0C:A32F A9 9F        LDA.B #$9F                      ; \
$0C:A331 9D 41 0B     STA.W $0B41,X                   ; } Y position = $9F
$0C:A334 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: pose index
$0C:A336 AD 06 0B     LDA.W $0B06                     ; Actor 1 Y speed
$0C:A339 10 0E        BPL $A349                       ; Falling (positive): handle below
$0C:A33B C9 F4        CMP.B #$F4                      ; Rising: fast
$0C:A33D 90 16        BCC $A355                       ; Y = 0 when the speed is $F4 or faster upward
$0C:A33F A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; Y = 1
$0C:A341 C9 F8        CMP.B #$F8                      ; Speed $F4-$F7?
$0C:A343 90 10        BCC $A355                       ; Y = 1 (medium)
$0C:A345 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2 (near the top of the hop)
$0C:A347 80 00        BRA $A349                       ; Continue

$0C:A349 C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; Falling and fast ($0C+)?

$0C:A423 B9 C2 A3     LDA.W $A3C2,Y                   ; \

;;; $A43C: Substate 1: landing pose animation ;;;
;; While pose [$1458] < 8 runs the hopping routine; when the hop ends on pose 0 at the ground it starts pose
;;     8. Poses 8-$0A step every 6 frames;
;; reaching $0B holds $0A and moves to substate 2. Draws the left/right/centre characters per pose, then joins
;;     the substate 0 drawing at $0CA1F6.
$0C:A43C AD 58 14     LDA.W $1458                     ; Pose [$1458]
$0C:A43F C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Pose >= 8?
$0C:A441 B0 19        BCS $A45C                       ; Yes: landing animation
$0C:A443 20 15 A3     JSR.W $A315                     ; Update the hopping character
$0C:A446 AD 58 14     LDA.W $1458                     ; Pose
$0C:A449 D0 0C        BNE $A457                       ; Not 0: no change
$0C:A44B AD 42 0B     LDA.W $0B42                     ; \
$0C:A44E C9 9F        CMP.B #$9F                      ; / Actor 1 Y position at the ground ($9F)?
$0C:A450 D0 05        BNE $A457                       ; No
$0C:A452 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$0C:A454 8D 58 14     STA.W $1458                     ; } Landed on pose 0: start the landing animation (pose 8)
$0C:A457 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$0C:A459 82 B4 00     BRL $A510                       ; Go draw only the lead sprite
$0C:A45C CE 59 14     DEC.W $1459                     ; Pose timer -1
$0C:A45F 10 17        BPL $A478                       ; Not expired
$0C:A461 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$0C:A463 8D 59 14     STA.W $1459                     ; } Reload pose timer = 6
$0C:A466 EE 58 14     INC.W $1458                     ; Next pose
$0C:A469 AD 58 14     LDA.W $1458                     ; \
$0C:A46C C9 0B        CMP.B #$0B                      ; / Pose reached $0B?
$0C:A46E D0 08        BNE $A478                       ; No
$0C:A470 A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$0C:A472 8D 58 14     STA.W $1458                     ; } Pose = $0A (hold the last pose)
$0C:A475 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Advance scene substate to 2
$0C:A478 AD 58 14     LDA.W $1458                     ; Pose
$0C:A47B 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; Pose AND 3 = 0?

$0C:A47F A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$0C:A481 85 00        STA $00                         ; } $00 = $18: X position of the left character
$0C:A483 64 01        STZ $01                         ; X high byte = 0
$0C:A485 A9 9F        LDA.B #$9F                      ; \
$0C:A487 85 02        STA $02                         ; } $02 = $9F: Y position
$0C:A489 AD 58 14     LDA.W $1458                     ; \

$0C:A48F 69 07        ADC.B #$07                      ; |
$0C:A491 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:A492 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:A493 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = ((pose AND 3) + 7) * 4: metasprite frame
$0C:A494 A2 D0        LDX.B #$D0                      ; X = $D0: OAM index
$0C:A496 20 21 A8     JSR.W $A821                     ; Draw the 2x2 metasprite
$0C:A499 A9 D4        LDA.B #$D4                      ; \
$0C:A49B 85 00        STA $00                         ; } $00 = $D4: X position of the right character
$0C:A49D 64 01        STZ $01                         ; X high byte = 0
$0C:A49F A9 9F        LDA.B #$9F                      ; \
$0C:A4A1 85 02        STA $02                         ; } $02 = $9F: Y position
$0C:A4A3 AD 58 14     LDA.W $1458                     ; \
$0C:A4A6 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$0C:A4A8 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A4A9 69 0A        ADC.B #$0A                      ; |
$0C:A4AB 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:A4AC 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:A4AD A8           TAY                             ; } Y = ((pose AND 3) + $0A) * 4: metasprite frame
$0C:A4AE A2 F0        LDX.B #$F0                      ; X = $F0: OAM index
$0C:A4B0 20 21 A8     JSR.W $A821                     ; Draw the 2x2 metasprite
$0C:A4B3 82 33 00     BRL $A4E9                       ; Go draw the centre character
$0C:A4B6 A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \

$0C:A4BA 64 01        STZ $01                         ; X high byte = 0
$0C:A4BC A9 A7        LDA.B #$A7                      ; \

$0C:A4C0 AD 58 14     LDA.W $1458                     ; \

$0C:A4C7 0A           ASL                             ; |

$0C:A4D4 A9 A7        LDA.B #$A7                      ; \
$0C:A4D6 85 02        STA $02                         ; } $02 = $A7: Y position
$0C:A4D8 AD 58 14     LDA.W $1458                     ; \
$0C:A4DB 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$0C:A4DD 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$0C:A4DE 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A4DF 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; |
$0C:A4E1 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:A4E2 0A           ASL                             ; |

$0C:A4E4 A2 D8        LDX.B #$D8                      ; X = $D8: OAM index

$0C:A4E9 AD 58 14     LDA.W $1458                     ; \

$0C:A4EF B9 39 A4     LDA.W $A439,Y                   ; \

$0C:A502 20 15 AA     JSR.W $AA15                     ; Draw the two-tile tall sprite
$0C:A505 AD 58 14     LDA.W $1458                     ; \

$0C:A50A A8           TAY                             ; |

$0C:A50E 0A           ASL                             ; |

$0C:A510 A5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo               ; \

;;; $A524..A52B: Data: release bit masks and order ;;;
$0C:A524              .db $20,$01,$10,$40,$08,$02,$04 ; Bit masks of the seven line actors, in release order

;;; $A532: Substate 2: release the seven actors ;;;
;; One actor per call ([$145C] = 0): launches line actor 7+X upward (speed $C0, gravity 4), spawns four
;;     particle actors 3-6 at its position,
;; sets its bit in the visible mask [$145A], plays sound $0A. After the 8th ([$145B]) sets actor 2 X = $80,
;;     changes music to $0B and goes to substate 3.
;; Otherwise runs $A5DE (outside this chunk) and redraws via $0CA4B6.
$0C:A532 AD 5C 14     LDA.W $145C                     ; [$145C]: release in progress?
$0C:A535 F0 03        BEQ $A53A                       ; Zero: start the next release
$0C:A537 82 91 00     BRL $A5CB                       ; Busy: just draw
$0C:A53A A9 98        LDA.B #$98                      ; \
$0C:A53C 8D 08 0B     STA.W $0B08                     ; |
$0C:A53F 8D 09 0B     STA.W $0B09                     ; } Y speeds of actors 3 and 4 = $98
$0C:A542 A9 D4        LDA.B #$D4                      ; \
$0C:A544 8D 0A 0B     STA.W $0B0A                     ; |
$0C:A547 8D 0B 0B     STA.W $0B0B                     ; } Y speeds of actors 5 and 6 = $D4
$0C:A54A AC 5B 14     LDY.W $145B                     ; Y = number of actors released so far
$0C:A54D B9 2B A5     LDA.W $A52B,Y                   ; \
$0C:A550 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A551 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A552 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A553 4A           LSR                             ; } X = $A52B[Y] >> 4: which line actor to release (0-6)
$0C:A554 AA           TAX                             ; X = line actor index
$0C:A555 1A           INC A                           ; A = X + 1
$0C:A556 8D 5C 14     STA.W $145C                     ; [$145C] = X + 1: release in progress
$0C:A559 A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; \
$0C:A55B 9D 0C 0B     STA.W $0B0C,X                   ; } Y speed of actor 7+X = $C0 (launch upward)
$0C:A55E A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$0C:A560 9D FD 0A     STA.W $0AFD,X                   ; } Gravity of actor 7+X = 4
$0C:A563 BD 48 0B     LDA.W $0B48,X                   ; \
$0C:A566 8D 44 0B     STA.W $0B44                     ; |
$0C:A569 8D 45 0B     STA.W $0B45                     ; } Y positions of actors 3 and 4 = Y position of actor 7+X
$0C:A56C 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:A56D 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$0C:A56F 8D 46 0B     STA.W $0B46                     ; |
$0C:A572 8D 47 0B     STA.W $0B47                     ; } Y positions of actors 5 and 6 = that Y position + 8
$0C:A575 9C 62 0B     STZ.W $0B62                     ; \
$0C:A578 9C 63 0B     STZ.W $0B63                     ; |
$0C:A57B 9C 64 0B     STZ.W $0B64                     ; |
$0C:A57E 9C 65 0B     STZ.W $0B65                     ; } Clear Y high bytes of actors 3-6
$0C:A581 BD 57 0B     LDA.W $0B57,X                   ; \
$0C:A584 8D 53 0B     STA.W $0B53                     ; |
$0C:A587 8D 55 0B     STA.W $0B55                     ; } X positions of actors 3 and 5 = X position of actor 7+X
$0C:A58A 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:A58B 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$0C:A58D 8D 54 0B     STA.W $0B54                     ; |
$0C:A590 8D 56 0B     STA.W $0B56                     ; } X positions of actors 4 and 6 = that X position + 8
$0C:A593 9C 71 0B     STZ.W $0B71                     ; \
$0C:A596 9C 72 0B     STZ.W $0B72                     ; |
$0C:A599 9C 73 0B     STZ.W $0B73                     ; |
$0C:A59C 9C 74 0B     STZ.W $0B74                     ; } Clear X high bytes of actors 3-6
$0C:A59F B9 24 A5     LDA.W $A524,Y                   ; \
$0C:A5A2 0C 5A 14     TSB.W $145A                     ; } Set this actor's bit in the visible mask [$145A]
$0C:A5A5 EE 5B 14     INC.W $145B                     ; Next release
$0C:A5A8 AD 5B 14     LDA.W $145B                     ; \
$0C:A5AB C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; / All seven released?
$0C:A5AD F0 07        BEQ $A5B6                       ; Yes: finish
$0C:A5AF A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$0C:A5B1 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; } Sound effect $0A on $1DFC
$0C:A5B4 80 15        BRA $A5CB                       ; Go draw

$0C:A5B6 9C 70 0B     STZ.W $0B70                     ; X high byte of actor 2 = 0
$0C:A5B9 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$0C:A5BB 8D 52 0B     STA.W $0B52                     ; } X position of actor 2 = $80
$0C:A5BE 9C 16 0B     STZ.W $0B16                     ; X speed of actor 2 = 0
$0C:A5C1 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \

$0C:A5C6 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Advance scene substate to 3

$0C:A5D1 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $A5DE: Ending: eggshell fragments and Yoshi helpers ;;;
;; Code for the Yoshi egg-hatching ending scene (credits engine): scene stages 3 and 4, the fragment
;;     update/draw routine,
;; fixed-point motion helper, Mario-on-Yoshi setup. Object arrays at $0B05-$0B80: Y speed $0B05, Y subpixel
;;     $0B23, Y pos $0B41/$0B5F,
;; X speed $0B14, X subpixel $0B32, X pos $0B50/$0B6E (X-direction entries are the Y entries + $0F).
;; Slots 3-6 are four flying fragments (probably eggshell pieces); slots 7-13 are the seven eggs / hatched
;;     Yoshis.
;; Stage dispatch is by [$1442] (PtrsLong0CA1DE). Interpretation of the scene is partly guessed.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:A5CB: Substate 2: release the seven actors
$0C:A5DE AD 5C 14     LDA.W $145C                     ; \
$0C:A5E1 F0 77        BEQ $A65A                       ; } Return if the shell effect is inactive ([$145C] = 0)
$0C:A5E3 A2 06        LDX.B #$06                      ; X = 6: loop over the four fragments, X = 6..3
$0C:A5E5 BD 05 0B     LDA.W $0B05,X                   ; \
$0C:A5E8 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A5E9 69 06        ADC.B #$06                      ; |
$0C:A5EB C9 70        CMP.B #$70                      ; |
$0C:A5ED F0 03        BEQ $A5F2                       ; } Fall speed [$0B05+X] += 6, but not stored if it would reach $70 (terminal speed)
$0C:A5EF 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X                   ; /
$0C:A5F2 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:A5F3 38           SEC                             ; |
$0C:A5F4 E9 03        SBC.B #$03                      ; } Y = X - 3: fragment number 0-3
$0C:A5F6 A8           TAY                             ; /
$0C:A5F7 B9 DA A5     LDA.W $A5DA,Y                   ; \
$0C:A5FA 9D 14 0B     STA.W $0B14,X                   ; } X speed of fragment = [DATA_0CA5DA+Y] ($E8, $18, $F4, $0C)
$0C:A5FD 20 21 A7     JSR.W $A721                     ; Apply Y speed to fragment Y position
$0C:A600 20 4F A7     JSR.W $A74F                     ; Apply X speed to fragment X position
$0C:A603 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0C:A604 E0 02        CPX.B #$02                      ; } Next fragment until X = 2
$0C:A606 D0 DD        BNE $A5E5                       ; /
$0C:A608 AD 44 0B     LDA.W $0B44                     ; \
$0C:A60B 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$0C:A60D C9 F0        CMP.B #$F0                      ; |
$0C:A60F D0 03        BNE $A614                       ; } If fragment 0 (slot 3) Y position is $F0+ (fell off screen), end the effect: [$145C] = 0
$0C:A611 9C 5C 14     STZ.W $145C                     ; /
$0C:A614 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: OAM offset
$0C:A616 A0 06        LDY.B #$06                      ; Y = 6: draw loop over fragments Y = 6..3
$0C:A618 B9 6E 0B     LDA.W $0B6E,Y                   ; \
$0C:A61B D0 38        BNE $A655                       ; } Skip fragments whose X high byte is nonzero (off screen)
$0C:A61D B9 5F 0B     LDA.W $0B5F,Y                   ; \
$0C:A620 D0 33        BNE $A655                       ; } Skip fragments whose Y high byte is nonzero
$0C:A622 B9 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,Y                   ; \
$0C:A625 C9 F0        CMP.B #$F0                      ; } Skip fragments whose Y position is $F0 or more
$0C:A627 B0 2C        BCS $A655                       ; /
$0C:A629 B9 50 0B     LDA.W $0B50,Y                   ; \
$0C:A62C 9D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,X       ; } OAM X = fragment X position
$0C:A62F B9 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,Y                   ; \
$0C:A632 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; } OAM Y = fragment Y position
$0C:A635 5A           PHY                             ; \
$0C:A636 98           TYA                             ; |
$0C:A637 38           SEC                             ; |
$0C:A638 E9 03        SBC.B #$03                      ; } Y = Y - 3: fragment number 0-3 (index preserved on the stack)
$0C:A63A A8           TAY                             ; /
$0C:A63B B9 D2 A5     LDA.W $A5D2,Y                   ; \
$0C:A63E 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; } OAM tile = [DATA_0CA5D2+Y] ($C8, $C8, $D8, $D8)
$0C:A641 B9 D6 A5     LDA.W $A5D6,Y                   ; \
$0C:A644 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; } OAM property = [DATA_0CA5D6+Y]: palette 3, X-flip on odd fragments
$0C:A647 7A           PLY                             ; Restore fragment index
$0C:A648 DA           PHX                             ; \
$0C:A649 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:A64A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A64B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A64C AA           TAX                             ; |
$0C:A64D 9E 20 04     STZ.W $0420,X                   ; } High OAM table entry = 0: small tile, X bit 8 clear
$0C:A650 FA           PLX                             ; /
$0C:A651 E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:A652 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:A653 E8           INX                             ; } OAM offset += 4
$0C:A654 E8           INX                             ; /
$0C:A655 88           DEY                             ; \
$0C:A656 C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; } Next fragment until Y = 2
$0C:A658 D0 BE        BNE $A618                       ; /
$0C:A65A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:A65B A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; Scene stage 3: object 2 (X = 2) runs off to the left
$0C:A65D BD 14 0B     LDA.W $0B14,X                   ; \
$0C:A660 38           SEC                             ; |
$0C:A661 E9 04        SBC.B #$04                      ; } X speed [$0B14+X] -= 4 (accelerate leftwards)
$0C:A663 9D 14 0B     STA.W $0B14,X                   ; /
$0C:A666 20 4F A7     JSR.W $A74F                     ; Apply X speed to object X position
$0C:A669 BD 50 0B     LDA.W $0B50,X                   ; \
$0C:A66C C9 F8        CMP.B #$F8                      ; } If X position < $F8 keep it, else it has left the screen:
$0C:A66E 90 0A        BCC $A67A                       ; /
$0C:A670 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; [$1442] += 1: advance to the next scene stage
$0C:A673 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$0C:A675 8D 5D 14     STA.W $145D                     ; } [$145D] = $F0: delay timer before the next stage
$0C:A678 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0: draw the picture at X position 0
$0C:A67A 85 00        STA $00                         ; \
$0C:A67C 85 02        STA $02                         ; } Picture column X positions $00, $02, $04 = object X position

$0C:A680 64 01        STZ $01                         ; \
$0C:A682 64 03        STZ $03                         ; } Clear their high bytes ($01, $03, $05)
$0C:A684 64 05        STZ $05                         ; /
$0C:A686 A9 3F        LDA.B #$3F                      ; \

$0C:A68C A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: first tile of the picture

$0C:A690 20 59 A1     JSR.W $A159                     ; Draw the large-tile picture at the object position
$0C:A693 CE 59 14     DEC.W $1459                     ; \

$0C:A698 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$0C:A69A 8D 59 14     STA.W $1459                     ; } Reload [$1459] = 6
$0C:A69D CE 58 14     DEC.W $1458                     ; [$1458] -= 1: scene animation phase
$0C:A6A0 AD 58 14     LDA.W $1458                     ; \
$0C:A6A3 C9 07        CMP.B #$07                      ; |
$0C:A6A5 D0 05        BNE $A6AC                       ; |
$0C:A6A7 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; } When [$1458] reaches 7 it is forced back to 8 (floor at 8)
$0C:A6A9 8D 58 14     STA.W $1458                     ; /
$0C:A6AC 20 78 A4     JSR.W $A478                     ; Draw the scene characters for phase [$1458]
$0C:A6AF 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:A6B0 20 46 A1     JSR.W $A146                     ; Scene stage 4: final pose, Mario on Yoshi waving
$0C:A6B3 20 15 A3     JSR.W $A315                     ; Scene helper ($A315)
$0C:A6B6 20 FC A2     JSR.W $A2FC                     ; Scene helper ($A2FC)
$0C:A6B9 A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; \
$0C:A6BB 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; |

$0C:A6BF 85 97        STA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; /

$0C:A6D2 B9 11 A3     LDA.W $A311,Y                   ; |

$0C:A6D6 A8           TAY                             ; /

$0C:A6DB AD 42 0B     LDA.W $0B42                     ; } $00 = Yoshi sprite X low, $02 = [$0B42] (probably the tall sprite Y)
$0C:A6DE 85 02        STA $02                         ; /

$0C:A6E2 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
