;;; $A821: Draw 32x32 sprite from 16x16 tiles ;;;
;; Draws 2 rows of 2 large tiles (32x32 total) into OAM, using the tile and property tables at
;;     $0CA7B9/$0CA7ED.
;; Parameters: X: OAM offset, Y: frame index (4 bytes per frame), $00/$01: X position, $02: Y position.
;; Skips drawing if the X high byte is nonzero. Y >= $28 selects the upper OAM block (offset + $100).
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:A031: Draw Mario and Yoshi in the credits
;;     $0C:A249: Scene substate table and substate 0 (PtrsLong0CA1DE)
;;     $0C:A2C0: Scene substate table and substate 0 (PtrsLong0CA1DE)
;;     $0C:A37A: Update hopping character and draw trio
;;     $0C:A396: Update hopping character and draw trio
;;     $0C:A496: Substate 1: landing pose animation
;;     $0C:A4B0: Substate 1: landing pose animation
;;     $0C:A70D: Ending: eggshell fragments and Yoshi helpers
$0C:A821 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; \
$0C:A823 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:A824 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } X = X & $FF (OAM offset)
$0C:A827 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0C:A828 98           TYA                             ; \
$0C:A829 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$0C:A82C C9 28 00     CMP.W #$0028                    ; |
$0C:A82F 90 05        BCC $A836                       ; |
$0C:A831 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:A832 09 00 01     ORA.W #$0100                    ; } If frame index [Y] >= $28, use the upper OAM block: X |= $100
$0C:A835 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0C:A836 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; 8-bit accumulator
$0C:A838 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0C:A83A 85 04        STA $04                         ; } $04 = 1: draw two rows
$0C:A83C A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$0C:A83E D0 60        BNE $A8A0                       ; } Skip if X high byte [$01] is nonzero (off screen)
$0C:A840 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0C:A842 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; } $0A = 2: large size, X bit 8 clear
$0C:A844 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:A846 9D 04 02     STA.W $0204,X                   ; } Second tile X = [$00]
$0C:A849 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:A84A 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } First tile X = [$00] + 8
$0C:A84C 9D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,X       ; /
$0C:A84F 90 04        BCC $A855                       ; \
$0C:A851 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; } If the X add carried: $0A = 1 (X bit 8 set for the first tile)
$0C:A853 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; /
$0C:A855 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$0C:A857 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; } Both tiles Y = [$02]
$0C:A85A 9D 05 02     STA.W $0205,X                   ; /
$0C:A85D B9 B9 A7     LDA.W $A7B9,Y                   ; \
$0C:A860 9D 06 02     STA.W $0206,X                   ; } Second tile number = [DATA_0CA7B9+Y]
$0C:A863 B9 BA A7     LDA.W $A7BA,Y                   ; \
$0C:A866 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; } First tile number = [DATA_0CA7BA+Y]
$0C:A869 B9 ED A7     LDA.W $A7ED,Y                   ; \
$0C:A86C 9D 07 02     STA.W $0207,X                   ; } Second tile property = [DATA_0CA7ED+Y]
$0C:A86F B9 EE A7     LDA.W $A7EE,Y                   ; \
$0C:A872 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; } First tile property = [DATA_0CA7EE+Y]
$0C:A875 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$0C:A877 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A878 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } $02 += $10: next row
$0C:A87A 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$0C:A87C DA           PHX                             ; Save OAM offset
$0C:A87D C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$0C:A87F 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:A880 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A881 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A882 AA           TAX                             ; } X = OAM offset / 4: index into the high OAM table
$0C:A883 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; /
$0C:A885 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0C:A887 9D 21 04     STA.W $0421,X                   ; } Second tile: large size
$0C:A88A A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$0C:A88C 9D 20 04     STA.W $0420,X                   ; } First tile: high bits = [$0A]
$0C:A88F FA           PLX                             ; Restore OAM offset
$0C:A890 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$0C:A892 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:A893 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A894 69 08 00     ADC.W #$0008                    ; |
$0C:A897 AA           TAX                             ; } OAM offset += 8: next two tiles
$0C:A898 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; /

$0C:A89B C8           INY                             ; } Y += 2: next table entries
$0C:A89C C6 04        DEC $04                         ; \
$0C:A89E 10 9C        BPL $A83C                       ; } Repeat for the second row
$0C:A8A0 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; 8-bit A and index

$0C:A8A3 A2 0D        LDX.B #$0D                      ; X = $0D: loop over seven hatched Yoshis, X = $0D..7
$0C:A8A5 BD 05 0B     LDA.W $0B05,X                   ; \
$0C:A8A8 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A8A9 7D F6 0A     ADC.W $0AF6,X                   ; } Y speed [$0B05+X] += gravity [$0AF6+X]
$0C:A8AC 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X                   ; /
$0C:A8AF 20 21 A7     JSR.W $A721                     ; Apply Y speed to Y position
$0C:A8B2 BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X                   ; \
$0C:A8B5 C5 0E        CMP $0E                         ; } If Y position >= floor [$0E]: bounce
$0C:A8B7 90 12        BCC $A8CB                       ; /
$0C:A8B9 9E 23 0B     STZ.W $0B23,X                   ; Clear Y subpixel
$0C:A8BC A9 F6        LDA.B #$F6                      ; \
$0C:A8BE 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X                   ; } Bounce speed = $F6 (upward)
$0C:A8C1 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0C:A8C3 9D F6 0A     STA.W $0AF6,X                   ; } Gravity = 1
$0C:A8C6 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; \
$0C:A8C8 9D 41 0B     STA.W $0B41,X                   ; } Y position = floor
$0C:A8CB CA           DEX                             ; \
$0C:A8CC E0 06        CPX.B #$06                      ; } Next Yoshi until X = 6
$0C:A8CE D0 D5        BNE $A8A5                       ; /
$0C:A8D0 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $A8D1..A8D8: Table: hatched Yoshi properties ;;;
;; $0CA8D1: seven bytes $00-$60, no reference found (unused?). $0CA8D8: OAM properties (palette/flip) for the

;;; $A8DF: Draw eggs and hatched Yoshis ;;;
;; Walks slots $0D..7. For each on-screen slot writes an OAM entry at [$02]: tile $86 for unhatched (bit in
;;     [$145A] clear),
;; tile $EA with a per-slot property from $A8D8 once hatched. Reads positions from $0B50/$0B41. Large
;;     (16x16) tiles.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:A03F: Draw Mario and Yoshi in the credits
;;     $0C:A309: Scene substate table and substate 0 (PtrsLong0CA1DE)
$0C:A8DF AD 5A 14     LDA.W $145A                     ; \
$0C:A8E2 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; } $0E = hatched-egg bit mask [$145A]
$0C:A8E4 A0 0D        LDY.B #$0D                      ; Y = $0D: loop over the seven slots, Y = $0D..7
$0C:A8E6 B9 6E 0B     LDA.W $0B6E,Y                   ; \
$0C:A8E9 D0 49        BNE $A934                       ; } Skip slots whose X high byte is nonzero
$0C:A8EB B9 50 0B     LDA.W $0B50,Y                   ; \
$0C:A8EE 85 00        STA $00                         ; } $00 = slot X position
$0C:A8F0 B9 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,Y                   ; \
$0C:A8F3 85 01        STA $01                         ; } $01 = slot Y position
$0C:A8F5 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; X = OAM offset [$02]
$0C:A8F7 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:A8F9 9D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,X       ; } OAM X = slot X position
$0C:A8FC A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$0C:A8FE 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; } OAM Y = slot Y position
$0C:A901 46 0E        LSR $0E                         ; \
$0C:A903 B0 0C        BCS $A911                       ; } Next hatch bit; carry set = this slot has hatched
$0C:A905 A9 86        LDA.B #$86                      ; \
$0C:A907 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; |
$0C:A90A A9 21        LDA.B #$21                      ; } Unhatched: tile $86, property $21 (egg)
$0C:A90C 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; /
$0C:A90F 80 12        BRA $A923                       ; Continue to size setup

$0C:A911 5A           PHY                             ; Save slot index
$0C:A912 98           TYA                             ; \
$0C:A913 38           SEC                             ; |
$0C:A914 E9 07        SBC.B #$07                      ; } Y = Y - 7: slot number 0-6
$0C:A916 A8           TAY                             ; /
$0C:A917 A9 EA        LDA.B #$EA                      ; \
$0C:A919 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; |
$0C:A91C B9 D8 A8     LDA.W $A8D8,Y                   ; } Hatched: tile $EA, property = [DATA_0CA8D8+Y] (per-slot palette)
$0C:A91F 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; /
$0C:A922 7A           PLY                             ; Restore slot index
$0C:A923 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:A924 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A925 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A926 AA           TAX                             ; |
$0C:A927 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; } High OAM table entry = 2: large tile
$0C:A929 9D 20 04     STA.W $0420,X                   ; /
$0C:A92C E6 02        INC $02                         ; \
$0C:A92E E6 02        INC $02                         ; |
$0C:A930 E6 02        INC $02                         ; } OAM offset [$02] += 4
$0C:A932 E6 02        INC $02                         ; /
$0C:A934 88           DEY                             ; \
$0C:A935 C0 06        CPY.B #$06                      ; } Next slot until Y = 6
$0C:A937 D0 AD        BNE $A8E6                       ; /
$0C:A939 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:A9A5 A8           TAY                             ; /

$0C:A9B9 9D 04 02     STA.W $0204,X                   ; /

$0C:A9C2 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; /
$0C:A9C5 B9 83 A9     LDA.W $A983,Y                   ; \
$0C:A9C8 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:A9C9 65 02        ADC $02                         ; } OAM Y (tile 2) = Y offset [DATA_0CA983+Y] + [$02]
$0C:A9CB 9D 05 02     STA.W $0205,X                   ; /
$0C:A9CE B9 3A A9     LDA.W $A93A,Y                   ; \
$0C:A9D1 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; } Tile 1 number = [DATA_0CA93A+Y]
$0C:A9D4 B9 3B A9     LDA.W $A93B,Y                   ; \
$0C:A9D7 9D 06 02     STA.W $0206,X                   ; } Tile 2 number = [DATA_0CA93B+Y]
$0C:A9DA B9 52 A9     LDA.W $A952,Y                   ; \

$0C:A9E0 B9 53 A9     LDA.W $A953,Y                   ; \
$0C:A9E3 9D 07 02     STA.W $0207,X                   ; } Tile 2 property = [DATA_0CA953+Y]
$0C:A9E6 5A           PHY                             ; Save frame index
$0C:A9E7 DA           PHX                             ; \
$0C:A9E8 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:A9E9 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:A9EA 4A           LSR                             ; } X = OAM offset / 4
$0C:A9EB AA           TAX                             ; /
$0C:A9EC A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; \

$0C:A9F0 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; |

$0C:A9FA 9D 21 04     STA.W $0421,X                   ; /

$0C:A9FE 7A           PLY                             ; Restore frame index

$0C:AA01 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } OAM offset += 8
$0C:AA03 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0C:AA04 C8           INY                             ; \
$0C:AA05 C8           INY                             ; } Y += 2 table entries
$0C:AA06 C6 04        DEC $04                         ; \

$0C:AA2C 9D 04 02     STA.W $0204,X                   ; /

$0C:AA40 B9 0C AA     LDA.W $AA0C,Y                   ; \
$0C:AA43 9D 06 02     STA.W $0206,X                   ; } Bottom tile number = [DATA_0CAA0C+Y]

;;; $AADF: Draw static 35-sprite picture; screen wipe ;;;
;; $AADF (JSL from the credits-screen setup at $00967F) copies the 35 records into OAM as large sprites.
;; $AB13 is a JSL wrapper for $AB1F, the screen wipe: it steps [$1B89] by 2 toward $0 or $E0,
;;     advances the scene
;; phase [$1928] and loads its palette when the wipe ends, and builds a per-scanline window table at $04A0 for
;;     HDMA channel 7.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:967F: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)

$0C:AAE0 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = program bank
$0C:AAE1 AB           PLB                             ; /
$0C:AAE2 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: OAM offset
$0C:AAE4 9B           TXY                             ; Y = 0: offset into the sprite records
$0C:AAE5 B9 53 AA     LDA.W $AA53,Y                   ; \
$0C:AAE8 9D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,X       ; } OAM X = record X
$0C:AAEB B9 54 AA     LDA.W $AA54,Y                   ; \
$0C:AAEE 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; } OAM Y = record Y
$0C:AAF1 B9 55 AA     LDA.W $AA55,Y                   ; \
$0C:AAF4 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; } OAM tile = record tile
$0C:AAF7 B9 56 AA     LDA.W $AA56,Y                   ; \
$0C:AAFA 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; } OAM property = record property
$0C:AAFD DA           PHX                             ; \
$0C:AAFE 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:AAFF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:AB00 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:AB01 AA           TAX                             ; |
$0C:AB02 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$0C:AB04 9D 20 04     STA.W $0420,X                   ; } High OAM entry = 2 (large tile)
$0C:AB07 FA           PLX                             ; /
$0C:AB08 E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:AB09 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:AB0A E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:AB0B E8           INX                             ; } Next record: OAM offset and record offset += 4
$0C:AB0C 9B           TXY                             ; /
$0C:AB0D C0 8C        CPY.B #$8C                      ; \
$0C:AB0F D0 D4        BNE $AAE5                       ; } Repeat until $8C bytes (35 sprites) are done
$0C:AB11 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$0C:AB12 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$0C:AB13 8B           PHB                             ; \
$0C:AB14 4B           PHK                             ; |
$0C:AB15 AB           PLB                             ; |
$0C:AB16 20 1F AB     JSR.W $AB1F                     ; } Wrapper: run the wipe update with the data bank set
$0C:AB19 AB           PLB                             ; /
$0C:AB1A 6B           RTL                             ; Return



;;; $AB1B..AB1D: Table: wipe step and end values ;;;
;; $0CAB1B: step -2 / +2. $0CAB1D: end values $00 / $E0.
$0C:AB1B              .db $FE,$02                     ; Wipe speed per frame: -2 (closing) / +2 (opening)

$0C:AB1D              .db $00,$E0                     ; Wipe end values: $00 / $E0


;;; $AB1F: Screen wipe update (window HDMA) ;;;
;; Updates [$1B89] (wipe size) by [DATA_0CAB1B+X], rebuilds the window HDMA tables ($04A0/$057E, 112 lines
;;     each half).
;; On reaching $E0 it flips the direction, advances [$1928] and loads the next palette ($ABB2); phase >=
;;     6 advances the game mode.
;; Parameters: X: [$1B88] direction, Y: [$1928] scene phase. Writes $41, $43, $44, $212E/$212F, $0D9F (HDMA
;;     channel 7).
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:9395: Ending mode entry points
;;     $0C:A1D4: Draw banner; dispatch scene substate
;;     $0C:AB16: Draw static 35-sprite picture; screen wipe
$0C:AB1F AE 88 1B     LDX.W $1B88                     ; X = [$1B88] wipe direction (1 = grow toward $E0, 0 = shrink to 0)
$0C:AB22 A9 33        LDA.B #$33                      ; \
$0C:AB24 85 41        STA $41                         ; } $41 = $33: window mask for BG1/BG2 (window 1 enabled, inverted)
$0C:AB26 AC 28 19     LDY.W $1928                     ; Y = [$1928]: scene phase
$0C:AB29 D0 04        BNE $AB2F                       ; \
$0C:AB2B E0 00        CPX.B #$00                      ; } Phase 0 with direction 0 keeps $43 = $33
$0C:AB2D F0 0C        BEQ $AB3B                       ; /
$0C:AB2F C0 06        CPY.B #$06                      ; \
$0C:AB31 90 06        BCC $AB39                       ; |
$0C:AB33 D0 06        BNE $AB3B                       ; |
$0C:AB35 E0 00        CPX.B #$00                      ; |
$0C:AB37 D0 02        BNE $AB3B                       ; } Phases 1-5 (or 6 with direction 0): $43 = $30
$0C:AB39 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; /
$0C:AB3B 85 43        STA $43                         ; Window mask for sprites/color [$43]
$0C:AB3D AD 89 1B     LDA.W $1B89                     ; \
$0C:AB40 DD 1D AB     CMP.W $AB1D,X                   ; } A = wipe size [$1B89]; compare with the end value for this direction
$0C:AB43 D0 1F        BNE $AB64                       ; Not at the end value yet: keep stepping
$0C:AB45 E0 00        CPX.B #$00                      ; \
$0C:AB47 F0 22        BEQ $AB6B                       ; } If direction is 0 (closed already) skip to table build
$0C:AB49 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; \
$0C:AB4B 8E 88 1B     STX.W $1B88                     ; } Opening finished: direction = 0
$0C:AB4E C0 06        CPY.B #$06                      ; \
$0C:AB50 90 05        BCC $AB57                       ; } If phase >= 6, move on to the next game mode
$0C:AB52 EE 00 01     INC.W RAM_GameMode              ; /
$0C:AB55 80 14        BRA $AB6B                       ; Return to table build

$0C:AB57 48           PHA                             ; \
$0C:AB58 DA           PHX                             ; } Save size and direction
$0C:AB59 EE FE 1F     INC.W $1FFE                     ; [$1FFE] += 1: request a palette reload
$0C:AB5C EE 28 19     INC.W $1928                     ; [$1928] += 1: next scene phase
$0C:AB5F 20 B2 AB     JSR.W $ABB2                     ; Load the new phase's palette
$0C:AB62 FA           PLX                             ; \
$0C:AB63 68           PLA                             ; } Restore direction and size
$0C:AB64 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:AB65 7D 1B AB     ADC.W $AB1B,X                   ; } [$1B89] += step [DATA_0CAB1B+X]
$0C:AB68 8D 89 1B     STA.W $1B89                     ; /
$0C:AB6B C2 20        REP #$20                        ; 16-bit A: build the window HDMA tables
$0C:AB6D A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; \
$0C:AB6F A0 E0        LDY.B #$E0                      ; } X = 0, Y = $E0
$0C:AB71 A9 FF 00     LDA.W #$00FF                    ; A = $00FF: empty window on this line
$0C:AB74 EC 89 1B     CPX.W $1B89                     ; \
$0C:AB77 90 03        BCC $AB7C                       ; } A = $FF00 (full window) once X >= [$1B89]
$0C:AB79 A9 00 FF     LDA.W #$FF00                    ; /
$0C:AB7C 9D A0 04     STA.W $04A0,X                   ; Top half scanline entry at $04A0+X
$0C:AB7F 99 7E 05     STA.W $057E,Y                   ; Bottom half scanline entry at $057E+Y (mirrored)
$0C:AB82 E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:AB83 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:AB84 88           DEY                             ; } X += 2, Y -= 2
$0C:AB85 88           DEY                             ; /
$0C:AB86 D0 EC        BNE $AB74                       ; Loop for 112 lines
$0C:AB88 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; 8-bit A
$0C:AB8A A9 13        LDA.B #$13                      ; \
$0C:AB8C 8D 2E 21     STA.W $212E                     ; } Window mask main and sub screen = $13 (BG1, BG2, OBJ)
$0C:AB8F 8D 2F 21     STA.W $212F                     ; /
$0C:AB92 A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; \
$0C:AB94 85 44        STA $44                         ; } [$44] = $22 (color math window control mirror, probably)
$0C:AB96 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$0C:AB98 8D 9F 0D     STA.W $0D9F                     ; } Enable HDMA channel 7 (window table)
$0C:AB9B 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $AB9C..ABAB: Table: palette selection per scene phase ;;;
;; $0CAB9C: palette block offsets. $0CABA4: backdrop color index per phase. $0CABAB: block number per phase.
$0C:AB9C              .db $00,$18,$30,$48,$60,$78,$90,$A8 ; Palette block offsets (24 bytes each) from $00:B0B0
$0C:ABA4              .db $06,$00,$00,$02,$05,$06,$00 ; Per-phase backdrop color index into $00:B0A0 (7 phases)

$0C:ABAB              .db $03,$03,$07,$00,$01,$02,$00 ; Per-phase palette block number (7 phases)


;;; $ABB2: Load scene phase palette ;;;
;; Builds two palette-upload entries at $0682/$0690 (length $0C, CGRAM $02/$12, six colors each) from
;;     $00:B0B0+block, and
;; sets color 0 in the palette buffer ($0701) from $00:B0A0. Parameters: [$1928]: scene phase.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:AB5F: Screen wipe update (window HDMA)
$0C:ABB2 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; 8-bit A and index
$0C:ABB4 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$0C:ABB6 8D 82 06     STA.W $0682                     ; |
$0C:ABB9 8D 90 06     STA.W $0690                     ; \
$0C:ABBC A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; } Palette upload entry 1: length $0C, CGRAM address $02
$0C:ABBE 8D 83 06     STA.W $0683                     ; /
$0C:ABC1 A9 12        LDA.B #$12                      ; |
$0C:ABC3 8D 91 06     STA.W $0691                     ; } Palette upload entry 2: length $0C, CGRAM address $12
$0C:ABC6 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; /
$0C:ABC8 AD 28 19     LDA.W $1928                     ; Y = [$1928] phase
$0C:ABCB 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; ...
$0C:ABCE A8           TAY                             ; Y = phase
$0C:ABCF B9 A4 AB     LDA.W $ABA4,Y                   ; \
$0C:ABD2 29 0F 00     AND.W #$000F                    ; |
$0C:ABD5 0A           ASL                             ; } X = ([DATA_0CABA4+Y] & $F) * 2
$0C:ABD6 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0C:ABD7 BF A0 B0 00  LDA.L Palettes?,X               ; A = backdrop color word from $00:B0A0
$0C:ABDB 8D 01 07     STA.W $0701                     ; Palette buffer color word [$0701]
$0C:ABDE A9 B0 B0     LDA.W #$B0B0                    ; \
$0C:ABE1 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0C:ABE3 B9 AB AB     LDA.W $ABAB,Y                   ; |
$0C:ABE6 29 0F 00     AND.W #$000F                    ; |
$0C:ABE9 AA           TAX                             ; |
$0C:ABEA BD 9C AB     LDA.W $AB9C,X                   ; |
$0C:ABED 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$0C:ABF0 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:ABF1 65 00        ADC $00                         ; } $00 = $B0B0 + [DATA_0CAB9C+[DATA_0CABAB+Y]]: source palette block
$0C:ABF3 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0C:ABF5 64 02        STZ $02                         ; $02 = 0: source bank 0
$0C:ABF7 A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; \
$0C:ABFA 85 04        STA $04                         ; } $04 = 0: buffer offset
$0C:ABFC A9 01 00     LDA.W #$0001                    ; \
$0C:ABFF 85 08        STA $08                         ; } $08 = 1: two blocks
$0C:AC01 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = buffer offset
$0C:AC03 A0 05 00     LDY.W #$0005                    ; Y = 5: six colors per block
$0C:AC06 A7 00        LDA [$00]                       ; \
$0C:AC08 9D 84 06     STA.W $0684,X                   ; } Copy a color word [[$00]] into $0684+X
$0C:AC0B E6 00        INC $00                         ; \
$0C:AC0D E6 00        INC $00                         ; |
$0C:AC0F E8           INX                             ; } Source += 2, destination += 2
$0C:AC10 E8           INX                             ; /
$0C:AC11 88           DEY                             ; \
$0C:AC12 10 F2        BPL $AC06                       ; } Next color until Y < 0
$0C:AC14 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$0C:AC16 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:AC17 69 0E 00     ADC.W #$000E                    ; } Next block: $04 += $0E
$0C:AC1A 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$0C:AC1C C6 08        DEC $08                         ; \
$0C:AC1E 10 E1        BPL $AC01                       ; } Repeat for the second block
$0C:AC20 A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; \
$0C:AC23 9D 84 06     STA.W $0684,X                   ; } Terminate the upload table with 0
$0C:AC26 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; 8-bit A and index
$0C:AC28 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $AD8C: Set credits scene layer data pointers ;;;
;; Increments the scene number [$1DE9], then sets the layer 1 pointer $65-$67 (bank $0C) and layer 2 pointer
;;     $68-$6A.
;; Layer 2 bank byte is $FF except for scene 12 ($0C). Called from the credits setup at $0095CA.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:95CA: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
$0C:AD8C 8B           PHB                             ; \
$0C:AD8D 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = program bank
$0C:AD8E AB           PLB                             ; /
$0C:AD8F EE E9 1D     INC.W $1DE9                     ; Credits scene number [$1DE9] += 1
$0C:AD92 A2 FF        LDX.B #$FF                      ; X = $FF: layer 2 bank byte for scenes 0-11
$0C:AD94 AD E9 1D     LDA.W $1DE9                     ; \
$0C:AD97 C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; |
$0C:AD99 D0 02        BNE $AD9D                       ; } Scene 12 ($0C): layer 2 bank byte X = $0C
$0C:AD9B A2 0C        LDX.B #$0C                      ; /
$0C:AD9D 0A           ASL                             ; Y = scene * 2
$0C:AD9E A8           TAY 
$0C:AD9F A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$0C:ADA1 85 67        STA $67                         ; } $67 = $0C: layer 1 data bank
$0C:ADA3 86 6A        STX $6A                         ; $6A = layer 2 data bank
$0C:ADA5 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; 16-bit A
$0C:ADA7 B9 58 AD     LDA.W $AD58,Y                   ; \
$0C:ADAA 85 65        STA $65                         ; } $65/$66 = layer 1 pointer [DATA_0CAD58+Y]
$0C:ADAC B9 72 AD     LDA.W $AD72,Y                   ; \
$0C:ADAF 85 68        STA $68                         ; } $68/$69 = layer 2 pointer [DATA_0CAD72+Y]
$0C:ADB1 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; 8-bit A
$0C:ADB3 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$0C:ADB4 6B           RTL                             ; Return

;;; $ADF6: Ending enemy scene: set up and slide layers ;;;
;; Two routines for the ending enemy parade ([$1DE9] = scene 0 Lakitu ... 12 Bowser). $0CADF6 (JSL from game
;;     mode $23) uploads the scene's enemy-name screen image
;; (ImagePointers entry 72 + scene), appends an extra image when [$1EEB] bit 7 is set (post-Special World
;;     flag), sets the window HDMA band split
;; ($04A0/$04AA/$04B4 entries 2 and 3 = $ADB5[scene] and $88 minus that) and Layer 2 Y from $ADC2,
;;     starts the layers off-screen and sets [$145B] = $FF hold time.
;; $0CAEAD (JSR from $93A5, game mode $25) runs each frame: Layer 1/3 move right 2 px, the opposite-
;;     moving mirror ($1462/$146A) left 2 px, Layer 2 at 1 px; they pause
;; for [$145B] frames when they meet at 0, then slide out; then the game mode advances ($26 for Bowser, else
;;     $22 to fade to the next enemy). Bowser (scene 12) does not slide, it just waits. Ends by jumping to
;;     $B5BC.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:95F6: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
$0C:ADF6 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$0C:ADF7 4B           PHK                             ; \
$0C:ADF8 AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = program bank ($0C)
$0C:ADF9 AD E9 1D     LDA.W $1DE9                     ; A = [$1DE9]: ending enemy scene (0 = Lakitu ... 12 = Bowser)
$0C:ADFC A8           TAY                             ; Y = scene
$0C:ADFD 0A           ASL                             ; \
$0C:ADFE AA           TAX                             ; / X = scene * 2 (index into the word tables)
$0C:ADFF 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:AE00 6D E9 1D     ADC.W $1DE9                     ; |
$0C:AE03 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:AE04 69 D8        ADC.B #$D8                      ; |
$0C:AE06 85 12        STA $12                         ; / [$12] = scene * 3 + $D8: ImagePointers entry 72 + scene (the enemy name screen image)
$0C:AE08 5A           PHY                             ; Save scene
$0C:AE09 DA           PHX                             ; Save scene * 2
$0C:AE0A 22 C8 84 00  JSL.L $84C8                     ; Upload screen image [$12] to VRAM (LoadScrnImage)
$0C:AE0E AD EB 1E     LDA.W $1EEB                     ; A = [$1EEB]
$0C:AE11 10 35        BPL $AE48                       ; Bit 7 clear (Special World not completed): skip the extra image
$0C:AE13 AD E9 1D     LDA.W $1DE9                     ; \
$0C:AE16 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:AE17 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = scene * 2
$0C:AE18 B9 DC AD     LDA.W $ADDC,Y                   ; A = pointer low byte (word table $ADDC, one entry per scene)
$0C:AE1B 8D 00 00     STA.W $0000                     ; [$00] = pointer low
$0C:AE1E B9 DD AD     LDA.W $ADDD,Y                   ; A = pointer high byte
$0C:AE21 8D 01 00     STA.W $0001                     ; [$01] = pointer high
$0C:AE24 A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; \
$0C:AE26 8D 02 00     STA.W $0002                     ; / [$02] = bank $0D: [$00] points at an extra screen image in bank $0D
$0C:AE29 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: source index
$0C:AE2B AF 7B 83 7F  LDA.L $7F837B                   ; A = current length of the screen image buffer
$0C:AE2F AA           TAX                             ; X = write index into the buffer at $7F837D
$0C:AE30 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$0C:AE32 B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; \
$0C:AE34 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; |
$0C:AE38 C8           INY                             ; |
$0C:AE39 C8           INY                             ; |
$0C:AE3A E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:AE3B E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:AE3C C9 FF FF     CMP.W #$FFFF                    ; |
$0C:AE3F D0 EF        BNE $AE30                       ; / Copy the extra image onto the end of the buffer, word by word, up to a $FFFF word
$0C:AE41 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:AE42 8F 7B 83 7F  STA.L $7F837B                   ; / Store the new buffer length
$0C:AE46 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$0C:AE48 FA           PLX                             ; X = scene * 2
$0C:AE49 7A           PLY                             ; Y = scene
$0C:AE4A B9 B5 AD     LDA.W $ADB5,Y                   ; A = scanline count of the first window band for this scene ($ADB5)
$0C:AE4D 8D A3 04     STA.W $04A3                     ; Window HDMA table 1 ($04A0): scanline count of entry 2
$0C:AE50 8D AD 04     STA.W $04AD                     ; Window HDMA table 2 ($04AA): scanline count of entry 2
$0C:AE53 8D B7 04     STA.W $04B7                     ; Window HDMA table 3 ($04B4): scanline count of entry 2
$0C:AE56 A9 88        LDA.B #$88                      ; \
$0C:AE58 38           SEC                             ; |
$0C:AE59 F9 B5 AD     SBC.W $ADB5,Y                   ; / A = $88 - first band = remaining scanlines of the window area
$0C:AE5C 8D A6 04     STA.W $04A6                     ; Window HDMA table 1: scanline count of entry 3
$0C:AE5F 8D B0 04     STA.W $04B0                     ; Window HDMA table 2: scanline count of entry 3
$0C:AE62 8D BA 04     STA.W $04BA                     ; Window HDMA table 3: scanline count of entry 3
$0C:AE65 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$0C:AE67 BD C2 AD     LDA.W $ADC2,X                   ; A = Layer 2 Y position for this scene (word table $ADC2)
$0C:AE6A 85 20        STA $20                         ; [$20] = Layer 2 Y position
$0C:AE6C AD E9 1D     LDA.W $1DE9                     ; \
$0C:AE6F 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$0C:AE72 C9 0C 00     CMP.W #$000C                    ; / Is the scene $0C (Bowser)?
$0C:AE75 D0 11        BNE $AE88                       ; No: set up the sliding layers instead
$0C:AE77 64 1A        STZ RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; Layer 1 X = 0 (the Bowser scene does not slide)
$0C:AE79 64 1E        STZ $1E                         ; Layer 2 X = 0
$0C:AE7B 64 22        STZ $22                         ; Layer 3 X = 0
$0C:AE7D 9C 62 14     STZ.W $1462                     ; Opposite-direction scroll X $1462 (used by sprites with prop bit 5) = 0
$0C:AE80 9C 66 14     STZ.W $1466                     ; Layer 2 mirror X $1466 = 0
$0C:AE83 9C 6A 14     STZ.W $146A                     ; Mirror X $146A = 0
$0C:AE86 80 1B        BRA $AEA3                       ; Skip the sliding-layer setup

$0C:AE88 A9 00 FF     LDA.W #$FF00                    ; \
$0C:AE8B 85 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; / Layer 1 X = $FF00 (starts $100 pixels to the left)
$0C:AE8D 85 22        STA $22                         ; Layer 3 X = $FF00
$0C:AE8F A9 00 01     LDA.W #$0100                    ; \
$0C:AE92 8D 62 14     STA.W $1462                     ; / Mirror X $1462 = $0100 (starts $100 pixels to the right, moves the other way)
$0C:AE95 8D 6A 14     STA.W $146A                     ; Mirror X $146A = $0100
$0C:AE98 A9 80 FF     LDA.W #$FF80                    ; \
$0C:AE9B 85 1E        STA $1E                         ; / Layer 2 X = $FF80
$0C:AE9D A9 80 00     LDA.W #$0080                    ; \
$0C:AEA0 8D 66 14     STA.W $1466                     ; / Layer 2 mirror X $1466 = $0080
$0C:AEA3 A9 FF 00     LDA.W #$00FF                    ; \
$0C:AEA6 8D 5B 14     STA.W $145B                     ; / [$145B] = $00FF: hold time in frames once the layers have met
$0C:AEA9 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$0C:AEAB AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$0C:AEAC 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$0C:AEAD E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit. Per-frame update of the enemy scene (game mode $25)
$0C:AEAF AD E9 1D     LDA.W $1DE9                     ; \
$0C:AEB2 C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; / Is the scene $0C (Bowser)?
$0C:AEB4 D0 06        BNE $AEBC                       ; No: slide the layers
$0C:AEB6 CE 5B 14     DEC.W $145B                     ; Bowser: only count down the hold timer
$0C:AEB9 4C F8 AE     JMP.W $AEF8                     ; Go and check whether the scene is over

$0C:AEBC C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$0C:AEBE A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; \
$0C:AEC0 CD 62 14     CMP.W $1462                     ; / Has Layer 1 X reached the opposite-moving X (layers met at 0)?
$0C:AEC3 D0 0B        BNE $AED0                       ; No: keep sliding
$0C:AEC5 AD 5B 14     LDA.W $145B                     ; \
$0C:AEC8 F0 06        BEQ $AED0                       ; / Hold timer already at 0: slide on
$0C:AECA CE 5B 14     DEC.W $145B                     ; Layers met: count down the hold timer
$0C:AECD 4C 0C AF     JMP.W $AF0C                     ; Skip the sliding this frame

$0C:AED0 A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; \
$0C:AED2 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:AED3 69 02 00     ADC.W #$0002                    ; |
$0C:AED6 85 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$0C:AED8 85 22        STA $22                         ; / Layer 1 X += 2; Layer 3 X = Layer 1 X
$0C:AEDA AD 62 14     LDA.W $1462                     ; \
$0C:AEDD 38           SEC                             ; |
$0C:AEDE E9 02 00     SBC.W #$0002                    ; |
$0C:AEE1 8D 62 14     STA.W $1462                     ; |
$0C:AEE4 8D 6A 14     STA.W $146A                     ; / Mirror X $1462 -= 2; $146A = $1462 (moves the opposite way)
$0C:AEE7 E6 1E        INC $1E                         ; Layer 2 X += 1
$0C:AEE9 CE 66 14     DEC.W $1466                     ; Layer 2 mirror X $1466 -= 1
$0C:AEEC A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; \
$0C:AEEE 2D 62 14     AND.W $1462                     ; |
$0C:AEF1 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; / Low byte of ([$1A] AND [$1462]) is 0 only when both are at an end of travel (0 or $100)
$0C:AEF4 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$0C:AEF6 D0 14        BNE $AF0C                       ; Not at an end of travel: keep going
$0C:AEF8 AD 5B 14     LDA.W $145B                     ; \
$0C:AEFB D0 0F        BNE $AF0C                       ; / Hold timer still running: wait
$0C:AEFD EE 00 01     INC.W RAM_GameMode              ; Next game mode (normally $25 to $26: fade to THE END)
$0C:AF00 AD E9 1D     LDA.W $1DE9                     ; \
$0C:AF03 C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; |
$0C:AF05 F0 05        BEQ $AF0C                       ; / Bowser scene: leave game mode at $26
$0C:AF07 A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; \
$0C:AF09 8D 00 01     STA.W RAM_GameMode              ; / Any other scene: game mode $22 (fade to the next enemy)
$0C:AF0C E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$0C:AF0E 4C BC B5     JMP.W $B5BC                     ; Draw this scene's background sprites

;;; $B5A2..B5BA: Table: scene sprite list offsets ;;;
;; 13 words, one per ending enemy scene: offset of that scene's sprite list from $0CAF11. Lists are not stored
;;     in scene order.
$0C:B5A2              .db $FC,$02,$1C,$01,$C1,$01,$22,$02 ; sc 0 (Lakitu): $02FC; sc 1 (Hammer Bro.): $011C; sc 2 (Pokey): $01C1; sc 3 (Rex): $0222
$0C:B5AA              .db $00,$00,$45,$00,$8B,$02,$95,$03 ; sc 4 (Dino-Rhino): $0000; sc 5 (Blargg): $0045; sc 6 (Urchin): $028B; sc 7 (Boo): $0395
$0C:B5B2              .db $9E,$00,$2A,$04,$93,$04,$E7,$00 ; sc 8 (Dry Bones): $009E; sc 9 (Grinder): $042A; sc 10 (Reznor): $493; sc 11 (Mecha): $E7
$0C:B5BA              .db $FC,$04                     ; scene 12 (Bowser): $04FC


;;; $B5BC: Draw ending scene background sprites ;;;
;; Builds extended OAM from the current scene's list in $AF11 (offset from $B5A2[[$1DE9]]),
;;     filling slots 127 downwards until an X of $FF.
;; Each sprite's X is reduced by the layer scroll ([$1A], or [$1462] if properties bit 5 is set); X bit 8 and
;;     the size bit go into the high table at $0420+slot.
;; Priority bits come from [$00]: $20, or $30 for scene 5.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:AF0E: Ending enemy scene: set up and slide layers
$0C:B5BC A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$0C:B5BE EB           XBA                             ; / A = 0, hidden high byte B = 0
$0C:B5BF A0 20        LDY.B #$20                      ; Y = $20: OAM priority bits for the scene's sprites
$0C:B5C1 AD E9 1D     LDA.W $1DE9                     ; A = scene
$0C:B5C4 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; Scene 5?
$0C:B5C6 D0 02        BNE $B5CA                       ; No: keep $20
$0C:B5C8 A0 30        LDY.B #$30                      ; Yes: use $30 (priority 3) instead
$0C:B5CA 84 00        STY $00                         ; [$00] = priority bits to merge into each sprite's properties
$0C:B5CC 0A           ASL                             ; A = scene * 2
$0C:B5CD C2 10        REP #$10                        ; X and Y = 16-bit
$0C:B5CF A8           TAY                             ; Y = scene * 2
$0C:B5D0 BE A2 B5     LDX.W $B5A2,Y                   ; X = offset of this scene's sprite list within $AF11
$0C:B5D3 A0 7F 00     LDY.W #$007F                    ; \
$0C:B5D6 84 01        STY $01                         ; / [$01] = $7F: next OAM high-table slot (counts down from 127)
$0C:B5D8 A0 FC 01     LDY.W #$01FC                    ; Y = $01FC: OAM offset of slot 127 (filled backwards)
$0C:B5DB 5A           PHY                             ; Save the OAM offset
$0C:B5DC A4 1A        LDY RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; Y = [$1A]: Layer 1 X scroll
$0C:B5DE BD 14 AF     LDA.W $AF14,X                   ; \
$0C:B5E1 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; |
$0C:B5E3 F0 03        BEQ $B5E8                       ; / Sprite properties bit 5 set?
$0C:B5E5 AC 62 14     LDY.W $1462                     ; Yes: scroll with [$1462] (the opposite-moving group) instead
$0C:B5E8 84 03        STY $03                         ; [$03] = X scroll used for this sprite (16-bit)
$0C:B5EA 7A           PLY                             ; Restore the OAM offset
$0C:B5EB BD 11 AF     LDA.W $AF11,X                   ; A = sprite X from the list
$0C:B5EE C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; \
$0C:B5F0 F0 41        BEQ $B633                       ; / $FF = end of this scene's list
$0C:B5F2 38           SEC                             ; \
$0C:B5F3 E5 03        SBC $03                         ; / A = X - scroll (low byte)
$0C:B5F5 99 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y       ; OAM X = screen X
$0C:B5F8 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$0C:B5FA E5 04        SBC $04                         ; |
$0C:B5FC 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$0C:B5FE 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = OAM X bit 8: borrow from the 16-bit subtraction
$0C:B600 BD 14 AF     LDA.W $AF14,X                   ; \
$0C:B603 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; |
$0C:B605 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:B606 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:B607 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:B608 05 04        ORA $04                         ; / A = X bit 8 | size bit (prop bit 4 moved to bit 1)
$0C:B60A 5A           PHY                             ; \
$0C:B60B A4 01        LDY $01                         ; |
$0C:B60D 99 20 04     STA.W $0420,Y                   ; } Store in the OAM high table entry [$0420 + [$01]]
$0C:B610 7A           PLY                             ; /
$0C:B611 BD 12 AF     LDA.W $AF12,X                   ; A = sprite Y from the list
$0C:B614 99 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y       ; OAM Y
$0C:B617 BD 13 AF     LDA.W $AF13,X                   ; A = tile from the list
$0C:B61A 99 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y        ; OAM tile
$0C:B61D BD 14 AF     LDA.W $AF14,X                   ; \
$0C:B620 29 CF        AND.B #$CF                      ; |
$0C:B622 05 00        ORA $00                         ; |
$0C:B624 99 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y        ; / OAM properties = list properties with bits 4-5 replaced by [$00]
$0C:B627 88           DEY                             ; \
$0C:B628 88           DEY                             ; |
$0C:B629 88           DEY                             ; |
$0C:B62A 88           DEY                             ; / Y -= 4: previous OAM slot
$0C:B62B E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:B62C E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:B62D E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:B62E E8           INX                             ; / X += 4: next sprite in the list
$0C:B62F C6 01        DEC $01                         ; Previous high-table slot
$0C:B631 80 A8        BRA $B5DB                       ; Next sprite

$0C:B633 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; X and Y = 8-bit
$0C:B635 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $B636..B7FE: Screen image: THE END ;;;
;; Two 12-tile rows at VRAM $50EA and $510A (Layer 3): 'T H E   E N D' as tops (tiles $Cx/$E3) and bottoms
;;     (+$10), with tile $FC as the spaces.
;; Screen image format (read by LoadScrnImage, $0085D2): blocks of VRAM word address (high, low), flags/length
;;     high (bit 7 = write down a column,
;; bit 6 = RLE, bits 5-0 = length high), length low; length = byte count - 1. Then tile/attribute byte pairs,
;;     or for RLE one tile and one attribute that are repeated. A $FF byte ends the image.
;; Followed by $FF padding up to $0CB7FF.
$0C:B636              .db $50,$EA,$00,$17,$E3,$20,$FC,$20 ; VRAM $50EA: 12 tiles; top row of "THE END": T(top) space
$0C:B63E              .db $C7,$20,$FC,$20,$C4,$20,$FC,$20 ; H(top) space E(top) space
$0C:B646              .db $FC,$20,$C4,$20,$FC,$20,$CD,$20 ; space E(top) space N(top)
$0C:B64E              .db $FC,$20,$C3,$20,$51,$0A,$00,$17 ; space D(top); VRAM $510A: 12 tiles (bottom row)
$0C:B656              .db $F3,$20,$FC,$20,$D7,$20,$FC,$20 ; T(bottom) space H(bottom) space
$0C:B65E              .db $D4,$20,$FC,$20,$FC,$20,$D4,$20 ; E(bottom) space space E(bottom)
$0C:B666              .db $FC,$20,$DD,$20,$FC,$20,$D3,$20 ; space N(bottom) space D(bottom)
$0C:B66E              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF ; End of image ($FF)

;;     then $C98C counts down [$144D] every 4th frame,
;; updates Mario's sprite ($D803) and jumps to the handler for cutscene [$13C6] through the table at
;;     $0CC9A5.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:C981: Cutscene main entry and text timer
$0C:C94E AD 43 14     LDA.W $1443                     ; A = [$1443]: text timer (counts down; bits 7-5 select the text line)
$0C:C951 F0 2A        BEQ $C97D                       ; Timer is 0: no text to show
$0C:C953 CE 43 14     DEC.W $1443                     ; Count the timer down
$0C:C956 AD 43 14     LDA.W $1443                     ; \
$0C:C959 29 1F        AND.B #$1F                      ; |
$0C:C95B D0 20        BNE $C97D                       ; / Only continue once every 32 frames (low 5 bits = 0)
$0C:C95D AD C6 13     LDA.W $13C6                     ; \
$0C:C960 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$0C:C961 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:C962 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:C963 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:C964 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = (cutscene number - 1) * 8
$0C:C966 AD 43 14     LDA.W $1443                     ; \
$0C:C969 29 E0        AND.B #$E0                      ; |
$0C:C96B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:C96C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:C96D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:C96E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:C96F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:C970 05 00        ORA $00                         ; |
$0C:C972 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] += text line index = [$1443] bits 7-5
$0C:C974 0A           ASL                             ; \
$0C:C975 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:C976 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$0C:C978 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:C979 69 21        ADC.B #$21                      ; |
$0C:C97B 85 12        STA $12                         ; / [$12] = [$00] * 3 + $21: ImagePointers entry 11 + [$00] (next text line)
$0C:C97D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:C97E 8B           PHB                             ; Cutscene main entry (called from game mode $18-$1A): save data bank
$0C:C97F 4B           PHK                             ; \
$0C:C980 AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = $0C
$0C:C981 20 4E C9     JSR.W $C94E                     ; Show the next text line when its timer says so
$0C:C984 20 8F CA     JSR.W $CA8F                     ; Draw the 3 decoration sprites if [$144A] is set
$0C:C987 20 8C C9     JSR.W $C98C                     ; Run the cutscene state machine
$0C:C98A AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$0C:C98B 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$0C:C98C A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$0C:C98E 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$0C:C990 D0 08        BNE $C99A                       ; |
$0C:C992 AD 4D 14     LDA.W $144D                     ; |
$0C:C995 F0 03        BEQ $C99A                       ; |
$0C:C997 CE 4D 14     DEC.W $144D                     ; / Every 4th frame: count down the delay timer [$144D] if it is not 0
$0C:C99A 20 03 D8     JSR.W $D803                     ; Update Mario's sprite for the cutscene ($D803)
$0C:C99D AD C6 13     LDA.W $13C6                     ; \
$0C:C9A0 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$0C:C9A1 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; / Run the handler for cutscene [$13C6] (1-7) from the table below


;;; $C9A5: Pointer table: cutscene handlers; cutscene 1 (Ptrs0CC9A5) ;;;
;; Seven handlers indexed by [$13C6]-1 (the castle 1-7 Koopaling cutscenes, 8 = credits is handled elsewhere).
;; $C9B3 (cutscene 1, Iggy): draws sprite slot 0, updates the object at [$0B51], then runs state [$1442]
;;     from the table below.
$0C:C9A5 B3 C9        .dw $C9B3                       ; Cutscene 1 (Iggy): $C9B3
$0C:C9A7 CC C9        .dw $C9CC                       ; Cutscene 2 (Morton): $C9CC
$0C:C9A9 2F CA        .dw $CA2F                       ; Cutscene 3 (Lemmy): $CA2F
$0C:C9AB 04 CA        .dw $CA04                       ; Cutscene 4 (Ludwig): $CA04
$0C:C9AD E0 C9        .dw $C9E0                       ; Cutscene 5 (Roy): $C9E0
$0C:C9AF 51 CA        .dw $CA51                       ; Cutscene 6 (Wendy): $CA51
$0C:C9B1 72 CA        .dw $CA72                       ; Cutscene 7 (Larry): $CA72

$0C:C9B3 20 5B CB     JSR.W $CB5B                     ; Draw the 16x16 sprite in OAM slot 0 ($CB5B)
$0C:C9B6 20 CE CA     JSR.W $CACE                     ; Update the object driven by [$0B51] ($CACE)
$0C:C9B9 AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; A = cutscene state [$1442]
$0C:C9BC 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the state routine from the table below


;;; $C9C0: Pointer table: cutscene 1 states; cutscene 2 (Ptrs0CC9C0) ;;;
;; Cutscene 1 state routines (6). Then $C9CC (cutscene 2, Morton): updates the object at [$0B51] and
;;     runs state [$1442] from the next table.
$0C:C9C0 1C CB        .dw $CB1C                       ; State 0: $CB1C (row of sprites)
$0C:C9C2 95 D2        .dw $D295                       ; State 1: $D295 (sound $1A, starts the backdrop flash)
$0C:C9C4 51 CC        .dw $CC51                       ; State 2: $CC51 (backdrop flash)
$0C:C9C6 B2 D2        .dw $D2B2                       ; State 3: $D2B2
$0C:C9C8 23 CD        .dw $CD23                       ; State 4: $CD23
$0C:C9CA DE CF        .dw $CFDE                       ; State 5: $CFDE (wait for a button, back to the map)

$0C:C9CC 20 CE CA     JSR.W $CACE                     ; Update the object driven by [$0B51] ($CACE)
$0C:C9CF AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; A = cutscene state [$1442]
$0C:C9D2 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the state routine from the table below


;;; $C9D6: Pointer table: cutscene 2 states; cutscene 5 (Ptrs0CC9D6) ;;;
;; Cutscene 2 state routines (5). Then $C9E0 (cutscene 5, Roy): sprite slot 0, object at [$0B51],
;;     $D4F8, then state [$1442].
$0C:C9D6 03 D0        .dw $D003                       ; State 0: $D003
$0C:C9D8 B2 D2        .dw $D2B2                       ; State 1: $D2B2
$0C:C9DA 23 CD        .dw $CD23                       ; State 2: $CD23
$0C:C9DC 57 D5        .dw $D557                       ; State 3: $D557
$0C:C9DE DE CF        .dw $CFDE                       ; State 4: $CFDE (wait for a button, back to the map)

$0C:C9E0 20 5B CB     JSR.W $CB5B                     ; Draw the 16x16 sprite in OAM slot 0 ($CB5B)
$0C:C9E3 20 CE CA     JSR.W $CACE                     ; Update the object driven by [$0B51] ($CACE)
$0C:C9E6 20 F8 D4     JSR.W $D4F8                     ; Cutscene 5 specific update ($D4F8)
$0C:C9E9 AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; A = cutscene state [$1442]
$0C:C9EC 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the state routine from the table below


;;; $C9F0: Pointer table: cutscene 5 states; cutscene 4 (Ptrs0CC9F0) ;;;
;; Cutscene 5 state routines (10). Then $CA04 (cutscene 4, Ludwig): sprite slot 0; state 0 sets [$1445]
;;     = 4; state 7 also runs $CF49; then state [$1442].
$0C:C9F0 1C CB        .dw $CB1C                       ; State 0: $CB1C (row of sprites)
$0C:C9F2 D0 D2        .dw $D2D0                       ; State 1: $D2D0
$0C:C9F4 72 CF        .dw $CF72                       ; State 2: $CF72
$0C:C9F6 C5 CF        .dw $CFC5                       ; State 3: $CFC5
$0C:C9F8 95 D2        .dw $D295                       ; State 4: $D295 (sound $1A, starts the backdrop flash)
$0C:C9FA 51 CC        .dw $CC51                       ; State 5: $CC51 (backdrop flash)
$0C:C9FC B2 D2        .dw $D2B2                       ; State 6: $D2B2
$0C:C9FE 23 CD        .dw $CD23                       ; State 7: $CD23
$0C:CA00 F7 CF        .dw $CFF7                       ; State 8: $CFF7
$0C:CA02 DE CF        .dw $CFDE                       ; State 9: $CFDE (wait for a button, back to the map)

$0C:CA04 20 5B CB     JSR.W $CB5B                     ; Draw the 16x16 sprite in OAM slot 0 ($CB5B)
$0C:CA07 AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; A = cutscene state [$1442]
$0C:CA0A D0 05        BNE $CA11                       ; Not state 0: skip
$0C:CA0C A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; \
$0C:CA0E 8C 45 14     STY.W $1445                     ; / State 0: [$1445] = 4
$0C:CA11 C9 07        CMP.B #$07                      ; \
$0C:CA13 D0 03        BNE $CA18                       ; / State 7?
$0C:CA15 20 49 CF     JSR.W $CF49                     ; State 7: extra update ($CF49)
$0C:CA18 AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; A = cutscene state [$1442]
$0C:CA1B 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the state routine from the table below


;;; $CA1F: Pointer table: cutscene 4 states; cutscene 3 (Ptrs0CCA1F) ;;;
;; Cutscene 4 state routines (8). Then $CA2F (cutscene 3, Lemmy): $D65B, object at [$0B51],
;;     $D3A6 (except in state 3), $D3F4, then state [$1442].
$0C:CA1F 1C CB        .dw $CB1C                       ; State 0: $CB1C (row of sprites)
$0C:CA21 95 D2        .dw $D295                       ; State 1: $D295 (sound $1A, starts the backdrop flash)
$0C:CA23 51 CC        .dw $CC51                       ; State 2: $CC51 (backdrop flash)
$0C:CA25 BD D2        .dw $D2BD                       ; State 3: $D2BD
$0C:CA27 A1 CD        .dw $CDA1                       ; State 4: $CDA1
$0C:CA29 E6 D2        .dw $D2E6                       ; State 5: $D2E6
$0C:CA2B E2 CE        .dw $CEE2                       ; State 6: $CEE2
$0C:CA2D DE CF        .dw $CFDE                       ; State 7: $CFDE (wait for a button, back to the map)

$0C:CA2F 20 5B D6     JSR.W $D65B                     ; Cutscene 3 specific update ($D65B)
$0C:CA32 20 CE CA     JSR.W $CACE                     ; Update the object driven by [$0B51] ($CACE)
$0C:CA35 AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; \
$0C:CA38 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$0C:CA3A F0 03        BEQ $CA3F                       ; / In state 3?
$0C:CA3C 20 A6 D3     JSR.W $D3A6                     ; No: run $D3A6 (cutscene object spawner)
$0C:CA3F 20 F4 D3     JSR.W $D3F4                     ; Cutscene object update ($D3F4)
$0C:CA42 AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; A = cutscene state [$1442]
$0C:CA45 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the state routine from the table below


;;; $CA49: Pointer table: cutscene 3 states; cutscene 6 (Ptrs0CCA49) ;;;
;; Cutscene 3 state routines (4). Then $CA51 (cutscene 6, Wendy): $D6EC, draws the object tile $E6
;;     at (B0, [$0B51]) when [$1444] is set, then state [$1442].
$0C:CA49 BC D0        .dw $D0BC                       ; State 0: $D0BC
$0C:CA4B B2 D2        .dw $D2B2                       ; State 1: $D2B2
$0C:CA4D 23 CD        .dw $CD23                       ; State 2: $CD23
$0C:CA4F DE CF        .dw $CFDE                       ; State 3: $CFDE (wait for a button, back to the map)

$0C:CA51 20 EC D6     JSR.W $D6EC                     ; Cutscene 6 specific update ($D6EC)
$0C:CA54 AD 44 14     LDA.W $1444                     ; \
$0C:CA57 F0 0E        BEQ $CA67                       ; / Is the object flag [$1444] set?
$0C:CA59 A2 30        LDX.B #$30                      ; \
$0C:CA5B A9 B0        LDA.B #$B0                      ; |
$0C:CA5D 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0C:CA5F A9 68        LDA.B #$68                      ; |
$0C:CA61 8D 51 0B     STA.W $0B51                     ; |
$0C:CA64 20 FD CA     JSR.W $CAFD                     ; / Yes: draw the object (tile $E6) at X = $B0, Y = $68 in the slot at $0380 + $30
$0C:CA67 AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; A = cutscene state [$1442]
$0C:CA6A 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the state routine from the table below


;;; $CA6E: Pointer table: cutscene 6 states; cutscene 7 (Ptrs0CCA6E) ;;;
;; Cutscene 6 state routines (2). Then $CA72 (cutscene 7, Larry): just runs state [$1442] from the next
;;     table.
$0C:CA6E C9 D0        .dw $D0C9                       ; State 0: $D0C9
$0C:CA70 DE CF        .dw $CFDE                       ; State 1: $CFDE (wait for a button, back to the map)

$0C:CA72 AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; A = cutscene state [$1442]
$0C:CA75 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the state routine from the table below


;;; $CA79: Pointer table: cutscene 7 states; sprite helpers (Ptrs0CCA79) ;;;
;; Cutscene 7 state routines (5), then shared sprite helpers:
;; $CA8F draws 3 decoration sprites from $CA83 (X, Y, tile, properties) in OAM slots 120-122 when
;;     [$144A] is set;
;; $CACE controls the object at [$0B51]/[$1444] (draws tile $E6 via $CAFD); $CB1C is state 0
;;     of cutscenes 1, 4 and 5 (row of sprites);
;; $CB5B draws the 16x16 sprite in OAM slot 0 at (80, 103) with tile $E0 ($E2 when [$143E] is non-zero).
$0C:CA79 D2 D0        .dw $D0D2                       ; State 0: $D0D2
$0C:CA7B 08 D1        .dw $D108                       ; State 1: $D108
$0C:CA7D 6F D1        .dw $D16F                       ; State 2: $D16F
$0C:CA7F 9C D1        .dw $D19C                       ; State 3: $D19C
$0C:CA81 DE CF        .dw $CFDE                       ; State 4: $CFDE (wait for a button, back to the map)

$0C:CA83              .db $20                         ; Decoration sprite 0: X = $20

$0C:CA84              .db $48                         ; Decoration sprite 0: Y = $48

$0C:CA85              .db $A6                         ; Decoration sprite 0: tile $A6

$0C:CA86              .db $18,$30,$48,$A8,$18,$28,$58,$8D ; Sprite 0 prop $18 (16x16); sprite 1: $30,$48,$A8,$18; sprite 2: $28,$58,$8D,(prop below)
$0C:CA8E              .db $08                         ; Sprite 2 properties $08 (8x8)

$0C:CA8F AD 4A 14     LDA.W $144A                     ; \
$0C:CA92 F0 39        BEQ $CACD                       ; / Nothing to draw unless [$144A] is set
$0C:CA94 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; \
$0C:CA96 BB           TYX                             ; / X = Y = 0: sprite index
$0C:CA97 B9 83 CA     LDA.W $CA83,Y                   ; \
$0C:CA9A 9D E0 03     STA.W $03E0,X                   ; / OAM X (slot at $03E0+X) = table X
$0C:CA9D B9 84 CA     LDA.W $CA84,Y                   ; \
$0C:CAA0 9D E1 03     STA.W $03E1,X                   ; / OAM Y = table Y
$0C:CAA3 B9 85 CA     LDA.W $CA85,Y                   ; \
$0C:CAA6 9D E2 03     STA.W $03E2,X                   ; / OAM tile = table tile
$0C:CAA9 B9 86 CA     LDA.W $CA86,Y                   ; \
$0C:CAAC 29 CF        AND.B #$CF                      ; |
$0C:CAAE 09 20        ORA.B #$20                      ; |
$0C:CAB0 9D E3 03     STA.W $03E3,X                   ; / OAM properties = table byte with bits 4-5 replaced by $20 (priority 2)
$0C:CAB3 DA           PHX                             ; \
$0C:CAB4 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:CAB5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CAB6 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CAB7 AA           TAX                             ; / X = OAM slot number
$0C:CAB8 B9 86 CA     LDA.W $CA86,Y                   ; \
$0C:CABB 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; |
$0C:CABD 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CABE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CABF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CAC0 9D 98 04     STA.W $0498,X                   ; / OAM high table ($0498+slot) = size bit (properties bit 4 moved to bit 1)
$0C:CAC3 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X = OAM byte offset
$0C:CAC4 E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:CAC5 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:CAC6 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:CAC7 E8           INX                             ; / X += 4: next OAM slot
$0C:CAC8 9B           TXY                             ; \
$0C:CAC9 C0 0C        CPY.B #$0C                      ; |
$0C:CACB D0 CA        BNE $CA97                       ; / Y = X; loop until 3 sprites are done
$0C:CACD 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:CACE AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; A = cutscene state [$1442]
$0C:CAD1 D0 0A        BNE $CADD                       ; Not state 0: go on
$0C:CAD3 9C 44 14     STZ.W $1444                     ; State 0: clear the object flag [$1444]
$0C:CAD6 A9 98        LDA.B #$98                      ; \
$0C:CAD8 8D 51 0B     STA.W $0B51                     ; / Object Y [$0B51] = $98 (start height)
$0C:CADB 80 1F        BRA $CAFC                       ; Return

$0C:CADD AD 44 14     LDA.W $1444                     ; \
$0C:CAE0 F0 1A        BEQ $CAFC                       ; / State not 0: return unless the object flag [$1444] is set
$0C:CAE2 AD 51 0B     LDA.W $0B51                     ; \
$0C:CAE5 C9 5C        CMP.B #$5C                      ; / Object Y [$0B51] below $5C?
$0C:CAE7 90 0A        BCC $CAF3                       ; Not yet: just draw it
$0C:CAE9 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; \
$0C:CAEB A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; |
$0C:CAED 9D 14 0B     STA.W $0B14,X                   ; / [$0B15] = $F0 (cutscene object 1 field set to off-screen value)
$0C:CAF0 20 68 D3     JSR.W $D368                     ; Update cutscene object slot ($D368)
$0C:CAF3 A2 30        LDX.B #$30                      ; \
$0C:CAF5 A9 AB        LDA.B #$AB                      ; |
$0C:CAF7 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0C:CAF9 82 01 00     BRL $CAFD                       ; / Draw the object (tile $E6) at X = $AB in the slot at $0380 + $30
$0C:CAFC 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:CAFD A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:CAFF 9D 80 03     STA.W $0380,X                   ; / OAM X = [$00]
$0C:CB02 AD 51 0B     LDA.W $0B51                     ; \
$0C:CB05 9D 81 03     STA.W $0381,X                   ; / OAM Y = [$0B51]
$0C:CB08 A9 E6        LDA.B #$E6                      ; \
$0C:CB0A 9D 82 03     STA.W $0382,X                   ; / OAM tile = $E6
$0C:CB0D A9 21        LDA.B #$21                      ; \
$0C:CB0F 9D 83 03     STA.W $0383,X                   ; / OAM properties = $21
$0C:CB12 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:CB13 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CB14 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CB15 AA           TAX                             ; / X = OAM slot number
$0C:CB16 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0C:CB18 9D 80 04     STA.W $0480,X                   ; / OAM high table: size = 16x16
$0C:CB1B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:CB1C AD 3E 14     LDA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; \
$0C:CB1F D0 0F        BNE $CB30                       ; / Is [$143E] zero?
$0C:CB21 A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; \
$0C:CB23 8D 50 0B     STA.W $0B50                     ; / Yes (first call): row start X [$0B50] = $60
$0C:CB26 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0C:CB28 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F                     ; / [$143F] = 1: animation timer
$0C:CB2B 9C 40 14     STZ.W $1440                     ; Animation frame [$1440] = 0
$0C:CB2E 80 25        BRA $CB55                       ; Go and draw

$0C:CB30 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: cutscene object 0
$0C:CB32 A0 30        LDY.B #$30                      ; Y = $30
$0C:CB34 AD C6 13     LDA.W $13C6                     ; \
$0C:CB37 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$0C:CB38 D0 02        BNE $CB3C                       ; |
$0C:CB3A A0 18        LDY.B #$18                      ; / Y = $30, or $18 in cutscene 1
$0C:CB3C 98           TYA                             ; \
$0C:CB3D 9D 14 0B     STA.W $0B14,X                   ; / [$0B14] = $30 or $18
$0C:CB40 20 68 D3     JSR.W $D368                     ; Update cutscene object slot ($D368)
$0C:CB43 CE 3F 14     DEC.W $143F                     ; \
$0C:CB46 10 0D        BPL $CB55                       ; / Animation timer [$143F] down; still positive: keep frame
$0C:CB48 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0C:CB4A 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F                     ; / Reload the timer with 1
$0C:CB4D AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440                     ; \
$0C:CB50 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; |
$0C:CB52 8D 40 14     STA.W $1440                     ; / Toggle animation frame [$1440] between 0 and 1
$0C:CB55 20 FA CB     JSR.W $CBFA                     ; Draw the 2x2 sprite block ($CBFA)
$0C:CB58 82 25 00     BRL $CB80                       ; Then draw the row of sprites
$0C:CB5B A0 E0        LDY.B #$E0                      ; \
$0C:CB5D AD 3E 14     LDA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; |
$0C:CB60 F0 02        BEQ $CB64                       ; |
$0C:CB62 A0 E2        LDY.B #$E2                      ; / Y = tile $E0, or $E2 when [$143E] is non-zero
$0C:CB64 8C 02 02     STY.W OAM_ExtendedTile          ; OAM slot 0 tile
$0C:CB67 A9 39        LDA.B #$39                      ; \
$0C:CB69 8D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp          ; / OAM slot 0 properties $39
$0C:CB6C A9 50        LDA.B #$50                      ; \
$0C:CB6E 8D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX         ; / OAM slot 0 X = $50
$0C:CB71 A9 67        LDA.B #$67                      ; \
$0C:CB73 8D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY         ; / OAM slot 0 Y = $67
$0C:CB76 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0C:CB78 8D 20 04     STA.W $0420                     ; / OAM slot 0 size = 16x16
$0C:CB7B 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $CB7C..CB7C: Tiles for 2x2 sprite block ;;;
$0C:CB7C              .db $86,$87,$96,$97             ; Tiles of the 2x2 block: $86 $87 / $96 $97


;;; $CB80: Draw cutscene sprite row and 2x2 block ;;;
;; $CB80: draws a row of 5 sprites (tile $E4, 16 pixels apart, y = $67) from X = $60 (or [$0B50] when
;;     [$143E] is non-zero), skipping any at X >= $B0,
;; plus, when [$143E] is non-zero, a small animated sprite (tile $85/$95 by [$1440]) at X = [$0B50]-8, y =
;;     $6F; when it passes X = $B0 the cutscene state advances.
;; $CBFA: draws a 2x2 block of sprites from $CB7C at (A8, 5F), 8 pixels apart, starting at OAM
;;     slot 1 ($0380 + 4); $CBFC enters with another slot offset in X.
$0C:CB80 A2 60        LDX.B #$60                      ; \
$0C:CB82 AD 3E 14     LDA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; |
$0C:CB85 F0 03        BEQ $CB8A                       ; |
$0C:CB87 AE 50 0B     LDX.W $0B50                     ; / X = start X of the row: $60, or [$0B50] when [$143E] is non-zero
$0C:CB8A 86 00        STX $00                         ; [$00] = X of the next sprite in the row
$0C:CB8C A9 67        LDA.B #$67                      ; \
$0C:CB8E 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = Y of the row = $67
$0C:CB90 A2 14        LDX.B #$14                      ; X = $14: first OAM slot of the row ($0380 + $14)
$0C:CB92 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:CB94 C9 B0        CMP.B #$B0                      ; |
$0C:CB96 B0 1D        BCS $CBB5                       ; / A = X of this sprite; skip it when X >= $B0 (off the right end)
$0C:CB98 9D 80 03     STA.W $0380,X                   ; OAM X
$0C:CB9B A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$0C:CB9D 9D 81 03     STA.W $0381,X                   ; / OAM Y = [$01]
$0C:CBA0 A9 E4        LDA.B #$E4                      ; \
$0C:CBA2 9D 82 03     STA.W $0382,X                   ; / OAM tile = $E4
$0C:CBA5 A9 3F        LDA.B #$3F                      ; \
$0C:CBA7 9D 83 03     STA.W $0383,X                   ; / OAM properties = $3F
$0C:CBAA DA           PHX                             ; \
$0C:CBAB 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:CBAC 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CBAD 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CBAE AA           TAX                             ; / X = OAM slot number
$0C:CBAF A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0C:CBB1 9D 80 04     STA.W $0480,X                   ; / OAM high table: size = 16x16
$0C:CBB4 FA           PLX                             ; Restore OAM offset
$0C:CBB5 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:CBB7 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:CBB8 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0C:CBBA 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Next sprite X = X + $10
$0C:CBBC E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:CBBD E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:CBBE E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:CBBF E8           INX                             ; / X += 4: next OAM slot
$0C:CBC0 E0 28        CPX.B #$28                      ; \
$0C:CBC2 D0 CE        BNE $CB92                       ; / Loop for 5 sprites (X = $14 ... $24)
$0C:CBC4 AD 3E 14     LDA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; \
$0C:CBC7 F0 30        BEQ $CBF9                       ; / Return unless [$143E] is non-zero
$0C:CBC9 AD 50 0B     LDA.W $0B50                     ; \
$0C:CBCC 38           SEC                             ; |
$0C:CBCD E9 08        SBC.B #$08                      ; |
$0C:CBCF C9 B0        CMP.B #$B0                      ; / A = [$0B50] - 8: X of the moving sprite, compared with $B0
$0C:CBD1 90 05        BCC $CBD8                       ; Not past the right end: draw the moving sprite
$0C:CBD3 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Past the end: next cutscene state ([$1442]++)
$0C:CBD6 80 21        BRA $CBF9                       ; Return

$0C:CBD8 9D 80 03     STA.W $0380,X                   ; OAM X of the moving sprite (slot at $0380 + $28)
$0C:CBDB A9 6F        LDA.B #$6F                      ; \
$0C:CBDD 9D 81 03     STA.W $0381,X                   ; / OAM Y = $6F
$0C:CBE0 A0 85        LDY.B #$85                      ; Y = tile $85
$0C:CBE2 AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440                     ; \
$0C:CBE5 F0 02        BEQ $CBE9                       ; |
$0C:CBE7 A0 95        LDY.B #$95                      ; / Animation frame [$1440] = 1: tile $95 instead
$0C:CBE9 98           TYA                             ; \
$0C:CBEA 9D 82 03     STA.W $0382,X                   ; / OAM tile
$0C:CBED A9 35        LDA.B #$35                      ; \
$0C:CBEF 9D 83 03     STA.W $0383,X                   ; / OAM properties = $35
$0C:CBF2 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:CBF3 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CBF4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CBF5 AA           TAX                             ; / X = OAM slot number
$0C:CBF6 9E 80 04     STZ.W $0480,X                   ; OAM high table: size = 8x8
$0C:CBF9 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:CBFA A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4: OAM slot 1 (the block starts at $0380 + 4)
$0C:CBFC A9 A8        LDA.B #$A8                      ; \
$0C:CBFE 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0C:CC00 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$00] = [$02] = $A8: left X of the block
$0C:CC02 A9 5F        LDA.B #$5F                      ; \
$0C:CC04 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = $5F: top Y of the block
$0C:CC06 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: tile index
$0C:CC08 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:CC0A 9D 80 03     STA.W $0380,X                   ; / OAM X = [$00]
$0C:CC0D A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$0C:CC0F 9D 81 03     STA.W $0381,X                   ; / OAM Y = [$01]
$0C:CC12 B9 7C CB     LDA.W $CB7C,Y                   ; \
$0C:CC15 9D 82 03     STA.W $0382,X                   ; / OAM tile = $CB7C[Y]
$0C:CC18 A9 2D        LDA.B #$2D                      ; \
$0C:CC1A 9D 83 03     STA.W $0383,X                   ; / OAM properties = $2D
$0C:CC1D DA           PHX                             ; \
$0C:CC1E 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:CC1F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CC20 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CC21 AA           TAX                             ; / X = OAM slot number
$0C:CC22 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0C:CC24 9D 80 04     STA.W $0480,X                   ; / OAM high table: size = 16x16
$0C:CC27 FA           PLX                             ; Restore OAM offset
$0C:CC28 C8           INY                             ; Next tile
$0C:CC29 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:CC2B 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:CC2C 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$0C:CC2E 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] += 8: next column
$0C:CC30 98           TYA                             ; \
$0C:CC31 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$0C:CC33 D0 0B        BNE $CC40                       ; / After every second tile (end of a row)...
$0C:CC35 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$0C:CC37 85 00        STA $00                         ; / ...[$00] = left X again
$0C:CC39 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$0C:CC3B 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:CC3C 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$0C:CC3E 85 01        STA $01                         ; / ...[$01] += 8: next row
$0C:CC40 E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:CC41 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:CC42 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:CC43 E8           INX                             ; / X += 4: next OAM slot
$0C:CC44 C0 04        CPY.B #$04                      ; \
$0C:CC46 D0 C0        BNE $CC08                       ; / Loop for 4 tiles
$0C:CC48 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $CC49..CC4D: Flash frame durations and colors ;;;
$0C:CC49              .db $03,$01,$03,$01             ; Frame durations by animation frame [$1440]: 3, 1, 3, 1

$0C:CC4D              .db $93,$73,$FF,$7F             ; Backdrop flash colors (words): $7393, $7FFF (white)


;;; $CC51: Cutscene state: backdrop color flash ;;;
;; Each frame the backdrop color mirror $0701 alternates between $7393 and $7FFF (white) every 2 frames, while
;;     [$1441] counts down.
;; A 3x2 sprite block is animated with the frame durations in $CC49 and drawn by $CCB6, plus the
;;     2x2 block at OAM offset $1C.
;; When the timer runs out the cutscene objects are cleared, the backdrop color is restored from the Palettes?
;;     table using CutsceneBgColor, and the state advances.
$0C:CC51 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$0C:CC53 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; |
$0C:CC55 AA           TAX                             ; / X = frame counter AND 2: 0 or 2
$0C:CC56 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$0C:CC58 BD 4D CC     LDA.W $CC4D,X                   ; \
$0C:CC5B 8D 01 07     STA.W $0701                     ; / Backdrop color mirror $0701 = $7393 or $7FFF (white), swapped every 2 frames
$0C:CC5E E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$0C:CC60 CE 41 14     DEC.W $1441                     ; \
$0C:CC63 10 1D        BPL $CC82                       ; / Flash timer [$1441] down; still positive: keep flashing
$0C:CC65 20 73 D3     JSR.W $D373                     ; Flash over: clear cutscene objects ($D373)
$0C:CC68 AE C6 13     LDX.W $13C6                     ; \
$0C:CC6B BF 50 94 00  LDA.L CutsceneBgColor-1,X       ; |
$0C:CC6F 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:CC70 AA           TAX                             ; / X = CutsceneBgColor[cutscene - 1] * 2
$0C:CC71 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A = 16-bit
$0C:CC73 BF A0 B0 00  LDA.L Palettes?,X               ; \
$0C:CC77 8D 01 07     STA.W $0701                     ; / Restore the backdrop color from the Palettes? table ($00B0A0)
$0C:CC7A E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A = 8-bit
$0C:CC7C EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Next cutscene state
$0C:CC7F 82 18 00     BRL $CC9A                       ; Then draw
$0C:CC82 CE 3F 14     DEC.W $143F                     ; \
$0C:CC85 10 10        BPL $CC97                       ; / Animation timer [$143F] down; not yet negative: skip
$0C:CC87 AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440                     ; \
$0C:CC8A 1A           INC A                           ; |
$0C:CC8B 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$0C:CC8D 8D 40 14     STA.W $1440                     ; / [$1440] = ([$1440] + 1) AND 3: next animation frame
$0C:CC90 AA           TAX                             ; \
$0C:CC91 BD 49 CC     LDA.W $CC49,X                   ; |
$0C:CC94 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F                     ; / [$143F] = $CC49[frame]: its duration
$0C:CC97 20 B6 CC     JSR.W $CCB6                     ; Draw the 3x2 sprite block for this frame ($CCB6)
$0C:CC9A A2 1C        LDX.B #$1C                      ; X = $1C: OAM slot offset ($0380 + $1C)
$0C:CC9C 82 5D FF     BRL $CBFC                       ; Draw the 2x2 sprite block there ($CBFC)


;;; $CC9F..CCAF: Tile table: 3x2 sprite frames ;;;
;; Tiles for $CCB6's 3x2 block of 16x16 sprites (6 bytes per frame, 0 = no sprite); selected by
;;     $CCB1.
$0C:CC9F              .db $A0,$A4,$00,$C0,$C4,$00,$A0,$A2 ; Frame at offset 0: row 1 tiles $A0 $A4 --, row 2 tiles $C0 $C4 -- (2 columns wide)
$0C:CCA7              .db $A4,$C0,$C2,$C4,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Offset 6: tiles $A0 $A2 $A4 / $C0 $C2 $C4 (3 wide); offset 12: blank frame
$0C:CCAF              .db $00,$00                     ; Blank frame (no tiles)


;;; $CCB1..CCB1: Tile table offsets by frame ;;;
$0C:CCB1              .db $00,$06,$0C,$06,$0C         ; Tile table offsets by frame (index [$1440]+1): 0, 6, 12, 6, 12


;;; $CCB6: Cutscene: castle tiles, scroll and shake states ;;;
;; Group of cutscene routines using [$1442] as scene state, [$143F]/[$1441] as timers, [$1440] as animation
;;     frame.
;; $0CCCB6: draws a 3x2 grid of 16x16 castle tiles (OAM slots 1-6) from $CC9F, frame chosen by [$1440],
;;     palette flashing.
;; $0CCD23: state - screen scrolls up with a shake until Y scroll = $C0, then queues a tile strip upload.
;; $0CCDA1: state - screen drops with increasing speed ([$1447], max $7F), shaking, until Y position >= $A8.
;; Called by:
