;;     $0C:CC97: Cutscene state: backdrop color flash
$0C:CCB6 AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440                     ; A = [$1440] (animation frame; $FF = first frame)
$0C:CCB9 1A           INC A                           ; X = frame + 1 (0..4)
$0C:CCBA AA           TAX 
$0C:CCBB BD B1 CC     LDA.W $CCB1,X                   ; A = offset of this frame's row in tile table $CC9F (6 tiles per frame)
$0C:CCBE 85 08        STA $08                         ; $08 = tile table index
$0C:CCC0 A0 A0        LDY.B #$A0                      ; Y = left X position $A0
$0C:CCC2 E0 00        CPX.B #$00
$0C:CCC4 D0 02        BNE $CCC8                       ; Frame $FF is drawn 8 pixels further right
$0C:CCC6 A0 A8        LDY.B #$A8                      ; Y = $A8
$0C:CCC8 84 00        STY $00                         ; $00 = X position of the current tile
$0C:CCCA 84 04        STY $04                         ; $04 = X position of the start of a row
$0C:CCCC A9 57        LDA.B #$57
$0C:CCCE 85 02        STA $02                         ; $02 = Y position of the current row = $57
$0C:CCD0 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = OAM index = 0 (OAM slot 1 onwards)
$0C:CCD2 A4 08        LDY $08
$0C:CCD4 B9 9F CC     LDA.W $CC9F,Y                   ; A = tile number from the table
$0C:CCD7 F0 29        BEQ $CD02                       ; Skip this tile if it is 0 (empty cell)
$0C:CCD9 9D 06 02     STA.W $0206,X                   ; OAM tile = A
$0C:CCDC A0 35        LDY.B #$35                      ; Y = OAM prop $35 (priority 3, palette 2)
$0C:CCDE AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440
$0C:CCE1 30 06        BMI $CCE9                       ; Frame $FF: keep palette 2
$0C:CCE3 29 02        AND.B #$02
$0C:CCE5 F0 02        BEQ $CCE9                       ; Palette flash only when bit 1 of the frame is set
$0C:CCE7 A0 39        LDY.B #$39                      ; Y = OAM prop $39 (palette 4)
$0C:CCE9 98           TYA 
$0C:CCEA 9D 07 02     STA.W $0207,X                   ; OAM prop
$0C:CCED A5 00        LDA $00
$0C:CCEF 9D 04 02     STA.W $0204,X                   ; OAM X position = [$00]
$0C:CCF2 A5 02        LDA $02
$0C:CCF4 9D 05 02     STA.W $0205,X                   ; OAM Y position = [$02]
$0C:CCF7 DA           PHX                             ; \
$0C:CCF8 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:CCF9 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CCFA 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CCFB AA           TAX                             ; |
$0C:CCFC A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$0C:CCFE 9D 21 04     STA.W $0421,X                   ; |
$0C:CD01 FA           PLX                             ; } OAM size bit for this slot = 2 (16x16 sprite)
$0C:CD02 E6 08        INC $08                         ; Next table entry
$0C:CD04 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:CD06 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:CD07 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0C:CD09 85 00        STA $00                         ; } [$00] += $10 (next tile to the right)
$0C:CD0B E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:CD0C E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:CD0D E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:CD0E E8           INX                             ; } X += 4 (next OAM slot)
$0C:CD0F E0 0C        CPX.B #$0C                      ; After 3 tiles, start the second row
$0C:CD11 D0 0B        BNE $CD1E
$0C:CD13 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$0C:CD15 85 00        STA $00                         ; } X position = row start [$04]
$0C:CD17 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$0C:CD19 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:CD1A 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0C:CD1C 85 02        STA $02                         ; } Y position [$02] += $10 (next row down)
$0C:CD1E E0 18        CPX.B #$18
$0C:CD20 D0 B0        BNE $CCD2                       ; Loop until 6 tiles (3x2 grid of 16x16) are written
$0C:CD22 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:CD23 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; Cutscene state: scroll screen upward with a shake. X = actor 0 (the camera)
$0C:CD25 A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo
$0C:CD27 C9 C0        CMP.B #$C0                      ; Has the screen Y scroll reached $C0?
$0C:CD29 D0 06        BNE $CD31                       ; No: keep scrolling
$0C:CD2B 64 1A        STZ RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; Yes: stop the shake, layer 1 X scroll = 0
$0C:CD2D 64 1B        STZ RAM_ScreenBndryXHi
$0C:CD2F 80 44        BRA $CD75                       ; Skip to the actor 1 handling

$0C:CD31 9D 41 0B     STA.W $0B41,X                   ; Actor 0 Y position (low) = screen Y scroll (low)
$0C:CD34 A5 1D        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi
$0C:CD36 9D 5F 0B     STA.W $0B5F,X                   ; Actor 0 Y position (high) = screen Y scroll (high)
$0C:CD39 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0
$0C:CD3B 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X                   ; Actor 0 Y speed = $F0 (-1 pixel per frame, 4.4 fixed point)
$0C:CD3E 20 3A D3     JSR.W $D33A                     ; Apply Y speed to actor 0 Y position
$0C:CD41 20 83 D2     JSR.W $D283                     ; Shake: layer 1 X scroll +/- 1 on alternate frames
$0C:CD44 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; 8-bit A
$0C:CD46 BD 5F 0B     LDA.W $0B5F,X
$0C:CD49 85 1D        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; Screen Y scroll (high) = actor 0 Y (high)
$0C:CD4B BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X
$0C:CD4E 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; Screen Y scroll (low) = actor 0 Y (low)
$0C:CD50 C9 FD        CMP.B #$FD                      ; Screen Y = $FD?
$0C:CD52 D0 05        BNE $CD59
$0C:CD54 A9 01        LDA.B #$01
$0C:CD56 8D 44 14     STA.W $1444                     ; Yes: [$1444] = 1 (flag: spawn the falling object sprite)
$0C:CD59 A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo
$0C:CD5B C9 E8        CMP.B #$E8                      ; Screen Y = $E8?
$0C:CD5D D0 03        BNE $CD62
$0C:CD5F 20 C9 D5     JSR.W $D5C9                     ; Yes: advance the sub-scene
$0C:CD62 A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo
$0C:CD64 C9 C0        CMP.B #$C0                      ; Screen Y = $C0 (final position)?
$0C:CD66 D0 0D        BNE $CD75
$0C:CD68 A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; Yes: sound effect $22
$0C:CD6A 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; Play sound effect
$0C:CD6D 20 D0 D1     JSR.W $D1D0                     ; Queue the 2-row tile strip ($D1A7) for upload
$0C:CD70 A9 08        LDA.B #$08
$0C:CD72 8D 06 0B     STA.W $0B06                     ; Actor 1 Y speed = 8
$0C:CD75 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; X = 1: actor 1
$0C:CD77 BD 05 0B     LDA.W $0B05,X                   ; A = actor 1 Y speed
$0C:CD7A 10 09        BPL $CD85
$0C:CD7C BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X                   ; Moving up: keep moving until its Y position < $68
$0C:CD7F C9 68        CMP.B #$68
$0C:CD81 B0 0E        BCS $CD91
$0C:CD83 80 0F        BRA $CD94

$0C:CD85 BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X                   ; Moving down: A = actor 1 Y position
$0C:CD88 C9 78        CMP.B #$78                      ; Reached $78?
$0C:CD8A D0 05        BNE $CD91
$0C:CD8C EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Yes: advance to the next scene state
$0C:CD8F 80 0D        BRA $CD9E                       ; Done

$0C:CD91 20 3A D3     JSR.W $D33A                     ; Apply actor 1 Y speed
$0C:CD94 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0
$0C:CD96 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; Actor 0 X speed = 4
$0C:CD98 9D 14 0B     STA.W $0B14,X
$0C:CD9B 20 68 D3     JSR.W $D368                     ; Apply actor 0 X speed
$0C:CD9E 82 89 00     BRL $CE2A                       ; Go draw
$0C:CDA1 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Cutscene state: screen drops with growing speed and shakes
$0C:CDA3 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; Every 4th frame...
$0C:CDA5 D0 12        BNE $CDB9
$0C:CDA7 AD 47 14     LDA.W $1447                     ; ...increase fall speed [$1447] by 2...
$0C:CDAA 18           CLC 
$0C:CDAB 69 02        ADC.B #$02
$0C:CDAD 8D 47 14     STA.W $1447
$0C:CDB0 C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; ...capped at $7F
$0C:CDB2 90 05        BCC $CDB9
$0C:CDB4 A9 7F        LDA.B #$7F
$0C:CDB6 8D 47 14     STA.W $1447
$0C:CDB9 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: actor 0
$0C:CDBB A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; Actor 0 Y position = screen Y scroll
$0C:CDBD 9D 41 0B     STA.W $0B41,X
$0C:CDC0 A5 1D        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi
$0C:CDC2 9D 5F 0B     STA.W $0B5F,X
$0C:CDC5 AD 47 14     LDA.W $1447                     ; Actor 0 Y speed = [$1447]
$0C:CDC8 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X
$0C:CDCB 20 3A D3     JSR.W $D33A                     ; Apply Y speed
$0C:CDCE BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X
$0C:CDD1 F0 04        BEQ $CDD7                       ; Shake while the screen Y is 0 or below $20
$0C:CDD3 C9 20        CMP.B #$20
$0C:CDD5 B0 03        BCS $CDDA
$0C:CDD7 20 83 D2     JSR.W $D283                     ; Shake: layer 1 X scroll +/- 1
$0C:CDDA BD 5F 0B     LDA.W $0B5F,X                   ; Screen Y scroll = actor 0 Y position
$0C:CDDD 85 1D        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi
$0C:CDDF BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X
$0C:CDE2 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo
$0C:CDE4 F0 09        BEQ $CDEF
$0C:CDE6 C9 20        CMP.B #$20
$0C:CDE8 90 05        BCC $CDEF
$0C:CDEA A9 08        LDA.B #$08
$0C:CDEC 8D 06 0B     STA.W $0B06                     ; At or above $20: actor 1 Y speed = 8
$0C:CDEF BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X
$0C:CDF2 F0 0E        BEQ $CE02                       ; Reached Y position $A8?
$0C:CDF4 C9 A8        CMP.B #$A8
$0C:CDF6 90 0A        BCC $CE02
$0C:CDF8 A9 7F        LDA.B #$7F                      ; Yes: timer [$143F] = $7F
$0C:CDFA 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F
$0C:CDFD EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Advance to the next scene state
$0C:CE00 80 1C        BRA $CE1E

$0C:CE02 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; 8-bit A
$0C:CE04 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; X = 1: actor 1
$0C:CE06 BD 05 0B     LDA.W $0B05,X                   ; A = actor 1 Y speed
$0C:CE09 10 09        BPL $CE14
$0C:CE0B BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X                   ; Moving up: stop once Y position < $68
$0C:CE0E C9 68        CMP.B #$68
$0C:CE10 B0 09        BCS $CE1B
$0C:CE12 80 0A        BRA $CE1E

$0C:CE14 BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X                   ; Moving down: stop once Y position >= $78
$0C:CE17 C9 78        CMP.B #$78
$0C:CE19 B0 03        BCS $CE1E
$0C:CE1B 20 3A D3     JSR.W $D33A                     ; Apply actor 1 Y speed
$0C:CE1E A9 77        LDA.B #$77
$0C:CE20 38           SEC 
$0C:CE21 ED 41 0B     SBC.W $0B41
$0C:CE24 8D 43 0B     STA.W $0B43                     ; [$0B43] = $77 - actor 0 Y: object Y relative to the scrolled screen
$0C:CE27 20 AB CE     JSR.W $CEAB                     ; Draw the spinning object sprite
$0C:CE2A 20 48 CE     JSR.W $CE48                     ; Draw the 4-tile animated row
$0C:CE2D A2 14        LDX.B #$14                      ; X = $14: OAM offset for the 2x2 sprite
$0C:CE2F A9 A8        LDA.B #$A8
$0C:CE31 85 00        STA $00                         ; X position of the 2x2 sprite = $A8
$0C:CE33 85 02        STA $02
$0C:CE35 A9 5F        LDA.B #$5F
$0C:CE37 38           SEC 
$0C:CE38 ED 41 0B     SBC.W $0B41
$0C:CE3B 85 01        STA $01                         ; Y position of the 2x2 sprite = $5F - screen offset
$0C:CE3D 82 C6 FD     BRL $CC06                       ; Draw the 2x2 sprite at ([$00],[$01])


;;; $CE40..CE40: Table: animated 4-tile row frames ;;;
;; Two frames of four 16x16 tile numbers ($80-$83, mirrored); indexed by [$1440]*4.
$0C:CE40              .db $80,$81,$82,$83,$83,$82,$81,$80 ; Frame 0: $80-$83, frame 1: $83-$80 (mirrored)


;;; $CE48: Cutscene: draw animated 4-tile row ;;;
;; Flips [$1440] every 6 frames and draws four 16x16 tiles in a horizontal row from X=$98, Y=[$0B42] (OAM
;;     slots 1-4).
;; Second frame is X-flipped.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:CE2A: Cutscene: castle tiles, scroll and shake states
$0C:CE48 CE 3F 14     DEC.W $143F                     ; Every 6 frames (timer $143F)...
$0C:CE4B 10 0D        BPL $CE5A
$0C:CE4D A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; ...reload timer = 5...
$0C:CE4F 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F
$0C:CE52 AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440
$0C:CE55 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; ...and flip [$1440] between 0 and 1
$0C:CE57 8D 40 14     STA.W $1440
$0C:CE5A A9 98        LDA.B #$98                      ; First tile X position = $98
$0C:CE5C 85 00        STA $00
$0C:CE5E A0 21        LDY.B #$21                      ; OAM prop $21 (palette 0, priority 2)...
$0C:CE60 AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440
$0C:CE63 F0 02        BEQ $CE67
$0C:CE65 A0 61        LDY.B #$61                      ; ...or $61 (X flipped) on the second frame
$0C:CE67 84 04        STY $04                         ; $04 = prop
$0C:CE69 AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440
$0C:CE6C 0A           ASL 
$0C:CE6D 0A           ASL 
$0C:CE6E A8           TAY                             ; Y = [$1440] * 4: row of 4 tiles in $CE40
$0C:CE6F A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = OAM index 0
$0C:CE71 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = X position
$0C:CE73 9D 04 02     STA.W $0204,X                   ; OAM X position
$0C:CE76 AD 42 0B     LDA.W $0B42
$0C:CE79 9D 05 02     STA.W $0205,X                   ; OAM Y position = [$0B42]
$0C:CE7C B9 40 CE     LDA.W $CE40,Y                   ; A = tile from the table
$0C:CE7F 9D 06 02     STA.W $0206,X                   ; OAM tile
$0C:CE82 A5 04        LDA $04
$0C:CE84 9D 07 02     STA.W $0207,X                   ; OAM prop
$0C:CE87 DA           PHX                             ; \
$0C:CE88 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:CE89 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CE8A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CE8B AA           TAX                             ; |
$0C:CE8C A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$0C:CE8E 9D 21 04     STA.W $0421,X                   ; |
$0C:CE91 FA           PLX                             ; } OAM size bit for this slot = 2 (16x16)
$0C:CE92 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:CE94 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:CE95 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0C:CE97 85 00        STA $00                         ; } [$00] += $10: next tile to the right
$0C:CE99 C8           INY                             ; Next tile in the table
$0C:CE9A E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:CE9B E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:CE9C E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:CE9D E8           INX                             ; } X += 4: next OAM slot
$0C:CE9E E0 10        CPX.B #$10
$0C:CEA0 D0 CF        BNE $CE71                       ; Loop until 4 tiles are written
$0C:CEA2 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $CEA3..CEA7: Table: spinning sprite tiles and properties ;;;
;; Tile numbers then OAM props for a 4-frame spin ($25/$65 = X flip).
$0C:CEA3              .db $C6,$C8,$C6,$C8             ; Spin tiles: $C6,$C8,$C6,$C8

$0C:CEA7              .db $25,$25,$65,$65             ; Spin props: $25,$25,$65,$65 (second half X flipped)


;;; $CEAB: Cutscene: draw spinning sprite ;;;
;; Draws one 16x16 sprite at X=$B0, Y=[$0B43] in OAM slot 12, frame advancing every 2 frames.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:CE27: Cutscene: castle tiles, scroll and shake states
$0C:CEAB A2 30        LDX.B #$30                      ; X = $30: OAM slot 12
$0C:CEAD A9 B0        LDA.B #$B0
$0C:CEAF 9D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,X       ; OAM X position = $B0
$0C:CEB2 AD 43 0B     LDA.W $0B43
$0C:CEB5 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; OAM Y position = [$0B43]
$0C:CEB8 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter
$0C:CEBA 29 06        AND.B #$06
$0C:CEBC 4A           LSR 
$0C:CEBD A8           TAY                             ; Y = (frame counter & 6) / 2: animation frame 0..3, changes every 2 frames
$0C:CEBE B9 A3 CE     LDA.W $CEA3,Y
$0C:CEC1 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; OAM tile = $C6 or $C8
$0C:CEC4 B9 A7 CE     LDA.W $CEA7,Y
$0C:CEC7 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; OAM prop: $25 or $65 (X flip), so the object spins
$0C:CECA 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:CECB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CECC 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CECD AA           TAX                             ; } X = OAM slot number
$0C:CECE A9 02        LDA.B #$02
$0C:CED0 9D 20 04     STA.W $0420,X                   ; Size bit = 2 (16x16)
$0C:CED3 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $CED4..CEDB: Tables: animation frame and duration per step ;;;
;; $CED4: [$1440] frame for each sequence step; $CEDB: frame duration (written to [$143F]).
$0C:CED4              .db $02,$FF,$02,$03,$04,$05,$06 ; Frame [$1440] per sequence step: 02,FF(hidden),02,03,04,05,06

$0C:CEDB              .db $03,$01,$07,$07,$07,$07,$07 ; Duration [$143F] per step: 03,01,07,07,07,07,07


;;; $CEE2: Cutscene state: falling object then frame sequence ;;;
;; Moves actor 2 under its Y/X speed while toggling frame; when Y >= $5C it has landed and a table-driven
;;     frame sequence plays ([$1447] = step).
;; Plays sound $08 on step 1; advances the scene state on step 6. Then draws the object via $0CCF49.
$0C:CEE2 AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440                     ; Cutscene state: object falls and bounces, then plays a frame sequence
$0C:CEE5 C9 02        CMP.B #$02
$0C:CEE7 B0 26        BCS $CF0F                       ; [$1440] >= 2: it has landed, go to the sequence
$0C:CEE9 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Falling: toggle [$1440] every other frame
$0C:CEEB 29 01        AND.B #$01
$0C:CEED F0 08        BEQ $CEF7
$0C:CEEF AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440
$0C:CEF2 49 01        EOR.B #$01
$0C:CEF4 8D 40 14     STA.W $1440
$0C:CEF7 A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; X = 2: actor 2
$0C:CEF9 20 3A D3     JSR.W $D33A                     ; Apply actor 2 Y speed
$0C:CEFC 20 68 D3     JSR.W $D368                     ; Apply actor 2 X speed
$0C:CEFF AD 43 0B     LDA.W $0B43                     ; A = Y position of the object
$0C:CF02 C9 5C        CMP.B #$5C                      ; Reached Y position $5C?
$0C:CF04 90 07        BCC $CF0D                       ; No: keep falling
$0C:CF06 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Yes: landed, [$1440] = 2
$0C:CF08 8D 40 14     STA.W $1440
$0C:CF0B 80 02        BRA $CF0F

$0C:CF0D 80 29        BRA $CF38                       ; Draw

$0C:CF0F CE 3F 14     DEC.W $143F                     ; Count down the frame timer
$0C:CF12 10 24        BPL $CF38
$0C:CF14 AD 47 14     LDA.W $1447                     ; Timer expired: step [$1447] to the next entry of the sequence
$0C:CF17 1A           INC A
$0C:CF18 8D 47 14     STA.W $1447
$0C:CF1B AA           TAX 
$0C:CF1C BD D4 CE     LDA.W $CED4,X                   ; A = animation frame for this step ($CED4)
$0C:CF1F 8D 40 14     STA.W $1440                     ; [$1440] = frame
$0C:CF22 BD DB CE     LDA.W $CEDB,X                   ; A = duration for this step ($CEDB)
$0C:CF25 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F                     ; [$143F] = timer
$0C:CF28 E0 01        CPX.B #$01                      ; Step 1?
$0C:CF2A D0 05        BNE $CF31
$0C:CF2C A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; Sound effect $08
$0C:CF2E 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; Play sound effect
$0C:CF31 E0 06        CPX.B #$06                      ; Step 6 (last)?
$0C:CF33 D0 03        BNE $CF38
$0C:CF35 20 C6 D5     JSR.W $D5C6                     ; Advance to the next scene state
$0C:CF38 82 0E 00     BRL $CF49                       ; Draw


;;; $CF3B..CF42: Tables: landed object tiles and properties ;;;
;; Tile numbers and OAM props, indexed by [$1440] (0-6).
$0C:CF3B              .db $B7,$B8,$89,$99,$A9,$B9,$E8 ; Tiles by frame 0-6: B7,B8,89,99,A9,B9,E8

$0C:CF42              .db $25,$25,$23,$23,$23,$23,$23 ; Props by frame 0-6: $25,$25, then $23 x5


;;; $CF49: Cutscene: draw object and wait states ;;;
;; $0CCF49: draws an 8x8 sprite at X=[$0B52], Y=[$0B43] using [$1440] (hidden when $FF).
;; $0CCF72: state - waits through four 4-frame animation steps, then advances. $0CCFC5 is a sibling wait
;;     state.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:CA15: Pointer table: cutscene 5 states; cutscene 4 (Ptrs0CC9F0)
$0C:CF49 AC 40 14     LDY.W $1440                     ; Y = [$1440] (frame, $FF = hidden)
$0C:CF4C C0 FF        CPY.B #$FF
$0C:CF4E F0 21        BEQ $CF71                       ; Nothing to draw when hidden
$0C:CF50 A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4: OAM slot 1
$0C:CF52 AD 52 0B     LDA.W $0B52
$0C:CF55 9D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,X       ; OAM X position = [$0B52]
$0C:CF58 AD 43 0B     LDA.W $0B43
$0C:CF5B 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; OAM Y position = [$0B43]
$0C:CF5E B9 3B CF     LDA.W $CF3B,Y                   ; A = tile ($CF3B)
$0C:CF61 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; OAM tile
$0C:CF64 B9 42 CF     LDA.W $CF42,Y                   ; A = prop ($CF42)
$0C:CF67 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; OAM prop
$0C:CF6A 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:CF6B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CF6C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CF6D AA           TAX                             ; } X = OAM slot number
$0C:CF6E 9E 20 04     STZ.W $0420,X                   ; Size bit = 0 (8x8)
$0C:CF71 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:CF72 CE 3F 14     DEC.W $143F                     ; Scene state: wait 4 animation frames. Count down timer
$0C:CF75 10 14        BPL $CF8B
$0C:CF77 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; Reload timer = 3...
$0C:CF79 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F
$0C:CF7C EE 40 14     INC.W $1440                     ; ...and advance animation frame
$0C:CF7F AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440
$0C:CF82 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; After 4 frames...
$0C:CF84 D0 05        BNE $CF8B
$0C:CF86 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; ...advance to the next scene state
$0C:CF89 80 05        BRA $CF90

$0C:CF8B A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4: OAM slot 1
$0C:CF8D 20 A3 CF     JSR.W $CFA3                     ; Draw the sprite for the current frame
$0C:CF90 A2 08        LDX.B #$08                      ; X = 8: OAM offset for the 2x2 sprite
$0C:CF92 A9 A8        LDA.B #$A8
$0C:CF94 85 00        STA $00                         ; X position = $A8
$0C:CF96 85 02        STA $02
$0C:CF98 A9 5F        LDA.B #$5F
$0C:CF9A 85 01        STA $01                         ; Y position = $5F
$0C:CF9C 82 67 FC     BRL $CC06                       ; Draw the 2x2 sprite


;;; $CF9F..CF9F: Table: sprite tile numbers ;;;
;; Four 16x16 tile numbers indexed by [$1440].
$0C:CF9F              .db $60,$62,$64,$66             ; Tiles for frames 0-3: 60,62,64,66


;;; $CFA3: Cutscene: sprite draw, exit and sub-scene states ;;;
;; $0CCFA3: draws a 16x16 sprite at ($AC,$63) with tile from $CF9F (quirk: tile number is also used as
;;     the OAM prop).
;; $0CCFC5/$0CCFF7: wait states. $0CCFDE: final state, once [$1443] and [$144D] are 0, any of B/Y/A/X resets
;;     the state and sets game mode $0B.
;; $0CD003: state driven by sub-scene [$143E] (timers, layer 1 X shake, castle sprite counter-shifted against
;;     the shake).
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:CF8D: Cutscene: draw object and wait states
$0C:CFA3 AC 40 14     LDY.W $1440                     ; Y = [$1440]
$0C:CFA6 B9 9F CF     LDA.W $CF9F,Y                   ; A = tile from $CF9F
$0C:CFA9 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; OAM tile
$0C:CFAC A0 21        LDY.B #$21                      ; Y = $21 (unused: the tile number is stored as the prop below)
$0C:CFAE 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; OAM prop = tile number (looks like a bug)
$0C:CFB1 A9 AC        LDA.B #$AC
$0C:CFB3 9D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,X       ; OAM X position = $AC
$0C:CFB6 A9 63        LDA.B #$63
$0C:CFB8 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; OAM Y position = $63
$0C:CFBB 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:CFBC 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CFBD 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:CFBE AA           TAX                             ; } X = OAM slot number
$0C:CFBF A9 02        LDA.B #$02
$0C:CFC1 9D 20 04     STA.W $0420,X                   ; Size bit = 2 (16x16)
$0C:CFC4 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:CFC5 AD 45 14     LDA.W $1445                     ; Scene state: A = [$1445]
$0C:CFC8 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; Is it 3?
$0C:CFCA F0 07        BEQ $CFD3
$0C:CFCC A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; No: timer [$143F] = 8 and keep waiting
$0C:CFCE 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F
$0C:CFD1 80 08        BRA $CFDB

$0C:CFD3 CE 3F 14     DEC.W $143F                     ; Yes: count down the timer
$0C:CFD6 10 03        BPL $CFDB
$0C:CFD8 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Timer expired: advance to the next scene state
$0C:CFDB 82 B2 FF     BRL $CF90                       ; Draw
$0C:CFDE AD 43 14     LDA.W $1443                     ; Final state: wait for [$1443] and [$144D] to be zero
$0C:CFE1 0D 4D 14     ORA.W $144D                     ; (text and fade finished)
$0C:CFE4 D0 10        BNE $CFF6
$0C:CFE6 A5 16        LDA $16                         ; Check controller 1: B, Y (byetUDLR) or A, X (axlr) pressed
$0C:CFE8 05 18        ORA $18
$0C:CFEA 29 C0        AND.B #$C0
$0C:CFEC F0 08        BEQ $CFF6                       ; None pressed: stay here
$0C:CFEE 9C 42 14     STZ.W $1442                     ; Reset the scene state
$0C:CFF1 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; Game mode = $0B (leave the cutscene)
$0C:CFF3 8D 00 01     STA.W RAM_GameMode
$0C:CFF6 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:CFF7 AD 43 14     LDA.W $1443                     ; Scene state: advance once [$1443] is set, then fall into the exit check
$0C:CFFA F0 06        BEQ $D002
$0C:CFFC EE 42 14     INC.W $1442
$0C:CFFF 82 DC FF     BRL $CFDE                       ; Go to the exit check
$0C:D002 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D003 AD 3E 14     LDA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; Scene state driven by [$143E] (sub-scene number)
$0C:D006 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Sub-scene 1?
$0C:D008 F0 2A        BEQ $D034
$0C:D00A C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Sub-scene 2?
$0C:D00C F0 0B        BEQ $D019
$0C:D00E C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; Sub-scene 3?
$0C:D010 F0 2C        BEQ $D03E
$0C:D012 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; Sub-scene 0: timer [$143F] = $10
$0C:D014 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F
$0C:D017 80 2D        BRA $D046

$0C:D019 AD 3F 14     LDA.W $143F                     ; Sub-scene 2: while the timer is >= 8, draw the puff effect
$0C:D01C 29 F8        AND.B #$F8
$0C:D01E F0 03        BEQ $D023
$0C:D020 20 69 D0     JSR.W $D069                     ; Draw the 2x2 effect at Mario's position
$0C:D023 20 83 D2     JSR.W $D283                     ; Shake the screen
$0C:D026 CE 3F 14     DEC.W $143F                     ; Count down
$0C:D029 10 1B        BPL $D046
$0C:D02B 9C 3E 14     STZ.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; Timer expired: sub-scene = 0
$0C:D02E 64 1A        STZ RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; Layer 1 X scroll = 0
$0C:D030 64 1B        STZ RAM_ScreenBndryXHi
$0C:D032 80 12        BRA $D046

$0C:D034 A9 3F        LDA.B #$3F                      ; Sub-scene 1: timer = $3F
$0C:D036 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F
$0C:D039 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; Sub-scene = 3
$0C:D03B 8D 3E 14     STA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum
$0C:D03E CE 3F 14     DEC.W $143F                     ; Sub-scene 3: count down the timer
$0C:D041 10 03        BPL $D046
$0C:D043 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Timer expired: advance to the next scene state
$0C:D046 A2 A8        LDX.B #$A8                      ; X position of the 2x2 sprite = $A8
$0C:D048 A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; Compensate the shake: layer 1 X scroll shifts the sprite the opposite way
$0C:D04A F0 08        BEQ $D054
$0C:D04C 10 04        BPL $D052
$0C:D04E A2 A9        LDX.B #$A9                      ; Scroll < 0: X = $A9
$0C:D050 80 02        BRA $D054

$0C:D052 A2 A7        LDX.B #$A7                      ; Scroll > 0: X = $A7
$0C:D054 86 00        STX $00
$0C:D056 86 02        STX $02
$0C:D058 A9 5F        LDA.B #$5F                      ; Y position = $5F
$0C:D05A 85 01        STA $01
$0C:D05C A2 08        LDX.B #$08                      ; X = 8: OAM offset
$0C:D05E 82 A5 FB     BRL $CC06                       ; Draw the 2x2 sprite


;;; $D061..D065: Table: puff effect tiles and properties ;;;
;; Four 8x8 tiles ($7C,$7D,$7D,$7C) with props $30/$F0 (lower pair flipped).
$0C:D061              .db $7C,$7D,$7D,$7C             ; Tiles: 7C,7D,7D,7C

$0C:D065              .db $30,$30,$F0,$F0             ; Props: 30,30,F0,F0 (bottom pair X and Y flipped)


;;; $D069: Cutscene: effects near Mario and scroll states ;;;
;; $0CD069: draws a 2x2 group of 8x8 pieces at Mario X/Y + $10 (OAM slots 1-4).
;; $0CD0BC-$0CD19C: scene states keyed to [$143E]: scroll screen down, ease screen and puff effect ($1A
;;     sound), layer 2 Y shake.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:D020: Cutscene: sprite draw, exit and sub-scene states
;;     $0C:D11B: Cutscene: effects near Mario and scroll states
$0C:D069 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: piece index
$0C:D06B A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4: OAM slot 1
$0C:D06D A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos
$0C:D06F 18           CLC 
$0C:D070 69 10        ADC.B #$10
$0C:D072 85 00        STA $00                         ; $00, $02 = Mario X + $10
$0C:D074 85 02        STA $02
$0C:D076 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos
$0C:D078 18           CLC 
$0C:D079 69 10        ADC.B #$10
$0C:D07B 85 01        STA $01                         ; $01 = Mario Y + $10
$0C:D07D A5 00        LDA $00
$0C:D07F 9D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,X       ; OAM X position
$0C:D082 A5 01        LDA $01
$0C:D084 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; OAM Y position
$0C:D087 B9 61 D0     LDA.W $D061,Y                   ; A = tile ($7C,$7D,$7D,$7C)
$0C:D08A 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; OAM tile
$0C:D08D B9 65 D0     LDA.W $D065,Y                   ; A = prop ($30,$30,$F0,$F0: bottom pieces flipped X and Y)
$0C:D090 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; OAM prop
$0C:D093 DA           PHX                             ; \
$0C:D094 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:D095 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D096 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D097 AA           TAX                             ; |
$0C:D098 9E 20 04     STZ.W $0420,X                   ; |
$0C:D09B FA           PLX                             ; } Size bit = 0 (8x8)
$0C:D09C A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:D09E 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D09F 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$0C:D0A1 85 00        STA $00                         ; } [$00] += 8: next piece to the right
$0C:D0A3 C8           INY                             ; Next piece
$0C:D0A4 C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; After 2 pieces, start the lower row
$0C:D0A6 D0 0B        BNE $D0B3
$0C:D0A8 A5 02        LDA $02
$0C:D0AA 85 00        STA $00
$0C:D0AC A5 01        LDA $01
$0C:D0AE 18           CLC 
$0C:D0AF 69 08        ADC.B #$08
$0C:D0B1 85 01        STA $01                         ; [$01] += 8: next row
$0C:D0B3 E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:D0B4 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:D0B5 E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:D0B6 E8           INX                             ; } X += 4: next OAM slot
$0C:D0B7 C0 04        CPY.B #$04
$0C:D0B9 D0 C2        BNE $D07D                       ; Loop until 4 pieces are written
$0C:D0BB 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D0BC AD 3E 14     LDA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; Scene state: if sub-scene = 1, advance
$0C:D0BF C9 01        CMP.B #$01
$0C:D0C1 D0 03        BNE $D0C6
$0C:D0C3 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Advance to the next scene state
$0C:D0C6 82 C7 FE     BRL $CF90                       ; Draw
$0C:D0C9 AD 3E 14     LDA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; Scene state: if a sub-scene is running...
$0C:D0CC F0 03        BEQ $D0D1
$0C:D0CE 20 C6 D5     JSR.W $D5C6                     ; ...advance to the next scene state
$0C:D0D1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D0D2 AD 3E 14     LDA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; Scene state (sub-scene 1 only): scroll screen down at speed 8
$0C:D0D5 C9 01        CMP.B #$01
$0C:D0D7 D0 2E        BNE $D107
$0C:D0D9 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: actor 0
$0C:D0DB A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; Actor 0 Y position = screen Y scroll
$0C:D0DD 9D 41 0B     STA.W $0B41,X
$0C:D0E0 A5 1D        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi
$0C:D0E2 9D 5F 0B     STA.W $0B5F,X
$0C:D0E5 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; Actor 0 Y speed = 8
$0C:D0E7 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X
$0C:D0EA 20 3A D3     JSR.W $D33A                     ; Apply Y speed
$0C:D0ED BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X
$0C:D0F0 F0 0E        BEQ $D100                       ; Y position 0 or < 9: just store it
$0C:D0F2 C9 09        CMP.B #$09
$0C:D0F4 90 0A        BCC $D100
$0C:D0F6 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Moved far enough: advance to the next scene state
$0C:D0F9 A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; [$1447] = $28 (starting speed for the next state)
$0C:D0FB 8D 47 14     STA.W $1447
$0C:D0FE 80 07        BRA $D107                       ; Done

$0C:D100 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; Screen Y scroll = actor 0 Y position
$0C:D102 BD 5F 0B     LDA.W $0B5F,X
$0C:D105 85 1D        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi
$0C:D107 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D108 AD 3E 14     LDA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; Scene state (sub-scene 2 only): screen drifts and puff effect
$0C:D10B C9 02        CMP.B #$02
$0C:D10D D0 5F        BNE $D16E
$0C:D10F CE 47 14     DEC.W $1447                     ; [$1447] -= 1 (acts as timer and Y speed)
$0C:D112 AD 47 14     LDA.W $1447
$0C:D115 30 07        BMI $D11E                       ; Negative: no puff
$0C:D117 C9 24        CMP.B #$24                      ; Below $24: no puff
$0C:D119 90 03        BCC $D11E
$0C:D11B 20 69 D0     JSR.W $D069                     ; Draw the puff effect near Mario
$0C:D11E AD 47 14     LDA.W $1447
$0C:D121 C9 C8        CMP.B #$C8                      ; Reached $C8 (-56)?
$0C:D123 D0 0E        BNE $D133
$0C:D125 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; Yes: timer [$143F] = $40
$0C:D127 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F
$0C:D12A A9 1A        LDA.B #$1A                      ; Sound effect $1A
$0C:D12C 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; Play sound effect
$0C:D12F EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Advance to the next scene state
$0C:D132 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D133 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: actor 0
$0C:D135 A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; Actor 0 position = screen scroll
$0C:D137 9D 41 0B     STA.W $0B41,X
$0C:D13A A5 1D        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi
$0C:D13C 9D 5F 0B     STA.W $0B5F,X
$0C:D13F A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo
$0C:D141 9D 50 0B     STA.W $0B50,X
$0C:D144 A5 1B        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi
$0C:D146 9D 6E 0B     STA.W $0B6E,X
$0C:D149 AD 47 14     LDA.W $1447                     ; Actor 0 Y speed = [$1447]
$0C:D14C 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X
$0C:D14F A9 E8        LDA.B #$E8                      ; Actor 0 X speed = $E8 (about -1.5 pixels per frame)
$0C:D151 9D 14 0B     STA.W $0B14,X
$0C:D154 20 3A D3     JSR.W $D33A                     ; Apply Y speed
$0C:D157 20 68 D3     JSR.W $D368                     ; Apply X speed
$0C:D15A BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X                   ; Screen scroll = actor 0 position
$0C:D15D 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo
$0C:D15F BD 5F 0B     LDA.W $0B5F,X
$0C:D162 85 1D        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi
$0C:D164 BD 50 0B     LDA.W $0B50,X
$0C:D167 85 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo
$0C:D169 BD 6E 0B     LDA.W $0B6E,X
$0C:D16C 85 1B        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi
$0C:D16E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D16F A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; Scene state: shake layer 2 Y position by +/- 1 every other frame
$0C:D171 29 02        AND.B #$02
$0C:D173 F0 0E        BEQ $D183
$0C:D175 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; 16-bit A
$0C:D177 A5 20        LDA $20                         ; Layer 2 Y position -= 1
$0C:D179 38           SEC 
$0C:D17A E9 01 00     SBC.W #$0001
$0C:D17D 85 20        STA $20
$0C:D17F E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; 8-bit A
$0C:D181 80 0C        BRA $D18F

$0C:D183 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; 16-bit A
$0C:D185 A5 20        LDA $20                         ; Layer 2 Y position += 1
$0C:D187 18           CLC 
$0C:D188 69 01 00     ADC.W #$0001
$0C:D18B 85 20        STA $20
$0C:D18D E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; 8-bit A
$0C:D18F CE 3F 14     DEC.W $143F                     ; Count down the timer
$0C:D192 10 07        BPL $D19B
$0C:D194 64 20        STZ $20                         ; Timer expired: layer 2 Y position = 0
$0C:D196 64 21        STZ $21
$0C:D198 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Advance to the next scene state
$0C:D19B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D19C AD 3E 14     LDA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; Scene state: if sub-scene = 3, advance
$0C:D19F C9 03        CMP.B #$03
$0C:D1A1 D0 03        BNE $D1A6
$0C:D1A3 20 C6 D5     JSR.W $D5C6                     ; Advance to the next scene state
$0C:D1A6 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $D1A7..D1CF: Stripe image data: two rows of 8 tiles ;;;
;; Stripe format: VRAM address (hi,lo), flags/length (hi,lo; length-1), then tile/prop byte pairs; $FF ends
;;     the data.
;; Two rows at VRAM $20B3 and $20D3, each 8 tiles (C0-C5 / D0-D5 with mirrored ends).
$0C:D1A7              .db $20,$B3,$00,$0F,$C0,$01,$C1,$01 ; VRAM $20B3, flags 0, length-1 = $0F: 8 tile+prop pairs C0..C5, flipped C1, C0
$0C:D1AF              .db $C2,$01,$C3,$01,$C4,$01,$C5,$01 ; tiles C2..C5 (prop 01)
$0C:D1B7              .db $C1,$41,$C0,$41,$20,$D3,$00,$0F ; flipped C1, C0 (prop 41); next: VRAM $20D3, length 16 (second row)
$0C:D1BF              .db $D0,$01,$D1,$01,$D2,$01,$D3,$01 ; tiles D0..D3 (prop 01)
$0C:D1C7              .db $D4,$01,$D5,$01,$D1,$41,$D0,$41 ; tiles D4, D5, then flipped D1, D0; $FF ends the stripe
$0C:D1CF              .db $FF


;;; $D1D0: Queue tile strip for upload ;;;
;; Copies the 41 bytes of $D1A7 into the stripe image buffer at $7F837D (indexed by [$7F837B]) and
;;     advances the index by $28.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:CD6D: Cutscene: castle tiles, scroll and shake states
$0C:D1D0 A0 28        LDY.B #$28                      ; Y = $28: index of the last byte of the strip
$0C:D1D2 98           TYA 
$0C:D1D3 18           CLC 
$0C:D1D4 6F 7B 83 7F  ADC.L $7F837B                   ; X = Y + [$7F837B] (current end of the upload buffer)
$0C:D1D8 AA           TAX 
$0C:D1D9 B9 A7 D1     LDA.W $D1A7,Y                   ; A = strip byte
$0C:D1DC 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; Copy to the stripe buffer at $7F837D
$0C:D1E0 CA           DEX 
$0C:D1E1 88           DEY 
$0C:D1E2 10 F5        BPL $D1D9                       ; Copy all 41 bytes backwards
$0C:D1E4 A9 28        LDA.B #$28
$0C:D1E6 18           CLC 
$0C:D1E7 6F 7B 83 7F  ADC.L $7F837B
$0C:D1EB 8F 7B 83 7F  STA.L $7F837B                   ; Buffer index += $28 (the $FF terminator is overwritten next time)
$0C:D1EF 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $D1F0..D1F8: Stripe image data: three-tile RLE row ;;;
;; VRAM $20F4 then $2114: RLE (flag $40) runs of 3 tiles $F8 with prop $00; terminated with $FF.
$0C:D1F0              .db $20,$F4,$40,$02,$F8,$00,$21,$14 ; VRAM $20F4, RLE flag $40, length-1 = 2: 3 tiles $F8 (prop $00); next VRAM $2114
$0C:D1F8              .db $40,$02,$F8,$00,$FF         ; RLE 3 x tile $F8 prop $00; $FF ends the stripe


;;; $D1FD..D227: Table: VRAM addresses for three columns ;;;
;; VRAM tilemap addresses, 8 rows each ($20 apart), for columns at $20F4, $20F6 and $20F8 (24 entries).
$0C:D1FD              .db $20,$F4                     ; VRAM address $20F4 (first column of 8 tiles)

$0C:D1FF              .db $21,$14,$21,$34,$21,$54,$21,$74 ; VRAM addresses $2114,$2134,...: rows down the column (step $20 = one row)
$0C:D207              .db $21,$94,$21,$B4,$21,$D4,$20,$F6 ; $2194,$21B4,$21D4, then next column $20F6
$0C:D20F              .db $21,$16,$21,$36,$21,$56,$21,$76 ; $2116,$2136,$2156,$2176 (column 2)
$0C:D217              .db $21,$96,$21,$B6,$21,$D6,$20,$F8 ; $2196,$21B6,$21D6, then next column $20F8
$0C:D21F              .db $21,$18,$21,$38,$21,$58,$21,$78 ; $2118,$2138,$2158,$2178 (column 3)
$0C:D227              .db $21,$98,$21,$B8,$21,$D8     ; $2198,$21B8,$21D8


;;; $D22D: Cutscene scene steps and object motion ;;;
;; Helpers for the credits/cutscene engine (scene handlers dispatched by [$13C6] and [$1442]) (state in
;;     [$1440]-[$144D], actor objects in $0B05-$0B8C).
;; $0CD22D queues a 13-byte stripe image (VRAM update) and patches two tile words in it.
;; $0CD283 shakes the screen +/-1 pixel on layer 1 X every frame. $0CD295-$0CD317 are scene-step handlers:
;;     play a sound,
;; set timers/objects, advance [$1442] and jump to a CCxxx handler. $0CD33A moves object X in Y by its speed
;;     (1/16 pixel
;; units); $0CD368 does the same for X. $0CD373 clears the subpixel bytes of objects 0-2 (quirk: $0B34 cleared
;;     twice).
;; Object arrays (index = object): Y speed $0B05, X speed $0B14, Y/X subpixel $0B23/$0B32, Y/X pos
;;     $0B41/$0B50, hi $0B5F/$0B6E.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:D756: Draw three-tile sprite and move rope column
$0C:D22D AF 7B 83 7F  LDA.L $7F837B                   ; \
$0C:D231 85 01        STA $01                         ; } [$01] = current stripe image buffer index [$7F837B]
$0C:D233 A0 0C        LDY.B #$0C                      ; \
$0C:D235 98           TYA                             ; |
$0C:D236 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D237 6F 7B 83 7F  ADC.L $7F837B                   ; |
$0C:D23B AA           TAX                             ; |
$0C:D23C B9 F0 D1     LDA.W $D1F0,Y                   ; |
$0C:D23F 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; |
$0C:D243 CA           DEX                             ; |
$0C:D244 88           DEY                             ; } Copy 13-byte template $D1F0 into the stripe buffer at $7F837D + index
$0C:D245 10 F5        BPL $D23C                       ; /
$0C:D247 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$0C:D249 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D24A 6F 7B 83 7F  ADC.L $7F837B                   ; } Advance the stripe image index by 12 bytes
$0C:D24E 8F 7B 83 7F  STA.L $7F837B                   ; /
$0C:D252 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$0C:D254 38           SEC                             ; |
$0C:D255 E9 A0        SBC.B #$A0                      ; } [$00] = Mario X - $A0
$0C:D257 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0C:D259 AD 46 14     LDA.W $1446                     ; \
$0C:D25C 38           SEC                             ; |
$0C:D25D E9 38        SBC.B #$38                      ; |
$0C:D25F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D260 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D261 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D262 65 00        ADC $00                         ; } Y = ([$1446] - $38) / 4 + [$00]: select which tile-word pair to patch in
$0C:D264 A8           TAY                             ; /
$0C:D265 A6 01        LDX $01                         ; X = start of the entry just written
$0C:D267 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; 16-bit accumulator
$0C:D269 B9 FD D1     LDA.W $D1FD,Y                   ; \
$0C:D26C 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; } Patch first tile word in the entry from $D1FD[Y]
$0C:D270 B9 FF D1     LDA.W $D1FF,Y                   ; \
$0C:D273 9F 83 83 7F  STA.L $7F8383,X                 ; } Patch second tile word (entry + 6) from $D1FF[Y]
$0C:D277 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; 8-bit accumulator
$0C:D279 C0 1C        CPY.B #$1C                      ; Last patch index ($1C)?
$0C:D27B D0 05        BNE $D282                       ; No: return
$0C:D27D A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0C:D27F 8D 44 14     STA.W $1444                     ; } [$1444] = 1: flag that the final patch was queued
$0C:D282 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D283 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; 16-bit accumulator
$0C:D285 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$0C:D287 29 01 00     AND.W #$0001                    ; } Test frame counter bit 0
$0C:D28A F0 04        BEQ $D290                       ; Even frame: scroll left
$0C:D28C E6 1A        INC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; Odd frame: layer 1 X scroll += 1
$0C:D28E 80 02        BRA $D292                       ; Done

$0C:D290 C6 1A        DEC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; Even frame: layer 1 X scroll -= 1 (screen shakes +/-1 pixel)
$0C:D292 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; 8-bit accumulator
$0C:D294 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D295 A9 1A        LDA.B #$1A                      ; \
$0C:D297 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; } Play sound effect $1A
$0C:D29A A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$0C:D29C 8D 40 14     STA.W $1440                     ; } [$1440] = $FF (timer)
$0C:D29F A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$0C:D2A1 8D 41 14     STA.W $1441                     ; } [$1441] = $30
$0C:D2A4 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0C:D2A6 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F                     ; } [$143F] = 1 (countdown)
$0C:D2A9 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Next scene step ([$1442]++)
$0C:D2AC 20 FA CB     JSR.W $CBFA                     ; Reset the state shared by scene steps
$0C:D2AF 82 9F F9     BRL $CC51                       ; Continue in the CCC51 handler
$0C:D2B2 A9 21        LDA.B #$21                      ; \
$0C:D2B4 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; } Play sound effect $21 (port $1DF9)
$0C:D2B7 20 1A D3     JSR.W $D31A                     ; Set up actor objects 0 and 1 and timers
$0C:D2BA 82 66 FA     BRL $CD23                       ; Continue in the CCD23 handler
$0C:D2BD A9 17        LDA.B #$17                      ; \
$0C:D2BF 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; } Play sound effect $17
$0C:D2C2 A9 77        LDA.B #$77                      ; \
$0C:D2C4 8D 43 0B     STA.W $0B43                     ; } Object 2 Y position = $77
$0C:D2C7 9C 47 14     STZ.W $1447                     ; [$1447] = 0
$0C:D2CA 20 1A D3     JSR.W $D31A                     ; Set up actor objects 0 and 1 and timers
$0C:D2CD 82 D1 FA     BRL $CDA1                       ; Continue in the CCDA1 handler
$0C:D2D0 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$0C:D2D2 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F                     ; } [$143F] = 3 (countdown)
$0C:D2D5 9C 40 14     STZ.W $1440                     ; [$1440] = 0
$0C:D2D8 A9 19        LDA.B #$19                      ; \
$0C:D2DA 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; } Play sound effect $19
$0C:D2DD EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Next scene step
$0C:D2E0 20 FA CB     JSR.W $CBFA                     ; Reset the state shared by scene steps
$0C:D2E3 82 8C FC     BRL $CF72                       ; Continue in the CCF72 handler
$0C:D2E6 CE 3F 14     DEC.W $143F                     ; Count down [$143F]
$0C:D2E9 30 01        BMI $D2EC                       ; Went negative: do the step below
$0C:D2EB 60           RTS                             ; Not yet: return

$0C:D2EC 20 73 D3     JSR.W $D373                     ; Clear subpixel positions of objects 0-2
$0C:D2EF A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$0C:D2F1 8D 43 0B     STA.W $0B43                     ; } Object 2 Y position = $0F
$0C:D2F4 9C 61 0B     STZ.W $0B61                     ; Object 2 Y high byte = 0
$0C:D2F7 A9 90        LDA.B #$90                      ; \
$0C:D2F9 8D 52 0B     STA.W $0B52                     ; } Object 2 X position = $90
$0C:D2FC 9C 70 0B     STZ.W $0B70                     ; Object 2 X high byte = 0
$0C:D2FF A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$0C:D301 8D 07 0B     STA.W $0B07                     ; } Object 2 Y speed = 8 (moving down)
$0C:D304 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$0C:D306 8D 16 0B     STA.W $0B16                     ; } Object 2 X speed = $FF (-1, moving left)
$0C:D309 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0C:D30B 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F                     ; } [$143F] = 2
$0C:D30E 9C 40 14     STZ.W $1440                     ; [$1440] = 0
$0C:D311 9C 47 14     STZ.W $1447                     ; [$1447] = 0
$0C:D314 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Next scene step
$0C:D317 82 C8 FB     BRL $CEE2                       ; Continue in the CCEE2 handler
$0C:D31A A9 77        LDA.B #$77                      ; \
$0C:D31C 8D 42 0B     STA.W $0B42                     ; } Object 1 Y position = $77
$0C:D31F A9 5F        LDA.B #$5F                      ; \
$0C:D321 8D 50 0B     STA.W $0B50                     ; } Object 0 X position = $5F
$0C:D324 A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; \
$0C:D326 8D 06 0B     STA.W $0B06                     ; } Object 1 Y speed = $F8 (-8, moving up)
$0C:D329 9C 40 14     STZ.W $1440                     ; [$1440] = 0
$0C:D32C A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$0C:D32E 8D 3F 14     STA.W $143F                     ; } [$143F] = 5
$0C:D331 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Next scene step
$0C:D334 20 73 D3     JSR.W $D373                     ; Clear subpixel positions of objects 0-2
$0C:D337 82 C0 F8     BRL $CBFA                       ; Reset the state shared by scene steps
$0C:D33A BD 05 0B     LDA.W $0B05,X                   ; \
$0C:D33D 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:D33E 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:D33F 0A           ASL                             ; } A = Y speed * 16 (fractional part of this frame's movement)
$0C:D340 0A           ASL                             ; /
$0C:D341 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:D342 7D 23 0B     ADC.W $0B23,X                   ; } Y subpixel += A; carry saved for the high part
$0C:D345 9D 23 0B     STA.W $0B23,X                   ; /
$0C:D348 08           PHP                             ; Save the subpixel carry
$0C:D349 BD 05 0B     LDA.W $0B05,X                   ; \
$0C:D34C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D34D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D34E 4A           LSR                             ; } A = Y speed / 16 (whole pixels)
$0C:D34F 4A           LSR                             ; /
$0C:D350 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Speed >= 8: negative after the shift
$0C:D352 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (high byte of movement for a positive speed)
$0C:D354 90 03        BCC $D359                       ; Positive
$0C:D356 09 F0        ORA.B #$F0                      ; Sign-extend the pixel part (A |= $F0)
$0C:D358 88           DEY                             ; Y = $FF (high byte of movement for a negative speed)
$0C:D359 28           PLP                             ; Restore the subpixel carry
$0C:D35A 7D 41 0B     ADC.W $0B41,X                   ; \
$0C:D35D 9D 41 0B     STA.W $0B41,X                   ; } Y position += pixel movement + carry
$0C:D360 98           TYA                             ; \
$0C:D361 7D 5F 0B     ADC.W $0B5F,X                   ; } Y position high byte += sign extension + carry
$0C:D364 9D 5F 0B     STA.W $0B5F,X                   ; /
$0C:D367 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D368 DA           PHX                             ; \
$0C:D369 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:D36A 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D36B 69 0F        ADC.B #$0F                      ; |
$0C:D36D AA           TAX                             ; } Same movement for X: run the move routine with X += $0F (X speed/position arrays)
$0C:D36E 20 3A D3     JSR.W $D33A                     ; /
$0C:D371 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$0C:D372 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D373 9C 23 0B     STZ.W $0B23                     ; \
$0C:D376 9C 32 0B     STZ.W $0B32                     ; |
$0C:D379 9C 24 0B     STZ.W $0B24                     ; |
$0C:D37C 9C 33 0B     STZ.W $0B33                     ; |
$0C:D37F 9C 34 0B     STZ.W $0B34                     ; } Clear the subpixel bytes of objects 0-2 (note: $0B34 cleared twice, $0B25 never)
$0C:D382 9C 34 0B     STZ.W $0B34                     ; /
$0C:D385 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $D386..D38E: Table: debris initial Y speeds ;;;
$0C:D386              .db $C8,$C0,$C4,$C8,$C0,$B4,$C8,$B8 ; Debris initial Y speeds, slots 0-7 (negative = up)
$0C:D38E              .db $C6,$B7,$C4,$B0,$C8,$C0,$C8,$C4 ; Debris initial Y speeds, slots 8-15

;;; $D396..D39E: Table: debris initial X speeds ;;;
$0C:D396              .db $18,$F8,$0A,$20,$E8,$1A,$EA,$08 ; Debris initial X speeds, slots 0-7
$0C:D39E              .db $F0,$18,$E0,$2A,$F8,$20,$FA,$18 ; Debris initial X speeds, slots 8-15


;;; $D3A6: Spawn and move falling debris ;;;
;; $0CD3A6: every other frame while 1 <= [$1445] <= $E7, take a free slot (14 down to 4) and launch a piece of
;;     debris
;; near Mario (+$18,+$20) with speeds from the two tables and gravity 4. $0CD3F4: apply gravity (up to speed
;;     $40),
;; move each active piece, free it when Y >= $80. Falls through into the draw routine at $0CD425.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:CA3C: Pointer table: cutscene 4 states; cutscene 3 (Ptrs0CCA1F)
$0C:D3A6 AD 45 14     LDA.W $1445                     ; \
$0C:D3A9 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$0C:D3AA C9 E7        CMP.B #$E7                      ; } Skip unless 1 <= [$1445] <= $E7 (scene timer window)
$0C:D3AC B0 45        BCS $D3F3                       ; /
$0C:D3AE A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$0C:D3B0 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Only spawn on even frames
$0C:D3B2 D0 3F        BNE $D3F3                       ; /
$0C:D3B4 A2 0E        LDX.B #$0E                      ; X = 14: look for a free debris slot (slots 14 down to 4)
$0C:D3B6 BD 8C 0B     LDA.W $0B8C,X                   ; [$0B8C,X] = slot active flag
$0C:D3B9 D0 33        BNE $D3EE                       ; In use: try the next slot
$0C:D3BB A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0C:D3BD 9D 8C 0B     STA.W $0B8C,X                   ; } Mark the slot active
$0C:D3C0 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$0C:D3C2 9D 7D 0B     STA.W $0B7D,X                   ; } Gravity [$0B7D,X] = 4
$0C:D3C5 BD 86 D3     LDA.W $D386,X                   ; \
$0C:D3C8 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X                   ; } Y speed = $D386[X] (initial upward speed)
$0C:D3CB BD 96 D3     LDA.W $D396,X                   ; \
$0C:D3CE 9D 14 0B     STA.W $0B14,X                   ; } X speed = $D396[X]
$0C:D3D1 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$0C:D3D3 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D3D4 69 18        ADC.B #$18                      ; } X position = Mario X + $18
$0C:D3D6 9D 50 0B     STA.W $0B50,X                   ; /
$0C:D3D9 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$0C:D3DB 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D3DC 69 20        ADC.B #$20                      ; } Y position = Mario Y + $20
$0C:D3DE 9D 41 0B     STA.W $0B41,X                   ; /
$0C:D3E1 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$0C:D3E3 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; } Play sound only when frame counter bit 1 is clear
$0C:D3E5 D0 0C        BNE $D3F3                       ; /
$0C:D3E7 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$0C:D3E9 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; } Play sound effect $07
$0C:D3EC 80 05        BRA $D3F3                       ; Done

$0C:D3EE CA           DEX                             ; Next slot
$0C:D3EF E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; Stop after slot 4
$0C:D3F1 D0 C3        BNE $D3B6                       ; Loop
$0C:D3F3 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D3F4 A2 0E        LDX.B #$0E                      ; X = 14: update debris slots 14..4
$0C:D3F6 BD 8C 0B     LDA.W $0B8C,X                   ; Slot active flag
$0C:D3F9 F0 20        BEQ $D41B                       ; Inactive: next slot
$0C:D3FB BD 05 0B     LDA.W $0B05,X                   ; A = Y speed
$0C:D3FE 30 04        BMI $D404                       ; Moving up: always accelerate
$0C:D400 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; \
$0C:D402 B0 07        BCS $D40B                       ; } Falling: only accelerate while speed < $40 (terminal velocity)
$0C:D404 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:D405 7D 7D 0B     ADC.W $0B7D,X                   ; } Y speed += gravity [$0B7D,X]
$0C:D408 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X                   ; /
$0C:D40B 20 3A D3     JSR.W $D33A                     ; Move Y by speed
$0C:D40E 20 68 D3     JSR.W $D368                     ; Move X by speed
$0C:D411 BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X                   ; \
$0C:D414 C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; } Still above Y = $80? then keep it
$0C:D416 90 03        BCC $D41B                       ; /
$0C:D418 9E 8C 0B     STZ.W $0B8C,X                   ; Fell off the bottom: free the slot
$0C:D41B CA           DEX                             ; Next slot
$0C:D41C E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; Stop after slot 4
$0C:D41E D0 D6        BNE $D3F6                       ; Loop
$0C:D420 82 02 00     BRL $D425                       ; Continue into the debris draw routine


;;; $D423..D423: Table: debris tiles ;;;
$0C:D423              .db $3C,$3D                     ; Debris tiles: $3C, $3D (alternate every 2 frames)


;;; $D425: Draw falling debris ;;;
;; Draws every active debris slot (14 down to 4) as an 8x8 sprite, tile alternating $3C/$3D, skipping X < $50.
$0C:D425 A0 0E        LDY.B #$0E                      ; Y = 14: debris slot index
$0C:D427 A2 14        LDX.B #$14                      ; X = $14: OAM index (first slot used)
$0C:D429 B9 8C 0B     LDA.W $0B8C,Y                   ; Slot active flag
$0C:D42C F0 2C        BEQ $D45A                       ; Inactive: skip
$0C:D42E B9 50 0B     LDA.W $0B50,Y                   ; \
$0C:D431 C9 50        CMP.B #$50                      ; } Skip if X position < $50 (left clip)
$0C:D433 90 25        BCC $D45A                       ; /
$0C:D435 9D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,X       ; OAM X = debris X position
$0C:D438 B9 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,Y                   ; \
$0C:D43B 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; } OAM Y = debris Y position
$0C:D43E 5A           PHY                             ; Save slot index
$0C:D43F A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$0C:D441 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; |
$0C:D443 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = frame counter bit 1 (0 or 1)
$0C:D444 A8           TAY                             ; /
$0C:D445 B9 23 D4     LDA.W $D423,Y                   ; \
$0C:D448 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; } OAM tile = $D423[Y] (alternates $3C/$3D)
$0C:D44B 7A           PLY                             ; Restore slot index
$0C:D44C A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; \
$0C:D44E 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; } OAM properties = $22
$0C:D451 DA           PHX                             ; \
$0C:D452 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:D453 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D454 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D455 AA           TAX                             ; |
$0C:D456 9E 20 04     STZ.W $0420,X                   ; } OAM high table entry for this sprite = 0 (8x8, X bit 8 clear)
$0C:D459 FA           PLX                             ; /
$0C:D45A E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:D45B E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:D45C E8           INX                             ; } Next OAM entry
$0C:D45D E8           INX                             ; /
$0C:D45E 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$0C:D45F C0 03        CPY.B #$03                      ; Stop after slot 4
$0C:D461 D0 C6        BNE $D429                       ; Loop
$0C:D463 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D464              .db $F8,$80,$80,$80,$FA,$80,$80,$80 ; Spark Y offsets for [$1445] = 0,1 ($80 = unused)

;;; $D4A4: Draw sparks around Mario (JSL) ;;;
;; Called with JSL from bank 00 ($00C773). Draws up to three 8x8 sprites (tile $B6, prop $31) at offsets from
;;     Mario given
;; by $D484/0CD464 row [$1445]; offset $80 = skip. Y gets +8 when Mario is small.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:C773: Mario animation C: scripted cutscene movement (UnknownAniC)
$0C:D4A4 8B           PHB                             ; \
$0C:D4A5 4B           PHK                             ; } Switch data bank to this bank
$0C:D4A6 AB           PLB                             ; /

$0C:D4AF 86 02        STX $02                         ; /
$0C:D4B1 A2 40        LDX.B #$40                      ; X = $40: OAM index
$0C:D4B3 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \

$0C:D4B7 AD 45 14     LDA.W $1445                     ; \

$0C:D4BC A8           TAY                             ; /
$0C:D4BD B9 84 D4     LDA.W $D484,Y                   ; \
$0C:D4C0 C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; } A = X offset; $80 = no sprite
$0C:D4C2 F0 29        BEQ $D4ED                       ; /
$0C:D4C4 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:D4C5 65 94        ADC RAM_MarioXPos               ; } OAM X = Mario X + offset
$0C:D4C7 9D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,X       ; /
$0C:D4CA B9 64 D4     LDA.W $D464,Y                   ; \
$0C:D4CD 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D4CE 65 96        ADC RAM_MarioYPos               ; |
$0C:D4D0 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D4D1 65 02        ADC $02                         ; } OAM Y = Mario Y + Y offset + [$02]
$0C:D4D3 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; /
$0C:D4D6 A9 B6        LDA.B #$B6                      ; \
$0C:D4D8 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; } OAM tile = $B6
$0C:D4DB A9 31        LDA.B #$31                      ; \
$0C:D4DD 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; } OAM properties = $31
$0C:D4E0 DA           PHX                             ; \
$0C:D4E1 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0C:D4E2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D4E3 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D4E4 AA           TAX                             ; |
$0C:D4E5 9E 20 04     STZ.W $0420,X                   ; } OAM high table entry = 0
$0C:D4E8 FA           PLX                             ; /
$0C:D4E9 E8           INX                             ; \
$0C:D4EA E8           INX                             ; |
$0C:D4EB E8           INX                             ; } Next OAM entry
$0C:D4EC E8           INX                             ; /
$0C:D4ED C8           INY                             ; Next table entry
$0C:D4EE C6 00        DEC $00                         ; Next sprite
$0C:D4F0 10 CB        BPL $D4BD                       ; Loop
$0C:D4F2 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$0C:D4F3 6B           RTL                             ; Return



;;; $D4F4..D4F4: Table: rising sprite tiles ;;;

;;; $D4F8: Rising and sideways sprites near Mario ;;;
;; $0CD4F8: when [$1446] is set, object 2 rises at speed -3 until $0D pixels above Mario and is drawn with
;;     tiles from
;; $D4F4 (prop $33). $0CD557: object 3 moves right/down from Mario and is drawn the same way; at X >=
;;     $0D it ends,
;; clears [$1446] and advances [$1442]. $0CD5C6: advance the step, set [$1443] = $FF, [$144D] = $D0 and start
;; sound/music value $13 through the STA.W $1DFB stored as data at $0CD5D5.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:C9E6: Pointer table: cutscene 2 states; cutscene 5 (Ptrs0CC9D6)
$0C:D4F8 AD 46 14     LDA.W $1446                     ; Is the rising sprite active? ([$1446])
$0C:D4FB D0 05        BNE $D502                       ; Yes: go on
$0C:D4FD 9C 43 0B     STZ.W $0B43                     ; Inactive: clear its Y position
$0C:D500 80 54        BRA $D556                       ; Return

$0C:D502 A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; X = 2: object 2
$0C:D504 A9 FD        LDA.B #$FD                      ; \
$0C:D506 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X                   ; } Object 2 Y speed = $FD (-3, moving up)
$0C:D509 20 3A D3     JSR.W $D33A                     ; Move object 2
$0C:D50C BD 41 0B     LDA.W $0B41,X                   ; \
$0C:D50F 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; } A = -(object 2 Y position): distance risen
$0C:D511 1A           INC A                           ; /

$0C:D514 90 05        BCC $D51B                       ; Done: [$1446] = 0
$0C:D516 9C 46 14     STZ.W $1446                     ; Return
$0C:D519 80 3B        BRA $D556                       ; Return

$0C:D51B A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; \
$0C:D51D A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; |
$0C:D51F D0 02        BNE $D523                       ; } [$00] = Y offset: 0 for big Mario, 8 for small
$0C:D521 A2 08        LDX.B #$08                      ; /
$0C:D523 86 00        STX $00
$0C:D525 A2 34        LDX.B #$34                      ; X = $34: OAM index
$0C:D527 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$0C:D529 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D52A 65 94        ADC RAM_MarioXPos               ; } OAM X = Mario X + 4
$0C:D52C 9D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,X       ; /
$0C:D52F AD 43 0B     LDA.W $0B43                     ; \
$0C:D532 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D533 65 96        ADC RAM_MarioYPos               ; |
$0C:D535 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D536 65 00        ADC $00                         ; } OAM Y = Mario Y + object 2 Y + [$00]
$0C:D538 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; /
$0C:D53B AD 43 0B     LDA.W $0B43                     ; \
$0C:D53E 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$0C:D540 1A           INC A                           ; |
$0C:D541 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D542 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = distance risen / 4 (animation frame 0-3)
$0C:D543 A8           TAY                             ; /
$0C:D544 B9 F4 D4     LDA.W $D4F4,Y                   ; \
$0C:D547 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; } OAM tile = $D4F4[Y]
$0C:D54A A9 33        LDA.B #$33                      ; \
$0C:D54C 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; } OAM properties = $33
$0C:D54F 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:D550 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D551 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D552 AA           TAX                             ; } OAM high table entry = 0
$0C:D553 9E 20 04     STZ.W $0420,X                   ; /

$0C:D557 AD 46 14     LDA.W $1446                     ; Is the sideways sprite active? ([$1446])

$0C:D55C 9C 44 0B     STZ.W $0B44                     ; \
$0C:D55F 9C 53 0B     STZ.W $0B53                     ; } Inactive: clear object 3 X and Y positions
$0C:D562 80 61        BRA $D5C5                       ; Return

$0C:D564 A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: object 3
$0C:D566 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$0C:D568 9D 14 0B     STA.W $0B14,X                   ; } Object 3 X speed = 6
$0C:D56B A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0C:D56D 9D 05 0B     STA.W $0B05,X                   ; } Object 3 Y speed = 1
$0C:D570 20 3A D3     JSR.W $D33A                     ; Move object 3 vertically
$0C:D573 20 68 D3     JSR.W $D368                     ; Move object 3 horizontally
$0C:D576 BD 50 0B     LDA.W $0B50,X                   ; \
$0C:D579 C9 0D        CMP.B #$0D                      ; } X position < $0D? keep going
$0C:D57B 90 08        BCC $D585
$0C:D57D 9C 46 14     STZ.W $1446                     ; Finished: [$1446] = 0
$0C:D580 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Next scene step
$0C:D583 80 40        BRA $D5C5                       ; Return

$0C:D585 A2 0F        LDX.B #$0F                      ; \
$0C:D587 A0 0C        LDY.B #$0C                      ; } X = $0F, Y = $0C: offsets for big Mario
$0C:D589 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \

$0C:D591 84 01        STY $01                         ; } [$00] = Y offset, [$01] = X offset
$0C:D593 A2 34        LDX.B #$34                      ; X = $34: OAM index
$0C:D595 AD 53 0B     LDA.W $0B53                     ; \

$0C:D59B 18           CLC                             ; |

$0C:D59E 9D 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,X       ; /
$0C:D5A1 AD 44 0B     LDA.W $0B44                     ; \

$0C:D5A7 18           CLC                             ; |

$0C:D5AA 9D 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,X       ; /
$0C:D5AD AD 53 0B     LDA.W $0B53                     ; \

$0C:D5B2 A8           TAY                             ; |

$0C:D5B6 9D 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,X        ; /
$0C:D5B9 A9 33        LDA.B #$33                      ; \
$0C:D5BB 9D 03 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,X        ; } OAM properties = $33
$0C:D5BE 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:D5BF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D5C0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D5C1 AA           TAX                             ; } OAM high table entry = 0
$0C:D5C2 9E 20 04     STZ.W $0420,X                   ; /
$0C:D5C5 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D5C6 EE 42 14     INC.W $1442                     ; Next scene step
$0C:D5C9 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$0C:D5CB 8D 43 14     STA.W $1443                     ; } [$1443] = $FF
$0C:D5CE A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; \
$0C:D5D0 8D 4D 14     STA.W $144D                     ; } [$144D] = $D0
