;;; $D5D5: Start music $13 (code stored as data) (Instr0CD5D5) ;;;
;; STA.W $1DFB written as .db bytes because the Mario-frame table at $0CD5D6 overlaps it; part of the routine
;;     above.
$0C:D5D5              .db $8D,$FB,$1D                 ; Raw bytes of STA.W $1DFB (play music/sound value [A] = $13)

$0C:D5D8 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $D5D9..D5E1: Table: Mario frame per animation tick ;;;
$0C:D5D9              .db $35,$36,$36,$36,$37,$37,$37,$37 ; Mario frame per animation tick, ticks 0-7 ($35-$37)
$0C:D5E1              .db $37,$37,$37,$36,$36,$35,$35,$35 ; Mario frame per animation tick, ticks 8-15

;;; $D5E9..D5F9: Table: accessory tile and slot group ;;;
$0C:D5E9              .db $8B,$8B,$8B,$AA,$8A,$CE,$CE,$8A ; Accessory tile (bit 0 = OAM slot group) by pose / tick, 0-7
$0C:D5F1              .db $8A,$AA,$AA,$8A,$AA,$8A,$CE,$8A ; Accessory tile by pose / tick, 8-15
$0C:D5F9              .db $AA,$8A,$8A                 ; Accessory tile by tick 16-18


;;; $D5FC..D60C: Table: accessory OAM properties ;;;
$0C:D5FC              .db $61,$61,$61,$61,$61,$61,$61,$21 ; Accessory OAM properties (XORed with flip), by pose / tick 0-7
$0C:D604              .db $21,$21,$21,$A1,$21,$21,$61,$61 ; Accessory OAM properties, 8-15
$0C:D60C              .db $61,$E1,$E1                 ; Accessory OAM properties, 16-18


;;; $D60F..D62F: Table: accessory X offsets ;;;
$0C:D60F              .db $FA,$FA,$F9,$FB,$F9,$FA,$F0,$F0 ; Accessory X offsets (small, big pairs), entries 0-3
$0C:D617              .db $F4,$F4,$FD,$FF,$FD,$FF,$0A,$0D ; Accessory X offsets (small, big pairs), entries 4-7
$0C:D61F              .db $0A,$0D,$0E,$10,$0E,$10,$0D,$0E ; Accessory X offsets (small, big pairs), entries 8-11
$0C:D627              .db $0E,$10,$0A,$0D,$FD,$FF,$F4,$F4 ; Accessory X offsets (small, big pairs), entries 12-15
$0C:D62F              .db $F0,$F0,$F3,$F0,$F3,$F0     ; Accessory X offsets (small, big pairs), entries 16-19


;;; $D635..D655: Table: accessory Y offsets ;;;
$0C:D635              .db $06,$03,$07,$00,$07,$01,$0D,$08 ; Accessory Y offsets (small, big pairs), entries 0-3
$0C:D63D              .db $02,$FB,$FF,$F6,$FF,$F6,$03,$FD ; Accessory Y offsets (small, big pairs), entries 4-7
$0C:D645              .db $03,$FD,$0A,$06,$0A,$06,$12,$0F ; Accessory Y offsets (small, big pairs), entries 8-11
$0C:D64D              .db $0A,$06,$03,$FD,$FF,$F6,$02,$FB ; Accessory Y offsets (small, big pairs), entries 12-15
$0C:D655              .db $0D,$08,$15,$10,$15,$10     ; Accessory Y offsets (small, big pairs), entries 16-19


;;; $D65B: Draw Mario accessory sprite (probably cape) ;;;
;; Runs when [$144A] >> 1 is non-zero. Plays a 16-tick animation counted down in [$1445] (sets Mario frame
;;     from
;; the table at $0CD5D6), then draws one 16x16 sprite at $02FC (or $032C) relative to Mario, flipped with his
;;     facing.
;; The tile, properties and offsets come from the tables at $0CD5E9-$0CD655, indexed by pose [$13DB] or tick.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:CA2F: Pointer table: cutscene 4 states; cutscene 3 (Ptrs0CCA1F)
$0C:D65B AD 4A 14     LDA.W $144A                     ; \
$0C:D65E 4A           LSR                             ; } Return unless [$144A] >> 1 is non-zero
$0C:D65F F0 62        BEQ $D6C3                       ; /
$0C:D661 AD 45 14     LDA.W $1445                     ; \
$0C:D664 D0 05        BNE $D66B                       ; } [$1445] = 0: use pose [$13DB] directly
$0C:D666 AE DB 13     LDX.W $13DB                     ; X = [$13DB] (pose index)
$0C:D669 80 15        BRA $D680                       ; Skip the animation

$0C:D66B CE 45 14     DEC.W $1445                     ; [$1445] -= 1 (animation tick)
$0C:D66E C9 F0        CMP.B #$F0                      ; \
$0C:D670 90 02        BCC $D674                       ; } Ticks >= $F0 count as $0F
$0C:D672 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; /
$0C:D674 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; Low nibble of the tick
$0C:D676 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:D677 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; } X = (tick & $0F) + 3
$0C:D679 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0C:D67A BD D6 D5     LDA.W ADDR_0CD5D6,X             ; \
$0C:D67D 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; } Mario frame = table at $0CD5D6 + X ($D5D9: frames $35-$37)
$0C:D680 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: first OAM slot group
$0C:D682 BD E9 D5     LDA.W $D5E9,X                   ; \
$0C:D685 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D686 90 02        BCC $D68A                       ; } Bit 0 of the tile entry selects the second slot group (Y = $30)
$0C:D688 A0 30        LDY.B #$30                      ; /
$0C:D68A 0A           ASL                             ; \
$0C:D68B 99 FE 02     STA.W $02FE,Y                   ; } OAM tile = entry with bit 0 cleared
$0C:D68E A5 76        LDA RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$0C:D690 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D691 6A           ROR                             ; |
$0C:D692 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D693 5D FC D5     EOR.W $D5FC,X                   ; } OAM properties = (Mario direction << 6) XOR $D5FC[X]  (X flip)
$0C:D696 99 FF 02     STA.W $02FF,Y                   ; /
$0C:D699 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:D69A 0A           ASL                             ; } X = X * 2
$0C:D69B AA           TAX                             ; /
$0C:D69C A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$0C:D69E F0 01        BEQ $D6A1                       ; } +1 if Mario is not small
$0C:D6A0 E8           INX                             ; /
$0C:D6A1 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$0C:D6A3 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D6A4 7D 35 D6     ADC.W $D635,X                   ; } OAM Y = Mario Y + $D635[X]
$0C:D6A7 99 FD 02     STA.W $02FD,Y                   ; /
$0C:D6AA BD 0F D6     LDA.W $D60F,X                   ; A = X offset from $D60F[X]
$0C:D6AD A6 76        LDX RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$0C:D6AF D0 03        BNE $D6B4                       ; |
$0C:D6B1 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; } Mirror the X offset when Mario faces left
$0C:D6B3 1A           INC A                           ; /
$0C:D6B4 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:D6B5 65 94        ADC RAM_MarioXPos               ; } OAM X = Mario X +/- offset
$0C:D6B7 99 FC 02     STA.W $02FC,Y                   ; /
$0C:D6BA 98           TYA                             ; \
$0C:D6BB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D6BC 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$0C:D6BD A8           TAY                             ; /
$0C:D6BE A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0C:D6C0 99 5F 04     STA.W $045F,Y                   ; } OAM high table entry = 2 (16x16)
$0C:D6C3 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $D6C4..D6E5: Tables: three-tile sprite and column steps ;;;
$0C:D6C4              .db $E7,$E6,$E6,$EA,$E6,$E7     ; Three-tile accessory X base by pose*2 + big

$0C:D6CA              .db $F6,$F1,$F3,$F3,$F3,$F4     ; Three-tile accessory Y base by pose*2 + big

$0C:D6D0              .db $1B,$0E,$00                 ; Offsets X of the three sprites: $1B, $0E, $00

$0C:D6D3              .db $15,$08,$00                 ; Offsets Y of the three sprites: $15, $08, $00

$0C:D6D6              .db $8E,$8E,$8C                 ; Tiles of the three sprites: $8E, $8E, $8C

$0C:D6D9              .db $FC,$04,$FC,$04,$FC,$04,$FC ; Column Y step per scene step: -4 / +4 alternating

$0C:D6E0              .db $34,$68,$34,$68,$34         ; Column target Y per step ($34 / $68); continues into next row

$0C:D6E5              .db $68,$34,$B0,$00,$C0,$00,$C0 ; $68,$34 end the Y targets; then Mario target X for steps 2,4,6: $B0,$C0,$C0


;;; $D6EC: Draw three-tile sprite and move rope column ;;;
;; Runs when [$144A] >> 1 is non-zero. With [$1446] = 0 it draws three 16x16 sprites (tiles $8E,$8E,$8C)
;;     diagonally
;; behind Mario (flipped with his direction). Otherwise it draws a column of five 16x16 sprites (tile $AC then
;;     $AE) at Mario X
;; from Y = [$1446] - 1 (capped at $68), sets Mario frame $25/$38 and steps through [$1445]: move the column
;;     between Y $34
;; and $68 in steps of 4, pausing [$1449] = $10 frames, with Mario walking right to the X targets. Purpose is
;;     a guess.
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:CA51: Pointer table: cutscene 3 states; cutscene 6 (Ptrs0CCA49)
$0C:D6EC AD 4A 14     LDA.W $144A                     ; \
$0C:D6EF 4A           LSR                             ; } Return unless [$144A] >> 1 is non-zero
$0C:D6F0 F0 5F        BEQ $D751                       ; /
$0C:D6F2 A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; \
$0C:D6F4 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; |
$0C:D6F6 99 70 04     STA.W $0470,Y                   ; |
$0C:D6F9 88           DEY                             ; } OAM high table entries $0470-$0474 = 2 (five 16x16 sprites)
$0C:D6FA 10 FA        BPL $D6F6                       ; /
$0C:D6FC AD 46 14     LDA.W $1446                     ; Rope-column active? ([$1446] != 0)
$0C:D6FF D0 51        BNE $D752                       ; Yes: draw it
$0C:D701 AD DB 13     LDA.W $13DB                     ; \
$0C:D704 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:D705 A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; |
$0C:D707 F0 01        BEQ $D70A                       ; |
$0C:D709 1A           INC A                           ; } Y = pose [$13DB] * 2 (+1 if Mario is not small)
$0C:D70A A8           TAY                             ; /
$0C:D70B B9 C4 D6     LDA.W $D6C4,Y                   ; \
$0C:D70E 85 00        STA $00                         ; } [$00] = X offset base $D6C4[Y]
$0C:D710 B9 CA D6     LDA.W $D6CA,Y                   ; \
$0C:D713 85 01        STA $01                         ; } [$01] = Y offset base $D6CA[Y]
$0C:D715 A5 76        LDA RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$0C:D717 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D718 6A           ROR                             ; |
$0C:D719 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D71A 49 61        EOR.B #$61                      ; } [$02] = OAM properties: X flip from direction, EOR $61
$0C:D71C 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$0C:D71E A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; X = 2: three sprites
$0C:D720 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:D721 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0C:D722 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = OAM index = X * 4
$0C:D723 A8           TAY                             ; /
$0C:D724 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0C:D726 18           CLC                             ; } A = [$00] + $D6D0[X]
$0C:D727 7D D0 D6     ADC.W $D6D0,X                   ; /
$0C:D72A 24 02        BIT $02                         ; \
$0C:D72C 50 03        BVC $D731                       ; |
$0C:D72E 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; } Mirror the offset when flipped
$0C:D730 1A           INC A                           ; /
$0C:D731 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:D732 65 94        ADC RAM_MarioXPos               ; } OAM X = Mario X + offset
$0C:D734 99 40 03     STA.W $0340,Y                   ; /
$0C:D737 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$0C:D739 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D73A 7D D3 D6     ADC.W $D6D3,X                   ; |
$0C:D73D 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D73E 65 96        ADC RAM_MarioYPos               ; } OAM Y = Mario Y + [$01] + $D6D3[X]
$0C:D740 99 41 03     STA.W $0341,Y                   ; /
$0C:D743 BD D6 D6     LDA.W $D6D6,X                   ; \
$0C:D746 99 42 03     STA.W $0342,Y                   ; } OAM tile = $D6D6[X]
$0C:D749 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$0C:D74B 99 43 03     STA.W $0343,Y                   ; } OAM properties = [$02]
$0C:D74E CA           DEX                             ; Next sprite
$0C:D74F 10 CF        BPL $D720                       ; Loop
$0C:D751 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D752 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; \
$0C:D754 D0 03        BNE $D759                       ; } Every 8th frame queue a stripe image update
$0C:D756 20 2D D2     JSR.W $D22D                     ; /
$0C:D759 A0 25        LDY.B #$25                      ; \
$0C:D75B AD 46 14     LDA.W $1446                     ; |
$0C:D75E C9 4C        CMP.B #$4C                      ; |
$0C:D760 90 02        BCC $D764                       ; |
$0C:D762 A0 38        LDY.B #$38                      ; } Mario frame = $25 above [$1446] = $4C, else $38 (ducking, back to camera)
$0C:D764 8C E0 13     STY.W MarioFrame                ; /
$0C:D767 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: OAM index
$0C:D769 3A           DEC A                           ; A = [$1446] - 1: Y of the top sprite
$0C:D76A 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = Y of this sprite
$0C:D76C A9 AC        LDA.B #$AC                      ; \
$0C:D76E 99 42 03     STA.W $0342,Y                   ; } OAM tile = $AC (top; later $AE)
$0C:D771 A9 21        LDA.B #$21                      ; \
$0C:D773 99 43 03     STA.W $0343,Y                   ; } OAM properties = $21
$0C:D776 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; OAM X = Mario X
$0C:D778 99 40 03     STA.W $0340,Y                   ; \
$0C:D77B A5 00        LDA $00                         ; } OAM Y = [$00]
$0C:D77D 99 41 03     STA.W $0341,Y                   ; /
$0C:D780 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:D781 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0C:D783 C9 68        CMP.B #$68                      ; |
$0C:D785 90 02        BCC $D789                       ; |
$0C:D787 A9 68        LDA.B #$68                      ; } [$00] += $10 for the next sprite, capped at $68
$0C:D789 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0C:D78B C8           INY                             ; \
$0C:D78C C8           INY                             ; |
$0C:D78D C8           INY                             ; } Next OAM entry
$0C:D78E C8           INY                             ; /
$0C:D78F A9 AE        LDA.B #$AE                      ; Tile $AE for the following sprites
$0C:D791 C0 14        CPY.B #$14                      ; Five sprites done?
$0C:D793 90 D9        BCC $D76E                       ; Loop
$0C:D795 AE 45 14     LDX.W $1445                     ; X = step [$1445]
$0C:D798 AD 46 14     LDA.W $1446                     ; A = [$1446]
$0C:D79B DD E0 D6     CMP.W $D6E0,X                   ; \
$0C:D79E D0 3E        BNE $D7DE                       ; } At the target Y for this step ($D6E0)? If not, move toward it
$0C:D7A0 AD 49 14     LDA.W $1449                     ; \
$0C:D7A3 F0 04        BEQ $D7A9                       ; |
$0C:D7A5 CE 49 14     DEC.W $1449                     ; } Pause timer [$1449]: count down and return
$0C:D7A8 60           RTS                             ; /

$0C:D7A9 8A           TXA                             ; Pause over
$0C:D7AA F0 1D        BEQ $D7C9                       ; Step 0: advance immediately
$0C:D7AC 4A           LSR                             ; \
$0C:D7AD B0 1A        BCS $D7C9                       ; } Odd steps: advance immediately
$0C:D7AF A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$0C:D7B1 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$0C:D7B3 F0 05        BEQ $D7BA                       ; |
$0C:D7B5 A9 39        LDA.B #$39                      ; } Even steps: every 4 frames show Mario frame $39 (standing, back to camera)
$0C:D7B7 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; /
$0C:D7BA A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$0C:D7BC DD E5 D6     CMP.W $D6E5,X                   ; } Mario walks right to X = $D6E5[X]
$0C:D7BF F0 08        BEQ $D7C9                       ; /
$0C:D7C1 1A           INC A                           ; \
$0C:D7C2 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; } Mario X += 1
$0C:D7C4 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; \
$0C:D7C6 F0 1D        BEQ $D7E5                       ; } Every 16 pixels: restart the pause timer
$0C:D7C8 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D7C9 EE 45 14     INC.W $1445                     ; Next step [$1445]++
$0C:D7CC E0 06        CPX.B #$06                      ; \
$0C:D7CE 90 04        BCC $D7D4                       ; } Step 6 or more?
$0C:D7D0 9C 46 14     STZ.W $1446                     ; \
$0C:D7D3 60           RTS                             ; } Last step: [$1446] = 0 (column gone)

$0C:D7D4 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0C:D7D5 4A           LSR                             ; } Play a sound on even steps
$0C:D7D6 B0 05        BCS $D7DD                       ; /
$0C:D7D8 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$0C:D7DA 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; } Play sound effect $0F
$0C:D7DD 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0C:D7DE 18           CLC                             ; \
$0C:D7DF 7D D9 D6     ADC.W $D6D9,X                   ; } [$1446] += $D6D9[X] (+/-4: move column up or down)
$0C:D7E2 8D 46 14     STA.W $1446                     ; /
$0C:D7E5 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$0C:D7E7 8D 49 14     STA.W $1449                     ; } Pause timer [$1449] = $10
$0C:D7EA 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $D7EB..D7FB: Tables: carried item position ;;;
$0C:D7EB              .db $F7,$F6                     ; Carried item X offset from Mario: small $F7, big $F6

$0C:D7ED              .db $63,$5F,$62,$5F,$62,$5E     ; Carried item Y position by pose*2 + big

$0C:D7F3              .db $67,$66,$65,$65,$64,$64,$64,$64 ; Bobbing Y position of carried item, 16 frames
$0C:D7FB              .db $64,$64,$64,$64,$65,$65,$66,$67 ; Bobbing Y position, frames 8-15


;;; $D803: Carried item sprite and Mario exit walk ;;;
;; Called every frame from the cutscene update ($0CC98C). Draws a 16x16 sprite (tile 0, prop $21) following
;;     Mario at
;; X = Mario - 9/10, with Y bobbing over 16 frames from $D7F3. When Mario is still at X < $40 it starts
;;     the pick-up
;; image timer ([$1498] = $10); when he reaches X <= 5 and is not moving left it increments [$144A] (scene
;;     done).
;; Called by:
;;     $0C:C99A: Cutscene main entry and text timer
$0C:D803 AE 4A 14     LDX.W $144A                     ; X = [$144A]
$0C:D806 D0 35        BNE $D83D                       ; Non-zero: skip ahead
$0C:D808 AD 98 14     LDA.W RAM_PickUpImgTimer        ; Pick-up image timer
$0C:D80B F0 05        BEQ $D812                       ; Zero: look for Mario
$0C:D80D 4A           LSR                             ; \
$0C:D80E F0 39        BEQ $D849                       ; } Timer = 1: advance [$144A]
$0C:D810 80 3D        BRA $D84F                       ; Otherwise just animate

$0C:D812 A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$0C:D814 F0 02        BEQ $D818                       ; } Y = 0 (small) or 1 (not small)
$0C:D816 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; /
$0C:D818 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$0C:D81A 18           CLC                             ; |
$0C:D81B 79 EB D7     ADC.W $D7EB,Y                   ; } [$144C] = Mario X + $D7EB[Y] (item X position)
$0C:D81E 8D 4C 14     STA.W $144C                     ; /
$0C:D821 98           TYA                             ; \
$0C:D822 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0C:D823 AD DB 13     LDA.W $13DB                     ; |
$0C:D826 2A           ROL                             ; } Y = [$13DB] * 2 + (Y & 1)
$0C:D827 A8           TAY                             ; /
$0C:D828 B9 ED D7     LDA.W $D7ED,Y                   ; A = item Y position from $D7ED[Y]
$0C:D82B A4 94        LDY RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$0C:D82D C0 40        CPY.B #$40                      ; } Mario X >= $40: just place the item
$0C:D82F B0 27        BCS $D858                       ; /
$0C:D831 A4 7B        LDY RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$0C:D833 D0 23        BNE $D858                       ; } Mario still moving: just place the item
$0C:D835 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$0C:D837 8D 98 14     STA.W RAM_PickUpImgTimer        ; } Pick-up image timer = $10
$0C:D83A 9C 8F 14     STZ.W $148F                     ; [$148F] = 0
$0C:D83D A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$0C:D83F C5 94        CMP RAM_MarioXPos               ; |
$0C:D841 90 09        BCC $D84C                       ; } A = 5; if Mario X > 5 keep walking, else clamp X to 5
$0C:D843 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; /
$0C:D845 A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$0C:D847 30 03        BMI $D84C                       ; } Moving left: keep going; otherwise [$144A]++ (scene done)
$0C:D849 EE 4A 14     INC.W $144A                     ; /
$0C:D84C EE 4B 14     INC.W $144B                     ; [$144B]++ (bobbing frame)
$0C:D84F AD 4B 14     LDA.W $144B                     ; \
$0C:D852 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0C:D854 A8           TAY                             ; } A = $D7F3[[$144B] & $0F]: bobbing Y position
$0C:D855 B9 F3 D7     LDA.W $D7F3,Y                   ; /
$0C:D858 8D 81 03     STA.W $0381                     ; OAM Y = A
$0C:D85B AD 4C 14     LDA.W $144C
$0C:D85E 8D 80 03     STA.W $0380                     ; OAM X = [$144C]
$0C:D861 9C 82 03     STZ.W $0382                     ; OAM tile = 0
$0C:D864 A9 21        LDA.B #$21                      ; \
$0C:D866 8D 83 03     STA.W $0383                     ; } OAM properties = $21
$0C:D869 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0C:D86B 8D 80 04     STA.W $0480                     ; } OAM high table entry = 2 (16x16)
$0C:D86E 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $D86F..D8FF: Padding: $FF fill ;;;
$0C:D86F              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
